title: Tax Incentives, Portfolio Choice, and Macroprudential Risks
affiliations: Swiss National Science Foundation, University of St. Gallen and University of St. Gallen

detail.title: Tax Incentives, Portfolio Choice, and Macroprudential Risks

publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Financial Studies Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We calibrate a lifecycle portfolio-choice model of homeowners facing uninsurable income risk to show that tax deductions for mortgage interest payments and voluntary pensioncontributions have sizable effects on household portfolios and macroprudential risks. The deductions reduce the after-tax cost of debt and increase the after-tax return of pension savings so that the mortgage incidence increases and portfolios shift from home equity and liquid assets towards pension savings. Because the consumption responses to a house-price decline are heterogeneous, the distribution of household debt shapes the quantitative effect of the tax deductions on the homeowners’ resilience after a house price bust.

AI.tldr: 该研究校准了一个生命周期投资组合选择模型，分析抵押贷款利息支付和自愿养老金缴款的税收减免对家庭投资组合和宏观审慎风险的影响。研究发现这些税收优惠会降低债务的税后成本，提高养老金的税后回报，导致抵押贷款使用增加，投资组合从住房权益和流动资产转向养老金储蓄。由于房价下跌对消费的影响存在异质性，家庭债务的分布决定了税收减免对房主在房价暴跌后恢复能力的影响程度。
AI.research_question: 抵押贷款利息支付和自愿养老金缴款的税收减免如何影响家庭投资组合配置和宏观审慎风险？这些税收政策如何塑造房主在房价下跌后的恢复能力？
AI.motivation: 许多国家为抵押贷款利息和养老金缴款提供税收减免，但这些政策对家庭投资组合和金融稳定性的影响尚未得到充分研究。理解这些税收激励如何影响家庭债务积累和资产配置对于评估宏观审慎风险至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期投资组合选择理论，考虑不可保险的收入风险；家庭财务决策理论；税收激励对投资行为的影响理论；宏观审慎风险分析框架。
AI.method: 校准的生命周期投资组合选择模型，针对面临不可保险收入风险的房主。模型考虑了抵押贷款利息和养老金缴款的税收减免政策，分析这些政策如何影响家庭的投资组合决策和债务积累。
AI.findings: 1. 税收减免显著降低了债务的税后成本，提高了养老金的税后回报；2. 导致抵押贷款使用增加，家庭投资组合从住房权益和流动资产转向养老金储蓄；3. 房价下跌对消费的影响存在异质性；4. 家庭债务的分布决定了税收减免对房主在房价暴跌后恢复能力的定量影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将税收激励纳入生命周期投资组合选择模型；2. 揭示了税收政策通过影响家庭债务积累和资产配置渠道对宏观审慎风险的作用机制；3. 强调了家庭异质性在评估政策效果中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了评估税收减免政策对金融稳定性影响的工具；2. 揭示了税收激励可能无意中增加宏观审慎风险；3. 建议在设计税收政策时需要考虑其对家庭债务积累和资产配置的长期影响。

title: Women's Labour Market Potential Unpaid Care Work and the Formalisation of Part-time Employment
affiliations: and National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER)

detail.title: Women's Labour Market Potential Unpaid Care Work and the Formalisation of Part-time Employment
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the macroeconomic and labour market implications of gender equality in unpaid care work and the formalisation of part-time employment in India. The unequal distribution of unpaid care responsibilities significantly limits women's labour force participation, perpetuating gender disparities in employment and economic outcomes. Using the McCall-Mortensen macroeconomic job search framework, this paper models the potential impacts of policy interventions on female labour force participation rates. A key contribution of the paper is to derive quantitative estimates via model simulation. We find that formalising part-time employment contracts and equalising the time burden of unpaid care work between genders predict a 6 percentage point increase in female LFPR, raising the current rate from 37% to 43%. The findings underscore the critical need for formalising part-time employment contracts in India.

AI.tldr: 本文通过宏观经济模型模拟发现，在印度，通过正规化兼职就业合同和性别间平等分担无偿照护工作，可使女性劳动力参与率提高6个百分点（从37%升至43%）。
AI.research_question: 性别间无偿照护工作的平等分配和兼职就业正规化对印度宏观经济和劳动力市场有何影响？
AI.motivation: 无偿照护责任的不平等分配严重限制了女性的劳动力参与，加剧了就业和经济结果中的性别差距，需要政策干预来解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: McCall-Mortensen宏观经济工作搜寻框架，用于模拟政策干预对女性劳动力参与率的影响。
AI.method: 使用McCall-Mortensen模型进行模拟分析，通过模型推导定量估计。
AI.findings: 正规化兼职就业合同和性别间平等分担无偿照护工作可使女性劳动力参与率提高6个百分点（从37%升至43%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将McCall-Mortensen工作搜寻框架应用于性别平等和无偿照护工作的宏观经济分析，为理解政策干预对女性劳动力参与的影响提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政策制定者提供了具体建议：正规化兼职就业合同是提高女性劳动力参与率的关键政策工具，有助于缩小性别差距并促进经济发展。

title: The Impact of High-Speed Rail Station Development on Urban Form: Evidence from Beijing and Tianjin
affiliations: University of Seattle

detail.title: The Impact of High-Speed Rail Station Development on Urban Form: Evidence from Beijing and Tianjin
detail.abstract:
The High-Speed Rail (HSR) was first constructed and operated in Japan in 1964. Today, several countries around Europe, Asia, and America have HSR services. As an emerging, high-speed ground transportation method, the HSR competes with and cooperates with road, air, and water transportation, and also contributes to economic development and passenger transportation. In 2008, China proposed a National High-Speed Rail Network Plan and began building the “JingHu Line,” which connects Beijing, Tianjin, and Shanghai.

This thesis focuses on the HSR construction in China, especially the construction of the “JingHu Line.” Beijing and Tianjin, the main cities served by this line, began reconstructing existing rail stations to meet the technical norms of HSRs. This thesis draws on existing literature about urban development, urban form, and high-speed rail stations to evaluate the impact of the HSR station on the surrounding area. It focuses especially on the reconstruction of high-speed rail stations in Beijing and Tianjin to examine the connections between HSRs and other urban transport methods, the emergence of new urban spaces, and land-use change in the station area.

In the thesis, I firstly review current literature and define three important terms, “high-speed rail,” “urban form,” and “rail station area,” which are the basis for this research. In the next section, I examine the evolving history of high-speed rail worldwide, which provides the background for this research and the main motivation for the construction of the Chinese High-Speed Network. Moreover, I review the features of HSR transportation, because the unique features of HSRs directly influence the changing form of surrounding areas. The “Urban Catalysts Theory” and “Linkage Theory” are introduced in Chapter 3 as the theoretical underpinning for this research. These two theories are tools to understand interactions between the HSR station and the surrounding area. Chapter three also reviews the current literature on the influence of HSR stations on a city. In the case study, I examine the construction of the HSR stations in Beijing and Tianjin to learn how the reconstruction projects were planned and built, how HSRs connect to the inner-city transportation network, and how the urban form changes in the station areas. Through this research, we can learn about the interactions between the construction of HSR stations and the development in the station area. Also, the review of reconstruction projects for HSR stations in Beijing and Tianjin provides experience for other cities that will have HSR services in the coming years.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究中国高铁建设，特别是京沪线高铁站重建对周边区域的影响，以北京和天津为例，探讨高铁站与城市交通连接、新城市空间形成及土地利用变化。
AI.research_question: 高铁站重建如何影响周边区域的城市形态、交通连接和土地利用变化？
AI.motivation: 中国高铁网络快速发展，特别是京沪线的建设，高铁站重建对周边区域产生重要影响，需要研究这种影响机制为其他城市提供经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市催化剂理论和联动理论，用于理解高铁站与周边区域的相互作用关系。
AI.method: 文献综述和案例研究，以北京和天津高铁站重建项目为案例，分析规划建设过程、与城市交通网络连接、站区城市形态变化。
AI.findings: 高铁站重建促进了周边区域的城市形态变化、新城市空间形成、土地利用模式改变，并加强了与城市内部交通网络的连接。
AI.theory_contributions: 应用城市催化剂理论和联动理论分析高铁站对城市发展的影响机制，丰富了高铁与城市发展关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他即将建设高铁的城市提供经验借鉴，指导高铁站规划建设与周边区域协同发展。

title: Artificial Intelligence and the Challenges to Banking and Financial Market Integrity
affiliations: Research Group on Law, Economics and Management (UMR CNRS 7321 GREDEG) / Université Nice Sophia Antipolis

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and the Challenges to Banking and Financial Market Integrity
detail.abstract: A substantial body of literature has been developed on the risks associated with algorithm-based, or at least algorithm-facilitated, anticompetitive practices. Similarly, numerous studies have addressed the risks of consumer choice distortions and manipulation. This contribution provides a brief synthesis of this literature and outlines perspectives on comparable risks that may threaten the integrity of banking and financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文对算法促成的反竞争行为和消费者选择扭曲风险文献进行综述，并探讨这些风险对银行和金融市场完整性的威胁。
AI.research_question: 算法促成的反竞争行为和消费者选择扭曲风险如何威胁银行和金融市场的完整性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献已广泛研究算法促成的反竞争行为和消费者选择操纵风险，但缺乏对这些风险如何具体影响银行和金融市场完整性的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于反竞争行为理论、消费者行为操纵理论、算法治理理论，以及金融市场完整性理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合分析，对现有研究进行系统性梳理和整合。
AI.findings: 算法促成的反竞争行为和消费者选择扭曲风险在银行和金融市场中具有特殊表现形式，可能通过算法合谋、价格歧视、信息不对称加剧等方式威胁市场完整性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将算法风险理论扩展到银行和金融领域，建立了算法风险与金融市场完整性之间的理论联系框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供识别和应对银行金融市场中算法风险的框架，帮助金融机构建立算法治理机制以维护市场完整性。

title: Blockchain for Islamic Social Financing and Islamic Financial Institutions

detail.title: Blockchain for Islamic Social Financing and Islamic Financial Institutions
detail.abstract: This article examines the potential of blockchain technology to enhance Islamic social finance and the operational frameworks of Islamic financial institutions (IFIs) in a manner consistent with Shariah principles. It analyses how blockchain-based tools such as smart contracts, digital wallets and distributed ledgers can improve transparency, accountability and efficiency in zakat collection and waqf endowment management, thereby strengthening public trust and advancing the objectives of Maqasid al-Shariah. The article further evaluates the role of blockchain in addressing key structural challenges faced by IFIs, including Shariah compliance in foreign exchange spot transactions, risk allocation in murabaha financing, and heightened liquidity risk exposure arising from Islamic financial contracts. By exploring practical use cases and regulatory considerations, the article argues that blockchain has significant potential to support social inclusion, enhance Shariah compliance and improve financial stability within the Islamic finance ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨区块链技术如何提升伊斯兰社会金融和伊斯兰金融机构的运营框架，使其符合伊斯兰教法原则。分析区块链工具如智能合约、数字钱包和分布式账本如何改善天课征收和宗教基金管理的透明度、问责制和效率，从而增强公众信任并促进伊斯兰教法目标。同时评估区块链在解决伊斯兰金融机构面临的关键结构性挑战中的作用。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术如何增强伊斯兰社会金融和伊斯兰金融机构的运营框架，使其符合伊斯兰教法原则？
AI.motivation: 伊斯兰金融需要提高透明度、问责制和效率，特别是在天课征收和宗教基金管理方面。同时，伊斯兰金融机构面临结构性挑战，如外汇即期交易的教法合规性、穆拉巴哈融资中的风险分配以及伊斯兰金融合同带来的流动性风险。区块链技术为解决这些问题提供了潜在方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于伊斯兰教法原则（Shariah）和伊斯兰教法目标（Maqasid al-Shariah）的理论框架，强调透明度、问责制、社会包容和金融稳定等核心价值。
AI.method: 理论分析结合实践案例研究，探讨区块链工具（智能合约、数字钱包、分布式账本）在伊斯兰金融中的应用，并评估监管考虑因素。
AI.findings: 区块链技术能够显著改善天课征收和宗教基金管理的透明度和效率，增强公众信任。同时，区块链可以帮助解决伊斯兰金融机构面临的结构性挑战，包括外汇交易的教法合规性、风险分配和流动性风险管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区块链技术与伊斯兰教法原则和伊斯兰教法目标相结合，为伊斯兰金融的数字化转型提供了理论框架。扩展了伊斯兰金融科技的理论基础，特别是在社会金融和机构运营方面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊斯兰金融机构提供了具体的区块链应用方案，包括天课征收、宗教基金管理、外汇交易合规性、风险分配和流动性风险管理。同时提出了监管考虑因素，为政策制定者和监管机构提供了实践指导。

reference: Columbia Business School Research Paper No. 6147226
title: Do Machines Make Firms Meaner? Automation and the Erosion of Workplace Amenities
affiliations: Columbia Business School, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance and Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Management

detail.title: Do Machines Make Firms Meaner? Automation and the Erosion of Workplace Amenities

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper No. 6147226
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: By reducing firms' dependence on human labor, automation increases firm bargaining power and weakens incentives to invest in firm-employee relations. We show that higher automation is associated with a broad deterioration in firm employee treatment, including lower employee-related CSR scores, deterioration in employee-related corporate culture, increased framing of employees as costs, greater labor rights violations, and more negative employee reviews of senior leadership and work-life balance. These negative effects are stronger for routine-intensive industries, in labor markets where workers have fewer outside options due to high unemployment or greater labor market concentration, and in years with lower electricity prices. Our findings caution that automation affects not only the quantity of jobs but also firms' treatment of employees and the quality of employees' workplace experience.

AI.tldr: 自动化通过降低企业对人工劳动的依赖，增强了企业的议价能力，削弱了投资于劳资关系的动机，导致员工待遇全面恶化
AI.research_question: 自动化如何影响企业对员工的待遇？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注自动化对就业数量的影响，但缺乏对自动化如何影响员工待遇和工作场所体验质量的探讨
AI.theoretical_framework: 议价能力理论：自动化降低企业对人工劳动的依赖，增强企业相对于员工的议价能力，从而减少投资于劳资关系的激励
AI.method: 实证研究，分析自动化程度与员工待遇多个维度（CSR评分、企业文化、劳动权利违规、员工评价等）的关联性，并考察行业特征、劳动力市场条件等调节因素
AI.findings: 自动化程度越高，员工待遇越差，包括：员工相关CSR评分降低、企业文化恶化、更多将员工视为成本、劳动权利违规增加、员工对高层领导和工作生活平衡的评价更负面。这些负面效应在常规密集型行业、工人外部选择较少（高失业率或劳动力市场集中度高）以及电价较低的年份更强
AI.theory_contributions: 将自动化研究从就业数量扩展到员工待遇质量，提出并验证了自动化通过增强企业议价能力影响劳资关系的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者和企业管理者：自动化不仅影响就业数量，还会恶化员工待遇和工作体验，需要相应政策干预和人力资源管理策略调整

title: Authenticity-Driven Motivations in Oligopoly: Efforts, Pricing, and Welfare
affiliations: University of Ottawa and University of Texas Rio Grande Valley (UTRGV) (Formerly University of Texas-Pan American) - Economics and Finance

detail.title: Authenticity-Driven Motivations in Oligopoly: Efforts, Pricing, and Welfare
detail.abstract: We develop an oligopoly theory of brand authenticity as a belief-based credence attribute valued by only a subset of consumers. Firms choose prices and costly authenticity efforts, while managers may derive private non-pecuniary benefits from being perceived as intrinsically motivated. Heterogeneity in consumer preferences and managerial motivations jointly determines equilibrium authenticity provision, pricing, and consumer sorting. Firms led by more authenticity-driven managers invest more and, under standard complementarity conditions, charge price premia. Authenticity is privately unsustainable when the attentive audience is small, viable when it is large, and fragile at intermediate sizes. In this fragile region, laissez-faire equilibrium exhibits inefficient exit despite socially valuable participation, reflecting an extensive-margin inefficiency that can be addressed by participation support or belief-based certification.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个品牌真实性的寡头垄断理论，将真实性视为一种基于信念的信任属性，只有部分消费者重视。企业选择价格和成本高昂的真实性投入，而管理者可能从被感知为内在动机中获得私人非金钱收益。消费者偏好和管理者动机的异质性共同决定了均衡的真实性提供、定价和消费者分类。
AI.research_question: 在消费者偏好和管理者动机异质性的情况下，品牌真实性如何在寡头垄断市场中均衡提供？企业如何定价？消费者如何分类？真实性在什么市场条件下可持续？
AI.motivation: 品牌真实性在营销和管理中日益重要，但缺乏正式的经济理论框架来解释企业如何投资真实性、消费者如何评估真实性，以及管理者内在动机如何影响企业决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头垄断理论、品牌真实性作为信念基础的信任属性、消费者异质性偏好、管理者非金钱收益（内在动机）、博弈论均衡分析。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建寡头垄断模型，企业选择价格和真实性投入，管理者有内在动机收益，消费者有异质性偏好。分析均衡条件、市场结构对真实性可持续性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 由更注重真实性的管理者领导的企业投资更多，在标准互补条件下收取价格溢价；2. 真实性在关注受众小时不可持续，大时可行，中等规模时脆弱；3. 在脆弱区域，自由放任均衡出现低效退出，尽管社会价值参与存在；4. 参与支持或基于信念的认证可以解决这种广泛边际低效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将品牌真实性正式建模为基于信念的信任属性；2. 整合消费者偏好和管理者动机异质性；3. 识别真实性可持续性的市场条件；4. 揭示自由放任均衡中的广泛边际低效；5. 提出政策干预的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助企业理解何时投资真实性有利可图；2. 指导管理者平衡内在动机与商业利益；3. 为政策制定者提供干预依据（如认证计划）；4. 帮助消费者识别真正注重真实性的品牌。

title: Forward-Guidance Surprises and the VIX on FOMC Days: Evidence from the USMPD with Finite-Sample Inference
affiliations: UNIST, School of Business Administration

detail.title: Forward-Guidance Surprises and the VIX on FOMC Days: Evidence from the USMPD with Finite-Sample Inference

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available, de-identified secondary data and does not involve human participants. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently by the author and received no external funding from public, commercial, or non-profit sources.

detail.abstract: Using the U.S. Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (USMPD) and daily close data for the Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), we study how distinct components of monetary policy news affect option-implied market uncertainty on Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) event days. In regressions of the close-to-close change in log VIX with lagged state controls, forward-guidance (path) surprises are strongly associated with the VIX response, while current-meeting (target) surprises are not. To address small-sample concerns inherent to event-day designs, we complement HC1 robust inference with nullimposed studentized wild bootstrap and permutation-based randomization inference. Overall, the evidence highlights forward-guidance news as a key driver of option-implied uncertainty around monetary policy announcements and underscores the importance of finite-sample inference choices in event-day studies.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国货币政策事件研究数据库和VIX指数数据，分析货币政策新闻的不同组成部分如何影响FOMC事件日的期权隐含市场不确定性。研究发现前瞻指引（路径）意外对VIX反应有显著影响，而当前会议（目标）意外则无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 货币政策新闻的不同组成部分（前瞻指引意外vs当前会议意外）如何影响FOMC事件日的期权隐含市场不确定性？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策公告如何影响市场不确定性对于政策制定者和市场参与者都很重要，但现有研究较少区分货币政策新闻的不同组成部分对期权隐含不确定性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导机制理论，特别是前瞻指引对市场预期形成的影响，以及期权定价理论中隐含波动率反映市场不确定性的机制。
AI.method: 使用美国货币政策事件研究数据库和VIX指数日度收盘数据，通过回归分析研究FOMC事件日VIX对数变化与货币政策意外之间的关系。采用HC1稳健推断、零约束学生化wild bootstrap和基于排列的随机化推断来解决小样本问题。
AI.findings: 前瞻指引（路径）意外与VIX反应显著相关，而当前会议（目标）意外则不显著。这表明前瞻指引新闻是货币政策公告周围期权隐含不确定性的关键驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）区分了货币政策新闻不同组成部分对市场不确定性的异质性影响；2）强调了事件日研究中有限样本推断方法选择的重要性；3）深化了对货币政策传导机制中前瞻指引作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了关于不同货币政策沟通方式对市场不确定性影响的实证证据；2）帮助市场参与者更好地理解和预测货币政策公告对波动率的影响；3）为事件研究提供了改进的小样本推断方法参考。

title: Before Judgment, There Must be Structure: Fiscal Epistemology and the Conditions of Institutional Knowledge

detail.title: Before Judgment, There Must be Structure: Fiscal Epistemology and the Conditions of Institutional Knowledge
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the upstream conditions of institutional judgment: what qualifies as evidence, how information becomes decision-grade, and how judgment acquires institutional legitimacy. Its central claim is that judgment is not the starting point of institutional action. Judgment becomes possible only after heterogeneous materials are rendered into structured objects under admissible rules—objects that are traceable, reviewable, and bound to responsibility.

The paper advances Fiscal Epistemology as a theoretical frame for this domain, defining institutional knowledge through evidence discipline rather than narrative persuasion. It specifies how visibility, admissibility, and closure operate as preconditions of judgment, and why institutional coherence depends on maintaining this ordering. Fiscal Geometry (FG) is positioned as a praxis background—a representational craft for making institutional tension structurally readable—named but not developed as a method.

The contribution is intentionally upstream. Rather than predicting institutional collapse or engaging motive- or intent-based debates, the paper defines the conditions under which institutional judgment remains coherent, inspectable, and reviewable in information-dense environments. In this sense, it offers an interdisciplinary interface language: it distinguishes what narrative can explain from what institutions can process, and clarifies the threshold at which information becomes executable within accountable procedures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"财政认识论"理论框架，探讨制度判断的上游条件：信息如何成为可接受的证据，判断如何获得制度合法性。核心观点是判断并非制度行动的起点，只有在异质材料按照可接受规则转化为结构化、可追溯、可审查、责任明确的对象后，判断才成为可能。
AI.research_question: 制度判断的上游条件是什么？什么构成证据，信息如何成为决策级信息，判断如何获得制度合法性？
AI.motivation: 在信息密集环境中，需要理解制度判断如何保持连贯性、可检查和可审查性，而不是预测制度崩溃或参与动机/意图辩论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政认识论：将制度知识定义为通过证据纪律而非叙事说服。财政几何学作为实践背景，使制度张力在结构上可读。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，未开发具体方法。通过理论构建和概念分析探讨制度判断的条件。
AI.findings: 可见性、可接受性和闭合性是判断的前提条件。制度连贯性依赖于维持这种秩序。判断只有在异质材料转化为结构化、可追溯、可审查、责任明确的对象后才成为可能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出财政认识论理论框架，区分叙事能解释的内容与制度能处理的内容。阐明信息在可问责程序中变得可执行的阈值。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供跨学科接口语言，帮助理解制度判断的连贯性条件。为信息密集环境中的制度决策提供概念工具。

title: Dynamic Correlations vs. Orthogonal Factors: Hedging Effectiveness across Global Equities, Cryptocurrencies, and Commodities
affiliations: Lovely Professional University

detail.title: Dynamic Correlations vs. Orthogonal Factors: Hedging Effectiveness across Global Equities, Cryptocurrencies, and Commodities
detail.abstract: The financial regime spanning the post-pandemic recovery and the subsequent global monetary tightening cycle has rigorously tested the diversification properties of digital assets. While correlations between digital assets and global equities have intensified during this period of liquidity contraction, this study re-evaluates their strategic role within a trivariate portfolio anchored by commodities. We address the limitations of standard Gaussian frameworks by contrasting the Dynamic Conditional Correlation (DCC-GARCH) model against the Generalized Orthogonal GARCH (GO-GARCH) model to capture time-varying dependencies and structural risk drivers. To evaluate risk management efficacy, the study constructs Equal-Weighted, Maximum Diversification, and Minimum Variance Portfolios (MVP), with the optimization framework permitting short selling to explicitly manage volatility transmission. Empirical results demonstrate that the Maximum Diversification Portfolio fails to mitigate risk, yielding negative hedging effectiveness due to forced exposure to idiosyncratic volatility. Conversely, the Minimum Variance Portfolio delivers superior performance across all specifications. Crucially, the analysis identifies commodities as a vital volatility absorber, stabilizing the portfolio against the heightened correlation between equities and digital assets. These findings confirm that while digital asset risks have evolved, dynamic hedging strategies utilizing factor-based models and commodity integration can effectively enhance portfolio resilience during regime shifts.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了在后疫情复苏和全球货币紧缩周期中，数字资产在包含大宗商品的三元投资组合中的战略作用。研究发现最小方差投资组合表现最优，大宗商品能有效吸收波动，而最大分散化投资组合因被迫暴露于特质波动而表现不佳。
AI.research_question: 在后疫情复苏和全球货币紧缩周期中，数字资产在包含大宗商品的三元投资组合中能否提供有效的风险分散？哪种投资组合策略（等权重、最大分散化、最小方差）在动态风险环境下表现最优？
AI.motivation: 后疫情复苏和全球货币紧缩周期对数字资产的分散化特性提出了严峻考验。数字资产与全球股票的相关性在流动性收缩期间加剧，需要重新评估其在包含大宗商品的投资组合中的战略作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态条件相关模型（DCC-GARCH）与广义正交GARCH模型（GO-GARCH）对比，用于捕捉时变依赖性和结构性风险驱动因素。投资组合理论，包括等权重、最大分散化和最小方差投资组合策略。
AI.method: 使用DCC-GARCH和GO-GARCH模型对比标准高斯框架的局限性，构建等权重、最大分散化和最小方差投资组合，优化框架允许卖空以明确管理波动传导。
AI.findings: 最大分散化投资组合无法缓解风险，产生负对冲效果（因被迫暴露于特质波动）。最小方差投资组合在所有规格中表现最优。大宗商品是关键的波动吸收器，能稳定投资组合以应对股票和数字资产之间增强的相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实数字资产风险已演变，但基于因子的动态对冲策略和大宗商品整合能有效增强投资组合在制度转变期间的韧性。为数字资产在多元投资组合中的战略定位提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了实用的投资组合构建建议：优先采用最小方差策略而非最大分散化策略，强调大宗商品在吸收波动中的关键作用，建议使用动态对冲策略和因子模型来管理数字资产风险。

publicationDetails.detailsText: George Mason University Legal Studies Research Paper Series, 26-03

detail.abstract: Since 2019, over 200 of my former students secured federal judicial clerkships. Over sixty Scalia Law graduates will commence federal clerkships from 2025-28, and we secured four U.S. Supreme Court clerkships through the 2022-26 terms. During the 2024-25 term, Scalia Law had over seventy graduates clerking for judges across the country, including thirty-two on federal courts, with fifteen of them on the U.S. Courts of Appeals and one on the U.S. Supreme Court. Because Scalia Law graduates only around 130 students per year, it’s one of the top law schools in the country for clerkships by percentage of class. And that certainly applies if you want to clerk for a judge appointed by President Donald J. Trump—trust me. That said, I’d like to bury three myths about clerkships that I hear from students every year—but never seem to die.

AI.tldr: 该论文旨在破除关于联邦司法助理职位的三个常见迷思，基于作者在斯卡利亚法学院指导学生获得助理职位的丰富经验。
AI.research_question: 关于联邦司法助理职位存在哪些常见的迷思？这些迷思为何持续存在？如何基于实际数据破除这些迷思？
AI.motivation: 作者观察到每年都有学生持有关于司法助理职位的错误观念，这些迷思似乎永远不会消失，影响了学生对职业发展的正确认知和规划。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业发展理论、法律教育评估框架，以及司法助理选拔的实证研究基础。
AI.method: 采用经验分析法，基于作者指导超过200名学生获得联邦司法助理职位的实际数据，结合斯卡利亚法学院的具体案例（如2024-25学年70多名毕业生担任助理的数据）。
AI.findings: 斯卡利亚法学院在司法助理职位方面表现优异：2019年以来200多名毕业生获得联邦助理职位；2025-28年将有60多名毕业生开始联邦助理工作；2022-26年获得4个最高法院助理职位；2024-25学年有70多名毕业生在全国担任助理，其中32人在联邦法院，15人在上诉法院，1人在最高法院。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于司法助理职位选拔的传统观念，提供了基于实证的职业发展理论框架，揭示了法学院在司法助理培养方面的成功因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学生提供了准确的职业规划指导，帮助破除关于助理职位的迷思；为法学院提供了提升学生司法助理就业率的实践策略；展示了斯卡利亚法学院的成功模式可供其他法学院参考。

title: The Meaning-to-Action Gap in Institutional Documents
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Meaning-to-Action Gap in Institutional Documents

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research, analysis, or interpretation of the findings presented in this working paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved voluntary participation by individual practitioners and volunteers operating in a personal, non-institutional capacity. No identifiable personal data or real client documents were collected or processed. All materials used were anonymized or example documents. Participants were informed of the study’s purpose and provided verbal consent prior to participation. Formal institutional ethics review was not required for this exploratory, minimal-risk pilot.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive funding from any public, private, or nonprofit organization.

detail.abstract: High-stakes institutional documents such as immigration notices, benefits letters, school compliance communications, and legal correspondence often fail non-expert readers not only through language barriers but through a "meaning-to-action" gap. Recipients may translate words yet still misunderstand obligations, deadlines, and risk. This paper presents an exploratory qualitative study examining practitioner trust boundaries and perceived failure modes in AI-assisted document interpretation. Ten participants, including legal, educational, and nonprofit support practitioners from the United States, Costa Rica, El Salvador, and Portugal, completed a baseline interview, five daily micro-checks over a five-day pilot use period, and an end-of-week interview while interacting with an AI-based document interpretation system. Using reflexive thematic analysis, recurring patterns were identified in which institutional documents obscure consequential risk, AI outputs are accepted as interpretive scaffolding, and legally, financially, or institutionally binding actions are consistently deferred to human judgment. These findings are synthesized into a governance-oriented design framework, Explain, Flag, Defer, which proposes uncertainty-aware risk surfacing, explicit non-advisory constraints, and audit-support features to support responsible deployment. Findings reflect practitioner perceptions in a personal capacity and should be interpreted as exploratory indicators of trust, risk perception, and workflow alignment rather than evidence of institutional adoption or end-user outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过质性探索分析，发现AI辅助文件解读系统在实践中存在"意义到行动"的鸿沟，即使翻译了文字，用户仍可能误解义务、期限和风险。研究提出了Explain, Flag, Defer治理框架来支持负责任部署。
AI.research_question: AI辅助文件解读系统中，从业者的信任边界和感知失败模式是什么？如何设计治理框架来支持负责任部署？
AI.motivation: 移民通知、福利信件、学校合规通信和法律信函等高风险机构文件不仅存在语言障碍，还存在"意义到行动"的鸿沟，即使翻译了文字，收件人仍可能误解义务、期限和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任边界理论、风险感知理论、人机协作框架、不确定性管理理论
AI.method: 探索性质性研究，采用反思性主题分析。10名来自美国、哥斯达黎加、萨尔瓦多和葡萄牙的法律、教育和非营利支持从业者参与，包括基线访谈、5天试点使用期间的每日微检查、周终访谈。
AI.findings: 1) 机构文件常常掩盖重要风险；2) AI输出被接受为解释性支架；3) 法律、财务或制度约束性行动始终被推迟到人类判断；4) 从业者在个人能力范围内对AI系统持谨慎态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Explain, Flag, Defer治理框架，包含不确定性意识风险呈现、明确的非咨询约束和审计支持功能，为AI辅助文件解读系统的信任建立和风险管理提供理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计者提供了具体的治理框架，帮助他们在高风险文件解读场景中设计更负责任的系统，平衡自动化效率和人类判断需求。

title: The Failed Gambit: How U.S. Engagement Policy Forged a Rival in China
affiliations: The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda

detail.title: The Failed Gambit: How U.S. Engagement Policy Forged a Rival in China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports no conflicts of interest related to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or primary data collection. It is based exclusively on secondary data and publicly available sources; therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was conducted without external financial support and was fully self-funded by the author.This study did not involve human participants, patients, or primary data collection. It is based exclusively on secondary data and publicly available sources; therefore, ethical approval was not required.

detail.abstract: The research paper will look at the evolution of the economic relation between the U.S. and China in the 21st century into one of strategic conflict. It will claim that the move can be attributed to an ineffective U.S engagement policy after the 2001 admission of China into the WTO which hinged on the promise that political liberalization would follow integration into the spheres of the economy. This strategy backfired by enhancing the state-directed economic practice in China coupled with the "China Shock" which led to the elimination of several millions of manufacturing jobs in the United States through foreign imports. The analysis shall follow the unresolved tensions generated by intellectual property theft and involuntary technology transfer, the ambitions of industrialization that China hopes to meet with its Made in China 2025 plan, and how they precondition confrontation. Then the paper will divide into dissecting two main conflicts. To begin with, 2017-2018 Tariff War will be reviewed as a paradigm shift towards direct economic pressure that triggered the shift to the supply chain diversion instead of mass reshoring in the U.S. Second, a hypothetical Tariff War in the year 2025 by scrambling the events and taking it a step further in terms of intensity such as the U.S assuming emergency powers and China engaging Toronto Bio in an asymmetric response using Chinese control of rare earth minerals. The paper will also address the development of the rivalry that has moved past tariffs to constitute a Chip War of technological dominance over each other and is compelling a world of supply chain modification to a China+1 approach based on geopolitical could-resilience. In conclusion, the paper will present that it is structural conflict which is anchored on incompatible economic and political systems of the two nations. This relationship has greatly emasculated the rules-based international order especially to the WTO. The probable future does not lie in a total economic divorce, rather an age of lasting, controlled rivalry which will remain to reconstitute the worldwide economy. The angle of dedollarization & rise of BRICS will also be explored in this paper.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析21世纪美中经济关系如何演变为战略冲突，认为美国2001年后的接触政策失败，反而强化了中国国家主导的经济模式并导致"中国冲击"，造成美国制造业就业流失。论文探讨知识产权盗窃、技术转让、中国制造2025计划等紧张点，分析2017-2018关税战和假设的2025年升级冲突，以及芯片战争和供应链重组。结论认为这是基于两国不相容经济政治体系的结构性冲突，将导致持久对抗而非完全脱钩。
AI.research_question: 21世纪美中经济关系如何以及为何从合作演变为战略冲突？这种演变对国际经济秩序和全球供应链有何影响？
AI.motivation: 美国2001年支持中国加入WTO的接触政策未能实现预期的政治自由化，反而强化了中国国家主导的经济模式，并导致"中国冲击"造成美国制造业就业流失。这种政策失败促使两国关系转向战略冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 战略冲突理论：分析大国经济关系如何从合作转向对抗
2. 经济安全理论：探讨经济政策如何成为国家安全工具
3. 供应链韧性理论：分析地缘政治如何推动供应链重组
4. 国际秩序理论：研究基于规则的秩序如何受到大国竞争侵蚀
AI.method:
1. 历史分析：追溯2001年WTO入世后美中关系演变
2. 案例研究：深入分析2017-2018关税战
3. 情景分析：构建2025年假设性关税战升级情景
4. 政策分析：评估知识产权、技术转让、中国制造2025等政策冲突
AI.findings:
1. 美国接触政策失败：未能实现政治自由化，反而强化了中国国家资本主义
2. "中国冲击"效应：导致美国数百万制造业就业流失
3. 冲突升级路径：从关税战到芯片战争，再到供应链重组
4. 结构性冲突根源：两国不相容的经济政治体系
5. 国际秩序侵蚀：WTO等基于规则的秩序受到严重削弱
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"接触政策失败-战略冲突"理论框架
2. 发展大国经济冲突的阶段性升级理论
3. 构建供应链地缘政治化的分析模型
4. 深化结构性冲突与国际秩序互动理论

reference: Bratislava Law Review, volume 9, issue 2, 2025[10.46282/blr.2025.9.2.1193]
title: CJEU: INGSTEEL II (CASE C-547/22): Compensation for Lost Opportunity -A Pivotal Judgment That Changes Little

detail.title: CJEU: INGSTEEL II (CASE C-547/22): Compensation for Lost Opportunity -A Pivotal Judgment That Changes Little

declarations.funderStatement: This paper was supported by the Scientific Grant Agency Ministry of Education, Science, Research and Youth of the Slovak Republic and Slovak Academy of Sciences (VEGA) within the project 1/0710/23 “Damages in competition law and public procurement - limits and challenges to effective enforcement of the European Union law”.

detail.abstract: The judgment of the Court of Justice of the European Union in INGSTEEL II (case C-547/22) appears, at first glance, to mark a significant step in the development of damages remedies for breaches of EU public procurement law, by precluding national legislation or practice that categorically excludes compensation for harm resulting from the loss of an opportunity to obtain a public contract. This commentary argues, however, that the judgment is less transformative than it initially seems. Although the Court confirmed that loss of opportunity cannot be excluded as a matter of principle from the scope of Article 2(1)(c) of the Remedies Directive, it neither recognised loss of opportunity as an autonomous head of damage under EU law nor clarified its content, conditions, or quantification. The paper situates INGSTEEL II within the broader context of the Remedies Directive's minimal harmonisation, the Court's fragmented case law on damages (including Commission v Portugal, Strabag, Spijker, and the Fosen-Linjen saga), and the tension between EU-level effectiveness requirements and Member States' procedural autonomy. Particular attention is paid to the Slovak legal context underlying the reference, revealing that the judgment does not substantially alter Slovak law, which already allows-at least in theory-compensation for loss of opportunity within the concept of lost profit. The analysis demonstrates that INGSTEEL II employs a "doublenegative" approach: rather than defining compensable harm, the Court merely prohibits its absolute exclusion. As a result, key issuessuch as causation, evidentiary standards, and damages in the context of framework agreements-remain unresolved and are left to national law. The commentary concludes that judicial harmonisation through case law cannot provide a coherent or comprehensive system of compensation for unlawfully excluded tenderers and argues that meaningful clarification requires legislative reform of the Remedies Directive, potentially inspired by the structure of Directive 2014/104/EU on antitrust damages.

AI.tldr: 本文分析欧盟法院INGSTEEL II判决，认为该判决虽禁止成员国绝对排除"机会损失"赔偿，但未将其确立为欧盟法下的独立损害类型，也未明确其内容、条件或量化标准，实际变革有限。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法院INGSTEEL II判决在多大程度上改变了欧盟公共采购法中的损害赔偿救济制度？
AI.motivation: INGSTEEL II判决表面上看似在欧盟公共采购法损害赔偿救济方面迈出重要一步，但需要深入分析其实际影响和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟救济指令的最低限度协调原则、欧盟层面有效性要求与成员国程序自主权之间的张力、欧盟法院碎片化的判例法（包括Commission v Portugal, Strabag, Spijker和Fosen-Linjen系列案件）。
AI.method: 法律分析和评论方法，将INGSTEEL II判决置于欧盟救济指令和判例法的更广泛背景下分析，特别关注斯洛伐克法律背景。
AI.findings: INGSTEEL II判决采用"双重否定"方法：仅禁止绝对排除机会损失赔偿，但未将其确立为欧盟法下的独立损害类型，也未明确其内容、条件或量化标准。判决未实质性改变斯洛伐克法律，关键问题如因果关系、证据标准和框架协议下的损害赔偿仍悬而未决。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了欧盟法院通过判例法进行司法协调的局限性，无法为被非法排除的投标人提供连贯全面的赔偿体系。论证了需要立法改革而非司法协调来实现有意义的澄清。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出INGSTEEL II判决实际变革有限，建议借鉴反垄断损害赔偿指令（2014/104/EU）的结构对救济指令进行立法改革，以提供更明确的赔偿框架。

title: Public Debt Management and Tax Policy Interactions
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Public Debt Management and Tax Policy Interactions
detail.abstract:
This study examines the interactions between public debt management and tax policy, focusing on how coordinated strategies can enhance fiscal stability and mitigate financial risks. Employing a mixed-methods approach, the research integrates an extensive literature review, comparative case studies of selected economies, and quantitative analysis of key debt and tax indicators. The findings indicate that effective public debt management, including optimal debt structuring and strategic borrowing, significantly contributes to fiscal resilience. Moreover, alignment with tax policy through measures such as revenue mobilization, progressive taxation, and efficient tax administration amplifies these benefits by reducing the likelihood of fiscal stress and enhancing government capacity to meet debt obligations. 
The analysis also reveals that uncoordinated debt and tax policies may exacerbate budgetary vulnerabilities, particularly in developing economies with constrained fiscal space. Based on these insights, the study recommends that policymakers adopt integrated frameworks where debt issuance strategies are closely aligned with tax policy objectives, supported by transparent reporting and monitoring mechanisms. Such an approach can strengthen fiscal discipline, improve debt sustainability, and provide a stable foundation for long-term economic growth. The findings have practical implications for government agencies, financial regulators, and international development partners seeking to design policies that balance borrowing needs with sustainable revenue generation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了公共债务管理与税收政策之间的协调互动，发现两者有效协同能增强财政稳定性、降低金融风险，而不协调的政策则会加剧预算脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 公共债务管理与税收政策如何通过协调策略增强财政稳定性并缓解金融风险？
AI.motivation: 理解债务管理与税收政策之间的相互作用对于实现财政稳定和降低金融风险至关重要，特别是在发展中国家财政空间受限的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政政策协调理论、债务可持续性理论、税收政策与债务管理互动框架。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：包括广泛的文献综述、选定经济体的比较案例研究、关键债务和税收指标的定量分析。
AI.findings: 有效的公共债务管理（包括最优债务结构和战略借款）显著增强财政韧性；与税收政策协调（通过收入动员、累进税制和高效税收管理）能进一步放大这些效益，降低财政压力可能性，增强政府偿债能力；不协调的债务和税收政策会加剧预算脆弱性，特别是在财政空间受限的发展中经济体。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了债务管理与税收政策协调的理论框架，深化了对财政政策协同机制的理解，为债务可持续性理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者采用债务发行策略与税收政策目标紧密协调的综合框架，支持透明报告和监测机制；为政府机构、金融监管机构和国际发展伙伴设计平衡借款需求与可持续收入生成的政策提供实践指导。

reference: Journal of the History of Ideas in East Asia, (2), 2012
title: Turning Crisis into Opportunity: an Essay on the Cultural Preconditions of Contemporary Crisis Mentality through a Conceptual Analysis of Weiji

detail.title: Turning Crisis into Opportunity: an Essay on the Cultural Preconditions of Contemporary Crisis Mentality through a Conceptual Analysis of Weiji

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of the History of Ideas in East Asia, (2), 2012

detail.abstract: This study examines the cultural preconditions of a popular conception in contemporary societies characterized by the idea of turning crisis into opportunity. Building on Reinhart Koselleck’s thesis regarding the conceptual origins of modern crisis mentality in European cultures, this paper presents an analysis of the conceptual history of weiji 危機 (the Chinese word for “crisis”) in the Chinese cultural-historical context. The modern use of weiji originated in the late Qing reform movement, which saw the emergence of a discourse and widespread consciousness of Chinese nationalism. The proliferation of weiji-talk found in Chinese public press during the thirty-year period 1895-1925 was indicative of larger cultural transformations involving changes in the cultural conception of history. Within this context, the concept of weiji became drafted into ideologies of nationalism, republicanism, and Communism, the operation of which all depended on the new cultural mentality regarding the nature of historical change as linear and man-made. For this reason, the conceptual histories of “weiji” and “crisis” could be said to have converged during the 20th century on the basis of a deeper convergence of their underlying cultural conception of history. This convergence has provided an important cultural precondition for not only the pervasive idea of turning crisis into opportunity in contemporary societies but also the emergence and evolution of powerful ideologies including nationalism, communism, industrialism, capitalism, and scientism in modern China.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析中文"危机"概念在1895-1925年间的历史演变，探讨了现代危机观念的文化前提。研究发现，晚清改革运动中形成的"危机"话语与中国民族主义意识兴起相关，并被纳入民族主义、共和主义和共产主义意识形态，这些意识形态都基于线性、人为的历史变革观念。这种历史观念的趋同为当代社会"化危为机"的流行观念提供了文化前提。
AI.research_question: 中文"危机"概念在近代中国的历史演变如何反映了文化历史观念的转变，并为当代"化危为机"观念提供了文化前提？
AI.motivation: 基于Reinhart Koselleck关于现代危机观念在欧洲文化中起源的论点，研究中文"危机"概念在中国文化历史背景下的演变，以理解当代社会"化危为机"观念的文化前提。
AI.theoretical_framework: Reinhart Koselleck的概念史理论，特别是关于现代危机观念起源的论点；文化历史观念转变理论；意识形态与文化心态的关系理论。
AI.method: 概念史分析方法，通过分析1895-1925年间中国公共媒体中"危机"话语的演变，考察文化历史观念的转变。
AI.findings: 1. 现代"危机"概念起源于晚清改革运动，与中国民族主义意识的兴起相关；2. 1895-1925年间"危机"话语的扩散反映了文化历史观念的转变；3. "危机"概念被纳入民族主义、共和主义和共产主义意识形态；4. 这些意识形态都依赖于线性、人为的历史变革观念；5. 中文"危机"与英文"crisis"概念在20世纪基于历史观念的趋同而融合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了Koselleck的危机观念理论到中国语境；2. 揭示了概念演变与文化历史观念转变的关系；3. 提出了跨文化概念趋同的理论框架；4. 建立了意识形态与文化心态之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解当代中国"化危为机"观念的历史根源；2. 为分析现代中国意识形态（民族主义、共产主义等）的演变提供视角；3. 有助于跨文化比较研究；4. 为理解当代社会危机管理观念提供历史背景。

title: Institutional Analysis of Crossmatch-to-Transfusion Ratios at a Tertiary Hospital
affiliations: University of Ulsan - Asan Medical Center, University of Ulsan - Asan Medical Center and University of Ulsan - Asan Medical Center

detail.title: Institutional Analysis of Crossmatch-to-Transfusion Ratios at a Tertiary Hospital
detail.abstract: Background: Efficient blood utilization is increasingly essential in Korea due to increasing transfusion demand and a declining donor pool. The crossmatch-to-transfusion (C/T) ratio reflects ordering efficiency; however, long-term institutional-level analyses are rare. This study examined 10-year C/T ratio trends and blood utilization patterns at a major tertiary hospital.Methods: We retrospectively analyzed red blood cell usage at Asan Medical Center between 2015 and 2024. Annual data on transfused units, completed crossmatches, and canceled crossmatch requests were obtained from the institutional blood bank information system. The C/T ratio was calculated as crossmatched units divided by transfused units. Autologous transfusions, whole blood transfusions, and massive transfusion protocol activations were excluded. Trends were assessed by usage type (ward, surgery, outpatient, and emergency) and by department.Results: Annual transfused units ranged from 59,731 to 86,063, with institutional C/T ratios stable at 1.12–1.17. Surgical services exhibited the highest cumulative C/T ratio (1.55), whereas outpatient utilization exhibited the lowest (1.03). Ward and emergency services exhibited intermediate ratios (1.04 and 1.05, respectively), with gradual improvement over time. In 2024, most departments maintained efficient ratios of 1.02–1.10; higher ratios were observed in the Pediatric Surgery (1.52) and Vascular Surgery (1.33) departments.Conclusions: This decade-long study demonstrated efficient blood utilization with significant variation across clinical settings. These findings suggest that a single universal C/T ratio may be inappropriate; interpretation should consider specific operational context, particularly between surgical and nonsurgical services. These findings provide a foundation for multi-center studies to develop standardized transfusion efficiency metrics.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了韩国一家大型三级医院10年间（2015-2024年）的交叉配血/输血比率（C/T比率）趋势和血液利用模式，发现整体血液利用效率较高，但不同临床科室存在显著差异。
AI.research_question: 韩国主要三级医院在10年期间（2015-2024年）的交叉配血/输血比率（C/T比率）趋势和血液利用模式如何？不同临床科室和医疗环境下的血液利用效率有何差异？
AI.motivation: 韩国面临输血需求增加和献血者减少的双重压力，需要提高血液利用效率。C/T比率是衡量血液订购效率的重要指标，但缺乏长期机构层面的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交叉配血/输血比率（C/T比率）理论，该比率定义为交叉配血单位数除以输血单位数，是衡量血液订购效率和库存管理的重要指标。
AI.method: 回顾性分析2015-2024年间Asan医学中心的红细胞使用数据。从机构血库信息系统获取年度输血单位数、完成交叉配血数和取消交叉配血请求数。计算C/T比率，排除自体输血、全血输血和大规模输血方案激活病例。按使用类型（病房、手术、门诊、急诊）和科室分析趋势。
AI.findings: 年度输血单位数在59,731至86,063之间，机构C/T比率稳定在1.12-1.17。手术服务C/T比率最高（1.55），门诊最低（1.03）。病房和急诊服务比率中等（分别为1.04和1.05），随时间逐渐改善。2024年，大多数科室保持高效比率（1.02-1.10），但小儿外科（1.52）和血管外科（1.33）比率较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了单一通用C/T比率的适用性，强调血液利用效率评估需要考虑特定的临床操作环境，特别是在手术与非手术服务之间。为开发标准化的输血效率指标提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了长期机构层面的血液利用效率基准数据，帮助医院管理者识别效率较低的科室（如小儿外科和血管外科），为针对性改进措施提供依据。建议多中心研究以建立标准化输血效率指标。

title: National Smart Fuel Network: An IT-Driven Logistics Framework to Reduce Fuel Waste and Strengthen Energy Security

detail.title: National Smart Fuel Network: An IT-Driven Logistics Framework to Reduce Fuel Waste and Strengthen Energy Security
detail.abstract: Fuel supply chains remain vulnerable to blind spots between production, storage, and distribution nodes, especially during disruptions when fragmented data slows response and increases waste. This paper proposes the National Smart Fuel Network (NSFN), an interoperable, IT-driven framework that integrates IoT telemetry (including satellite-enabled connectivity for remote corridors), warehouse and transportation system integration (WMS/TMS), and decision-support analytics to improve in-transit visibility, inventory accuracy, and disruption management. Using publicly available indicators combined with scenario-based modeling, NSFN performance is compared against a baseline fragmented network. Across normal, moderate-disruption, and severe-disruption scenarios, the model indicates potential reductions in fuel waste of 36-40%, improvements in inventory accuracy to 96-98%, reductions in delivery delays of 40-50%, and response-time improvements of 30-35%. The paper contributes (1) a reference architecture for end-to-end fuel logistics observability, (2) a reproducible evaluation approach with clear metrics and sensitivity checks, and (3) governance and security considerations for trusted data sharing across stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出国家智能燃料网络（NSFN），一个整合物联网遥测、仓储运输系统集成和决策支持分析的互操作IT驱动框架，旨在解决燃料供应链中的盲点问题。通过场景建模，NSFN相比碎片化网络可减少燃料浪费36-40%，提高库存准确性至96-98%，减少交付延迟40-50%，改善响应时间30-35%。
AI.research_question: 如何通过IT驱动的互操作框架（NSFN）解决燃料供应链中生产、存储和分销节点之间的盲点问题，提高在途可见性、库存准确性和中断管理能力？
AI.motivation: 燃料供应链在中断期间存在脆弱性，碎片化数据导致响应缓慢和浪费增加，需要集成解决方案来提高供应链的韧性和效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链可见性理论、中断管理理论、物联网集成理论、决策支持系统理论
AI.method: 使用公开可用指标结合基于场景的建模方法，将NSFN性能与基线碎片化网络进行比较，涵盖正常、中度中断和严重中断三种场景。
AI.findings: NSFN在三种场景下表现出显著改进：燃料浪费减少36-40%，库存准确性提高至96-98%，交付延迟减少40-50%，响应时间改善30-35%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）端到端燃料物流可观测性的参考架构；2）具有明确指标和敏感性检查的可重复评估方法；3）跨利益相关者可信数据共享的治理和安全考虑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为燃料供应链管理者提供可实施的IT集成框架，显著改善运营效率、减少浪费、增强中断应对能力，为政策制定者提供数据共享治理和安全指南。

title: Generational Differences in the Workplace: A Critical Review and Evidence-Based Framework for Organizational Practice

detail.title: Generational Differences in the Workplace: A Critical Review and Evidence-Based Framework for Organizational Practice
detail.abstract: The concept of generational differences has become deeply embedded in organizational discourse, shaping human resource practices, leadership development programs, and workplace policies. This article provides a comprehensive critical review of the empirical literature on generational differences in workplace values, attitudes, and behaviors. Synthesizing evidence from meta-analyses, longitudinal studies, and cross-cultural research, we find that the prevailing narrative of distinct generational cohorts with fundamentally different work orientations is largely unsupported by rigorous empirical evidence. Effect sizes for generational differences are consistently small, typically explaining less than 2% of variance in workplace outcomes, while within-generation heterogeneity substantially exceeds between-generation differences. We critically examine the "digital native" construct and its application to younger workers, finding limited empirical support for claims of inherent technological superiority. We further address the cultural specificity of Western generational frameworks and their limited applicability in non-Western contexts. The article proposes a contextual contingency framework that reconceptualizes age-related workplace dynamics through the integration of lifespan development theory, career stage models, sociohistorical context analysis, and intersectional perspectives. We provide specific attention to Generation Z's workforce entry amid unprecedented circumstances and examine implications for remote and hybrid work arrangements. Practical implications for evidence-based management are discussed, including recommendations for replacing generation-based interventions with approaches grounded in individual differences, life stage considerations, and organizational context. A detailed methodological agenda for future research addresses the age-period-cohort identification problem and proposes specific designs for advancing knowledge in this domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性回顾了关于职场代际差异的实证研究，发现代际差异效应值很小（通常解释不到2%的方差），而代内异质性远大于代际差异。文章提出了情境权变框架，建议用基于个体差异、生命阶段和组织情境的方法替代代际干预。
AI.research_question: 职场价值观、态度和行为中的代际差异是否得到实证支持？代际差异的效应大小如何？如何更好地概念化年龄相关的职场动态？
AI.motivation: 代际差异概念已深深嵌入组织话语，影响人力资源管理实践、领导力发展项目和职场政策，但需要批判性评估其经验基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情境权变框架，整合了生命周期发展理论、职业阶段模型、社会历史背景分析和交叉视角。
AI.method: 对代际差异实证文献的全面批判性回顾，综合元分析、纵向研究和跨文化研究的证据。
AI.findings: 1. 代际差异效应值普遍很小，通常解释不到2%的方差；2. 代内异质性远大于代际差异；3. "数字原生代"概念缺乏实证支持；4. 西方代际框架在非西方情境中适用性有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了代际差异的主流叙事；2. 提出了替代性的情境权变框架；3. 整合了多种理论视角；4. 为未来研究提供了方法论议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议用基于个体差异、生命阶段和组织情境的方法替代代际干预；2. 为Z世代进入职场提供具体建议；3. 对远程和混合工作安排的影响分析；4. 推动循证管理实践。

title: Increasing Resiliency of Critical Infrastructure Supply Chains: An IT-Driven Framework for Visibility, Buffering, and Rapid Recovery

detail.title: Increasing Resiliency of Critical Infrastructure Supply Chains: An IT-Driven Framework for Visibility, Buffering, and Rapid Recovery
detail.abstract: Critical-infrastructure supply chains that move food, medical supplies, fuel, and other essential goods are vulnerable to cascading failures when demand spikes, transportation capacity tightens, and information is fragmented across nodes. This paper proposes a practical resiliency framework that combines multi-node network design, adaptive inventory buffers, and a shared visibility and risk layer integrating WMS/TMS signals, IoT events, and early-warning indicators. The framework supports proactive disruption detection, coordinated allocation during shortages, and faster recovery through dynamic routing, pre-positioning, and cross-node replenishment policies. We present a reference architecture, an implementation blueprint for operators and public-private partners, and an evaluation approach using measurable outcomes such as service continuity, recovery time, stockout duration, and buffer efficiency. The proposed approach emphasizes interoperability, governance, and security so that heterogeneous actors can collaborate without centralizing sensitive commercial data. The result is a scalable blueprint for improving continuity of essential-goods distribution during natural hazards, labor constraints, cyber incidents, and other high-impact disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合多节点网络设计、自适应库存缓冲和共享可见性与风险层的实用韧性框架，以应对关键基础设施供应链在需求激增、运输能力紧张和信息碎片化时的级联故障风险。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个实用的韧性框架来增强关键基础设施供应链（食品、医疗用品、燃料等）在面对需求激增、运输能力紧张和信息碎片化时的抗干扰能力？
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施供应链在自然灾害、劳动力限制、网络事件等高影响干扰下容易发生级联故障，而现有系统缺乏有效的协调机制、可见性不足，且信息分散在不同节点之间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链韧性理论、网络设计理论、库存缓冲理论、信息共享与协作理论、风险预警理论。
AI.method: 提出一个结合多节点网络设计、自适应库存缓冲和共享可见性与风险层的框架，包括参考架构、实施蓝图和评估方法，使用服务连续性、恢复时间、缺货持续时间和缓冲效率等可衡量结果进行评估。
AI.findings: 提出的框架能够支持主动干扰检测、短缺期间的协调分配，并通过动态路由、预定位和跨节点补货策略实现更快恢复，同时确保互操作性、治理和安全性。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了供应链韧性框架的理论基础，整合了网络设计、库存管理和信息共享等多个理论维度，提出了一个可扩展的韧性蓝图理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为运营商和公私合作伙伴提供了具体的实施蓝图和参考架构，强调互操作性、治理和安全性，使异构参与者能够在不集中敏感商业数据的情况下协作，提高基本商品分配的连续性。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Sustainable Freight Distribution and Energy Supply
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Sustainable Freight Distribution and Energy Supply

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or animal subjects; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The paper is supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. 251735.

detail.abstract: Transitioning heavy-duty freight to low-carbon energy requires synchronized expansion of renewable electricity, green-hydrogen supply, and zero-emission vehicle (ZEV) fleets. This study introduces a stochastic multi-agent optimization framework to study market-based interaction outcomes of freight systems. The proposed framework links long-term infrastructure investments with short-term operational decisions for decentralized renewable generators, conventional plants, freight distributors, and mixed battery electric vehicles (BEV) and fuel cell electric vehicle (FCEV) fleets. A Texas case study illustrates system interactions across major freight corridors and highlights the roles of existing generator capacity, solar resources availability, and strategic investment of solar panels and electrolysis. Comparing the decentralized equilibrium with a centralized planner shows that the centralized planner invests substantially more in solar and hydrogen to reduce charging congestion and balance energy across hubs. Sensitivity analyses show that green hydrogen plays its largest role when conventional generation capacity is tight and renewable costs are low, whereas high conventional generation capacity shifts the system toward BEV charging. These interconnected findings highlight the importance of jointly considering resource availability, energy infrastructure, and freight technologies when designing targeted policies to steer decentralized markets toward long-term decarbonization goals.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个随机多智能体优化框架，分析重型货运向低碳能源转型的市场互动，通过德州案例研究揭示了太阳能、氢能和电动汽车基础设施投资的协同关系。
AI.research_question: 在重型货运向低碳能源转型过程中，如何通过市场机制协调可再生能源发电、绿氢供应和零排放车辆基础设施的投资与运营决策？
AI.motivation: 重型货运脱碳需要同步扩展可再生能源发电、绿氢供应和零排放车辆车队，但现有研究缺乏对市场参与者分散决策下系统互动结果的分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多智能体系统和博弈论框架，结合随机优化理论，分析分散市场参与者的长期投资和短期运营决策互动。
AI.method: 开发随机多智能体优化框架，将长期基础设施投资与短期运营决策相连接，应用于德州主要货运走廊案例研究，比较分散均衡与集中规划结果。
AI.findings: 集中规划者比分散市场投资更多太阳能和氢能以缓解充电拥堵和平衡能源枢纽；绿氢在传统发电容量紧张且可再生能源成本低时作用最大；高传统发电容量使系统偏向BEV充电。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析货运脱碳系统市场互动的随机多智能体优化框架，为理解分散决策下的基础设施协同投资提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了设计针对性政策的依据，强调需要综合考虑资源可用性、能源基础设施和货运技术，引导分散市场实现长期脱碳目标。

title: The Window Is Closing: How Canada Can Shape the Future of Stablecoins and Digital Payments

detail.title: The Window Is Closing: How Canada Can Shape the Future of Stablecoins and Digital Payments

declarations.funderStatement: Several organizations provided grants in support of the completion of this project. The C.D. Howe Institute (CDHI) operates under a strict Independence and Non-Partisanship policy. CDHI requires all funding partners to agree that any contribution does not and shall not, in any way, compromise the CDHI’s Mission Statement, nor constrain CDHI’s academic freedom and editorial independence; They must also agree that any research undertaken by CDHI does not stipulate a predetermined result, nor shall it inhibit the independence of CDHI’s staff and authors to pursue scholarly research and disseminate the results of this research.

detail.abstract:
• The rise of US dollar-linked stablecoins – digital tokens designed to maintain a constant one-for-one value with the US dollar – following the 2025 GENIUS Act poses potential risks to Canada’s monetary sovereignty and payment-system oversight. Without a clear domestic framework, Canadian payments could increasingly migrate to foreign-issued stablecoins and exchange platforms, weakening regulatory control and complicating monetary policy transmission.
  • Canada’s Stablecoin Act is a necessary first step but leaves critical design choices to the implementation phase. While the Act designates the Bank of Canada as the primary regulator and establishes baseline requirements for reserves and redemption, detailed rules on eligible assets, operational standards, insolvency treatment, and coordination with securities regulators remain unresolved.
  • This Commentary recommends a two-track regulatory model that aligns regulation with economic function rather than technology, giving Canada a viable path to shape its payments future rather than default to foreign stablecoin standards. Pure payment stablecoins should operate under Bank of Canada oversight as fully backed payment instruments, while tokenized bank deposits should remain within existing prudential banking regulatory frameworks. This approach promotes innovation while preserving financial stability and consumer protection.
  • Integrating stablecoins with a central bank digital currency (CBDC) could strengthen competition, resilience, and interoperability, and position Canada to compete effectively in the digital payments revolution. A CBDC, at minimum in wholesale form, would provide a neutral settlement layer, support orderly redemptions through central bank liquidity access, and enhance Canada’s ability to pursue international equivalency agreements while maintaining control over domestic payment infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美元稳定币对加拿大货币主权和支付系统监管的潜在风险，评估了加拿大《稳定币法案》的不足，并提出双轨监管模式和CBDC整合建议，以维护金融稳定和消费者保护。
AI.research_question: 加拿大应如何监管稳定币以应对美元稳定币带来的货币主权和支付系统风险，同时促进创新和金融稳定？
AI.motivation: 2025年《GENIUS法案》后美元稳定币的兴起对加拿大的货币主权和支付系统监管构成潜在风险，加拿大《稳定币法案》作为初步应对措施存在关键设计缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济功能而非技术的监管对齐理论、双轨监管模型、CBDC作为中立结算层的理论框架。
AI.method: 政策分析、监管框架评估、比较分析（基于经济功能vs技术）、政策建议制定。
AI.findings: 1) 美元稳定币可能导致加拿大支付系统向外国平台迁移，削弱监管控制和货币政策传导；2) 加拿大《稳定币法案》虽指定央行为主要监管机构，但在合格资产、运营标准、破产处理等关键细节上存在不足；3) 双轨监管模式（纯支付稳定币由央行监管，代币化银行存款由现有银行监管框架管理）是可行路径；4) CBDC整合可增强竞争、韧性和互操作性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于经济功能而非技术的稳定币监管理论框架，发展了双轨监管模型，论证了CBDC作为中立结算层在稳定币生态系统中的理论作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大监管机构提供了具体的政策建议：实施双轨监管模式，推进CBDC发展（至少批发形式），制定详细的合格资产和运营标准，加强与国际监管协调，维护国内支付基础设施控制权。

title: Express Charging Lanes for Electric Vehicle Evacuation
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: Express Charging Lanes for Electric Vehicle Evacuation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: The paper is supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. 2521735.

detail.abstract: The long-distance evacuation of electric vehicles (EVs) presents significant challenges for disaster management due to their limited driving range and constrained charging infrastructure. EVs with long charging times can create negative externalities for all other EVs waiting in queues, especially during evacuation scenarios. This study investigates the use of express charging lanes to reduce overall evacuation delays. We propose optimization models to optimize the allocation of charging plugs for express and regular charging, considering both user equilibrium and system optimal scenarios. To account for heterogeneities and uncertainties, such as stochastic EV arrival patterns and variable charging demands, we further develop numerical simulation models to quantify the delay distribution. We found that separating EVs with lower charging demand has the potential to minimize total system delay. The proposed models can identify the optimal level of express charging plug allocation to minimize the total charging delay without centralized enforcing traffic distribution. In addition, the model enables government agencies to estimate the required charging resources to fulfill timely evacuation within a given time window. The insights generated by the proposed theoretical models have been validated using agent-based simulation, where uncertainties can be flexibly represented.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨在电动汽车长距离疏散中使用快速充电车道来减少整体延误，通过优化模型分配快速和普通充电桩，考虑用户均衡和系统最优，并开发数值模拟模型处理异质性和不确定性。
AI.research_question: 如何在电动汽车长距离疏散场景中，通过优化快速充电车道的充电桩分配来最小化整体充电延误？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车在灾难疏散中面临续航里程有限和充电基础设施不足的挑战，长时间充电会对其他等待车辆产生负外部性，特别是在疏散场景中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 用户均衡理论和系统最优理论，结合排队论和优化理论。
AI.method: 提出优化模型来分配快速和普通充电桩，考虑用户均衡和系统最优场景；开发数值模拟模型处理随机EV到达模式和可变充电需求；使用基于代理的模拟验证理论模型。
AI.findings: 分离充电需求较低的电动汽车可以最小化总系统延误；模型能识别最优快速充电桩分配水平，无需集中强制交通分配；政府机构可估算所需充电资源以确保及时疏散。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑电动汽车疏散场景中快速充电车道分配的优化框架；整合了用户均衡和系统最优视角；开发了处理异质性和不确定性的模拟验证方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾难管理部门提供电动汽车疏散规划工具；帮助政府机构估算充电基础设施需求；提供无需强制交通分配即可优化充电延误的实用方案。

title: Structural Market Behavior and Systematic Trading: Multi-Instrument Validation of the BLT Engine

detail.title: Structural Market Behavior and Systematic Trading: Multi-Instrument Validation of the BLT Engine
detail.abstract: This report presents a comprehensive empirical evaluation of the BLT Engine, a systematic trading engine assessed through multi-year, tick-level historical simulation and statistical robustness diagnostics. The primary objective of this document is not to disclose the internal mechanics or theoretical construction of the engine, but rather to analyze its observable behavior under real historical market conditions. Emphasis is placed on performance consistency, risk containment, equity stability, and sensitivity to trade-sequence variability. All results presented in this report are derived from deterministic historical back testing conducted over extended time horizons (spanning multiple market regimes), using high-fidelity tick data where available. The evaluation framework is uniform across tests, ensuring that observed differences in performance are attributable to market structure rather than execution artefacts. Key performance indicators include absolute profitability, drawdown characteristics, win rate stability, trade distribution properties, and risk-adjusted metrics such as profit factor and Sharpe ratio. These metrics are complemented by Monte Carlo stress testing, in which realized trades are randomly reordered to generate a large ensemble of alternative equity trajectories. The inclusion of Monte Carlo resampling allows for a rigorous assessment of robustness, helping to determine whether performance depends on favorable sequencing or instead reflects a persistent structural edge. Particular attention is given to the dispersion of outcomes, worst case equity paths, and the absence of account ruin across simulated scenarios. This report is intended for professional audiences, including quantitative traders, systematic strategy developers, and institutional evaluators, seeking a transparent, data-driven assessment of systematic trading performance without exposure of proprietary implementation details.

AI.tldr: 该报告对BLT交易引擎进行了全面的实证评估，通过多年分笔数据历史模拟和统计稳健性诊断，重点分析其在真实历史市场条件下的可观测行为，包括性能一致性、风险控制、权益稳定性和交易序列敏感性。
AI.research_question: BLT系统交易引擎在真实历史市场条件下的性能表现如何？其盈利是否依赖于有利的交易序列，还是反映了持续的结构性优势？
AI.motivation: 为专业投资者（量化交易员、系统策略开发者和机构评估者）提供透明、数据驱动的系统交易性能评估，而不暴露专有实现细节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统交易评估框架、历史回测理论、蒙特卡洛模拟方法、风险调整绩效指标理论。
AI.method: 1. 确定性历史回测：使用高保真分笔数据，跨越多个市场周期；2. 蒙特卡洛压力测试：通过随机重排已实现交易生成大量替代权益轨迹；3. 统一评估框架确保结果可比性。
AI.findings: 报告未具体说明结果，但评估了以下指标：绝对盈利能力、回撤特征、胜率稳定性、交易分布特性、风险调整指标（盈利因子、夏普比率），以及蒙特卡洛模拟中的结果离散度、最差权益路径和账户无破产情况。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合历史回测和蒙特卡洛重采样的综合评估框架；2. 强调了交易序列敏感性分析的重要性；3. 提供了区分"运气"和"技能"的系统性方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为专业投资者提供了评估系统交易策略的实用工具；2. 通过蒙特卡洛压力测试帮助识别策略稳健性；3. 提供了透明、可复制的绩效评估方法，保护了专有策略细节。

title: Inventory Planning under Demand and Yield Uncertainties: A Doubly Linear Decision Rule Approach
affiliations: , City University of Hong Kong, Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology, CUHK Business School, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, School of Business, Ningbo University and City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: Inventory Planning under Demand and Yield Uncertainties: A Doubly Linear Decision Rule Approach
detail.abstract: Effectively planning multi-stage inventory requires careful consideration of both demand and yield uncertainties, as each significantly impacts decision quality. However, addressing these uncertainties jointly is challenging because they are influenced by unpredictable and sequentially revealed factors. In addition, the joint distribution of demand and yield is generally unknown in practice, and this distributional ambiguity further complicates the design of reliable policies. In this work, we propose a factor-based model to account for demand and yield uncertainties. To capture the distributional ambiguity, we formulate a distributionally robust multi-stage inventory planning problem. In our model, order quantities are determined sequentially and incorporate information from previous stages, resulting in an adaptive and robust policy. To address the computationally intractable bilinear constraints arising in the model's exact reformulation, we propose a novel doubly linear decision rule that captures both uncertainties and preserves tractability by reformulating the bilinear constraints for efficient and scalable optimization. Numerical experiments show that our model is able to make predictions for demand and yield at higher accuracy, and it achieves cost efficiency as well as robustness compared to benchmark strategies while maintaining computational tractability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因子的分布鲁棒多阶段库存规划模型，同时考虑需求和产量不确定性，通过双重线性决策规则解决计算难题，实现预测精度、成本效率和鲁棒性的平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够同时处理需求和产量不确定性、分布模糊性，并保持计算可处理性的多阶段库存规划策略？
AI.motivation: 多阶段库存规划需要考虑需求和产量双重不确定性，但这些不确定性受不可预测因素影响且联合分布未知，分布模糊性进一步增加了可靠策略设计的难度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于因子的不确定性模型、分布鲁棒优化理论、多阶段决策理论、自适应鲁棒策略
AI.method: 提出基于因子的需求-产量不确定性模型，构建分布鲁棒多阶段库存规划问题，设计新颖的双重线性决策规则来线性化双线性约束，实现高效可扩展优化。
AI.findings: 模型能够以更高精度预测需求和产量，相比基准策略在保持计算可处理性的同时实现了成本效率和鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出同时考虑需求和产量不确定性的因子模型；2) 建立分布鲁棒多阶段库存规划框架；3) 开发双重线性决策规则解决计算难题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供可处理的计算方法；2) 实现预测精度提升；3) 平衡成本效率和鲁棒性；4) 为实际库存管理提供可靠决策支持。

title: Climate Risk's assimilation in Bank Regulation - Law's Internal Dialogue amidst Uncertainty
affiliations: Charles III University of Madrid

detail.title: Climate Risk's assimilation in Bank Regulation - Law's Internal Dialogue amidst Uncertainty

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Banking Institute Working Paper Series No. 203
publicationDetails.journalName: European Banking Institute (EBI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Climate change is humanity’s greatest challenge for the XXIst century. Its effects will be felt for generations to come. In light of the enormity of the challenge, bank regulators are moving, yet reforms are neither homogeneous nor comprehensive. The EU is clearly more committed to the effort than any other player, and even within the EU, attitudes are cautious towards Pillar 1 (prudential requirements) and macroprudential measures, bolder towards Pillar 3 (market discipline through disclosures), and Pillar 2 (supervisory review), though more uneven on the latter. This does not follow a scientific logic (due to the high uncertainty of climate risk) but a policy logic, since legislators and regulators tend to follow a path of minimum resistance, and undertake first the reforms that require them a lower epistemic burden.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了银行监管机构应对气候变化的改革路径，指出欧盟在此领域最为积极，但改革呈现不均衡性：在支柱1（审慎要求）和宏观审慎措施上较为谨慎，在支柱3（市场纪律）上更为大胆，支柱2（监管审查）则表现不一。这种模式并非基于科学逻辑，而是政策逻辑，反映了监管机构倾向于选择认知负担较低的改革路径。
AI.research_question: 银行监管机构如何应对气候变化挑战？特别是，欧盟及其他监管机构在巴塞尔框架的三个支柱（审慎要求、监管审查、市场纪律）上采取了何种不同的改革路径？
AI.motivation: 气候变化是21世纪人类面临的最大挑战，其影响将延续数代人。面对这一巨大挑战，银行监管机构正在采取行动，但改革既不统一也不全面。需要理解监管机构应对气候风险的策略差异及其背后的逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于巴塞尔银行监管框架的三个支柱（Pillar 1: 审慎要求，Pillar 2: 监管审查，Pillar 3: 市场纪律）；政策制定理论中的"最小阻力路径"和"认知负担"概念；气候风险的不确定性理论。
AI.method: 政策分析/比较研究方法，分析欧盟及其他监管机构在巴塞尔框架下应对气候变化的改革措施，比较不同支柱上的政策差异。
AI.findings: 欧盟在应对气候变化方面比其他参与者更为积极；改革呈现不均衡模式：对支柱1和宏观审慎措施态度谨慎，对支柱3（信息披露）更为大胆，支柱2则表现不一；这种模式遵循的是政策逻辑而非科学逻辑，反映了监管机构倾向于选择认知负担较低的改革路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了监管机构应对复杂风险（如气候变化）时的"认知负担最小化"决策框架；解释了为何监管改革在巴塞尔框架的不同支柱上呈现不均衡性；将气候风险的高度不确定性与监管决策逻辑联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解监管改革路径差异的框架；帮助银行和金融机构预测监管趋势；指出了当前监管框架在应对气候变化方面的局限性；为未来更全面的气候风险监管改革提供了方向性建议。

title: The Word "Run": A Proof of Concept for Premise Misalignment
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Word "Run": A Proof of Concept for Premise Misalignment
detail.abstract:
This paper challenges the widely cited claim that the English word “run” is the most complex word in the language, a conclusion typically drawn from its unusually large number of dictionary definitions. It argues that this conclusion rests on a category error: measuring conceptual complexity by counting surface-level outputs rather than identifying the underlying generative rule.

Using a structural analysis, the paper demonstrates that “run” operates as a single, minimal operator denoting the execution of a self-contained, continuous, forward-propelled process. The apparent multiplicity of meanings reflects the broad applicability of this operator across physical, mechanical, computational, social, and spatial domains—not semantic ambiguity.

This case serves as a proof of concept for premise misalignment, illustrating how expert narratives can mistake widespread invariance for complexity. The analysis suggests that similar misclassifications may underlie broader cognitive and institutional errors, where noise is mistaken for structure and description for explanation.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文挑战了"run"是英语中最复杂单词的流行观点，认为这是基于范畴错误的结论——用表面定义数量衡量概念复杂性，而非识别底层生成规则。通过结构分析，论文证明"run"是一个表示执行自包含、连续、向前推进过程的单一最小算子，其多种含义反映的是该算子跨领域的广泛适用性，而非语义模糊。
AI.research_question: 英语单词"run"是否真的是语言中最复杂的单词？如何正确评估词汇的概念复杂性？
AI.motivation: 挑战关于"run"是英语最复杂单词的广泛引用观点，指出这种结论基于错误的衡量方法（范畴错误），需要建立更准确的概念复杂性评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 范畴错误理论、结构语言学、生成语法、概念复杂性理论、表面输出与底层规则的区分。
AI.method: 结构分析，通过识别"run"作为单一最小算子的底层生成规则，分析其在物理、机械、计算、社会、空间等领域的应用模式。
AI.findings: "run"是一个表示执行自包含、连续、向前推进过程的单一算子；其多种字典定义反映的是该基本概念的广泛适用性，而非语义模糊；专家叙事错误地将广泛不变性误解为复杂性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了概念复杂性的新评估框架（基于底层规则而非表面输出）；发展了"前提错位"理论概念；为语言学和认知科学中的类似误分类提供了分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 纠正了关于词汇复杂性的常见误解；为词典编纂和语言教学提供了更准确的概念分析方法；揭示了认知和制度性错误中普遍存在的将噪音误认为结构、将描述误认为解释的模式。

title: Optimal Underreporting and Competitive Equilibrium
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Tsinghua univeristy, The University of Sydney - School of Mathematics and University of Connecticut - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Optimal Underreporting and Competitive Equilibrium
detail.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic insurance market model comprising two competing insurance companies and a continuum of insureds, and examines the interaction between strategic underreporting by the insureds and competitive pricing between the insurance companies under a Bonus-Malus System (BMS) framework. For the first time in an oligopolistic setting, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the insureds' optimal reporting barrier, as well as its continuous dependence on the BMS premiums. For the 2-class BMS case, we prove the existence of Nash equilibrium premium strategies and conduct an extensive sensitivity analysis on the impact of the model parameters on the equilibrium premiums.

AI.tldr: 本文在寡头竞争保险市场模型中，首次研究了投保人策略性瞒报与保险公司在奖惩系统（BMS）下的竞争定价之间的相互作用，证明了最优报告门槛的存在性、唯一性及连续性，并分析了2类BMS下的纳什均衡保费策略。
AI.research_question: 在寡头竞争的保险市场中，投保人的策略性瞒报行为与保险公司在奖惩系统（BMS）下的竞争定价如何相互作用？最优报告门槛和均衡保费策略的存在性、唯一性及参数敏感性如何？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注垄断市场或完全竞争市场下的保险定价问题，缺乏对寡头竞争市场中投保人策略性行为与保险公司竞争定价相互作用的研究。奖惩系统（BMS）作为保险定价的重要机制，其与市场竞争的交互影响尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 动态保险市场模型：包含两家竞争保险公司和连续投保人群体；2. 奖惩系统（BMS）框架；3. 博弈论：投保人与保险公司的策略互动；4. 纳什均衡理论：分析保险公司竞争定价；5. 最优控制理论：确定投保人最优报告门槛。
AI.method: 1. 建立包含两家保险公司和连续投保人的动态保险市场模型；2. 在BMS框架下分析投保人策略性瞒报行为；3. 证明最优报告门槛的存在性、唯一性和连续性；4. 针对2类BMS情况，证明纳什均衡保费策略的存在性；5. 进行广泛的参数敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 首次在寡头竞争环境下证明了投保人最优报告门槛的存在性和唯一性；2. 证明了最优报告门槛对BMS保费的连续依赖性；3. 对于2类BMS，证明了纳什均衡保费策略的存在性；4. 通过敏感性分析揭示了模型参数对均衡保费的显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将策略性瞒报行为纳入寡头竞争保险市场分析；2. 建立了BMS框架下投保人与保险公司互动的理论模型；3. 证明了最优报告门槛的存在性、唯一性和连续性定理；4. 扩展了保险市场博弈论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为保险公司在竞争环境下设计BMS定价策略提供理论指导；2. 帮助监管机构理解市场结构对投保人行为的影响；3. 为保险产品设计和风险管理提供决策支持；4. 揭示了参数变化对市场均衡的影响机制。

title: Return Distributions, Not Levels
affiliations: Tecnológico de Monterrey - EGADE Business School and Tecnológico de Monterrey

detail.title: Return Distributions, Not Levels

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable,
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Asset pricing theory and risk management require accurate characterization of the complete distribution of returns, not just means, variances, and kurtosis. We document that standardized asset returns exhibit a universal symmetric wave-like deviation from normality appearing identically across equities, foreign exchange, cryptocurrencies, credit spreads, and VIX. This pattern persists for a century, remains invariant to temporal aggregation and portfolio diversification, and reflects a single dominant systematic factor. Ignoring this structure can lead to systematic underestimates of Value-at-Risk by 2.2-3.3 percentage points, translating to $2.2-3.4 billion errors per $100 billion portfolio. We show that consumption-based stochastic discount factors account for 61-79% of this distributional structure using conventional preference parameters. Independent approaches to constructing risk-neutral returns (both consumption and options-based) produce overlapping distributional shapes while markedly disagreeing on return levels. The equity premium puzzle therefore concerns levels and not the distributional shape of returns.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现标准化资产收益率存在普遍对称波状偏离正态分布的模式，这种模式在不同资产类别、时间跨度和投资组合中保持稳定，忽略此结构会导致VaR显著低估。消费随机贴现因子能解释大部分分布结构，股权溢价之谜主要涉及收益率水平而非分布形态。
AI.research_question: 资产收益率分布是否存在普遍的系统性偏离正态分布的模式？这种模式在不同资产类别、时间跨度中是否稳定？忽略这种分布结构对风险管理有何影响？消费随机贴现因子能否解释这种分布结构？
AI.motivation: 资产定价理论和风险管理需要准确刻画收益率的完整分布，而不仅仅是均值、方差和峰度。现有研究可能忽视了收益率分布中存在的系统性结构模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM）、随机贴现因子理论、风险中性定价、正态分布假设下的风险管理框架。
AI.method: 实证分析多种资产类别（股票、外汇、加密货币、信用利差、VIX）的标准化收益率分布，时间跨度长达一个世纪，考察时间聚合和投资组合多样化的影响，使用消费随机贴现因子解释分布结构，比较风险中性收益率构建方法。
AI.findings: 1. 标准化资产收益率存在普遍对称波状偏离正态分布的模式；2. 该模式在不同资产类别、时间跨度（一个世纪）中保持稳定；3. 模式对时间聚合和投资组合多样化具有不变性；4. 反映单一主导系统性因子；5. 忽略此结构会导致VaR低估2.2-3.3个百分点；6. 消费随机贴现因子能解释61-79%的分布结构；7. 风险中性收益率构建方法在分布形态上一致但在水平上存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了资产收益率分布的普遍系统性结构；2. 表明股权溢价之谜主要涉及收益率水平而非分布形态；3. 为资产定价理论提供了新的分布特征证据；4. 揭示了消费随机贴现因子在解释分布结构方面的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 风险管理：忽略分布结构会导致VaR显著低估（每1000亿美元组合产生22-34亿美元误差）；2. 投资实践：提供了更准确的收益率分布建模方法；3. 监管应用：改进金融机构的风险计量和资本要求计算。

title:
SBCM Note #7: The Theory of Entropic Elasticity (v2.1)
The Law of Potential Capacity, Plasticity Lag, and the Mechanism of Wealth Ejection
affiliations: SBCM Alliance

detail.title:
SBCM Note #7: The Theory of Entropic Elasticity (v2.1)
The Law of Potential Capacity, Plasticity Lag, and the Mechanism of Wealth Ejection

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. (Theoretical study)
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
<p><strong>— The Law of Potential Capacity, Plasticity Lag, and the Mechanism of Wealth Ejection —</strong></p>

<p><strong>Abstract:</strong><br>
Traditional Keynesian economics assumes that pouring budget ($I_{budget}$) into a region directly translates into economic growth ("Pump Priming"), implying that a region is an "infinite container" capable of holding any amount of capital.<br>
However, <strong>SBCM Field Theory</strong> posits that every physical system (region/block) behaves as an <strong>Elastic Body</strong> with a finite <strong>"Potential Entropic Capacity ($C_{pot}$)"</strong>.</p>

<p>This note proves mathematically that when external injection exceeds this capacity, the system generates a <strong>"Restoring Force"</strong> (Hooke's Law) that actively ejects the excess wealth to the exterior. Furthermore, through <strong>Time Constant Analysis</strong> ($\tau_{money} \ll \tau_{structure}$), we demonstrate that rapid budget injection results in <strong>Elastic Rebound</strong> (leakage) rather than Plastic Deformation (growth).</p>

<p><strong>Conclusion:</strong><br>
The failure of regional economics is not a lack of money, but a violation of elasticity limits. Without flow regulation (Impedance Matching) via <strong>G-Cart</strong>, fiscal stimulus is physically destined to dissipate.</p>

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SBCM场理论，将经济区域视为具有有限"潜在熵容量"的弹性体。当外部资金注入超过该容量时，系统会产生"恢复力"将超额财富排出，导致资金泄漏而非经济增长。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统凯恩斯主义经济刺激政策在某些区域会失效？区域经济系统对资金注入的物理响应机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统凯恩斯经济学假设区域是"无限容器"，能够容纳任何数量的资本注入，但现实中许多财政刺激政策并未产生预期经济增长效果，需要新的理论框架解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: SBCM场理论、弹性体理论、潜在熵容量概念、胡克定律（恢复力）、时间常数分析（资金时间常数与结构时间常数）、弹性反弹与塑性变形理论。
AI.method: 数学证明方法、时间常数分析（τ_money ≪ τ_structure）、弹性体物理模型应用、理论推导。
AI.findings: 1. 区域经济系统具有有限的潜在熵容量；2. 当外部注入超过容量时，系统会产生恢复力主动排出超额财富；3. 快速预算注入导致弹性反弹（泄漏）而非塑性变形（增长）；4. 区域经济失败的原因是违反弹性极限而非资金不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出SBCM场理论框架，将经济系统建模为弹性体；2. 引入潜在熵容量概念；3. 建立资金注入与系统响应的物理机制模型；4. 解释传统经济刺激政策失效的物理原理。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出财政刺激需要阻抗匹配（通过G-Cart进行流量调节）；2. 强调考虑区域弹性极限的重要性；3. 为政策制定者提供避免资金泄漏的理论指导；4. 提出更有效的经济干预方法。

title: The Anatomy of Decarbonizing Firms
affiliations: EMLYON Business School,  and

detail.title: The Anatomy of Decarbonizing Firms
detail.abstract: We study the firm-level drivers of corporate decarbonization using a global panel combining financial characteristics, balance-sheet indicators, ESG metrics, macroeconomic variables, and firms' greenhouse gas emissions. Emission trajectories exhibit strong persistence, with past emissions the dominant predictor of future performance. However, firms with larger carbon footprints also display greater abatement potential, creating opportunities for targeted stewardship and capital reallocation. We identify adoption of Science-Based Targets (SBT) as a significant catalyst for emission reductions and provide causal evidence that credible, externally validated climate commitments accelerate decarbonization. We develop machine-learning models that outperform heuristic benchmarks in forecasting one-year-ahead abatement, especially in hard-to-abate sectors, and we show that such forecasts can help further curtail portfolio-level emissions. Nevertheless, our results indicate that, given current emission trends in the cross-section of firms, building portfolios with net zero objectives for 2050 remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用全球面板数据分析企业脱碳的驱动因素，发现排放轨迹具有强持续性，但碳足迹大的企业减排潜力也更大。采用科学碳目标(SBT)是减排的重要催化剂，机器学习模型能有效预测未来减排，但构建2050年净零投资组合仍面临挑战。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的哪些因素驱动公司脱碳？科学碳目标(SBT)等气候承诺如何影响减排效果？机器学习模型能否有效预测企业减排表现？
AI.motivation: 随着全球气候变化加剧，企业脱碳成为关键议题。理解企业层面的脱碳驱动因素对于投资者、政策制定者和企业管理者制定有效的气候策略至关重要，但目前缺乏系统性的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业环境绩效理论、气候变化经济学、ESG投资理论，以及企业承诺与行为改变的理论框架，特别是科学碳目标(SBT)作为外部验证机制的作用。
AI.method: 使用全球面板数据，结合财务特征、资产负债表指标、ESG指标、宏观经济变量和企业温室气体排放数据。采用因果推断方法评估SBT的影响，开发机器学习模型预测未来减排表现。
AI.findings: 1) 排放轨迹具有强持续性，过去排放是未来表现的主要预测指标；2) 碳足迹大的企业减排潜力更大；3) SBT采用是减排的重要催化剂，可信的外部验证气候承诺能加速脱碳；4) 机器学习模型在预测一年期减排方面优于启发式基准，尤其在难减排行业；5) 基于当前企业排放趋势，构建2050年净零投资组合仍具挑战性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为企业脱碳驱动因素提供了系统性实证证据；2) 验证了外部验证气候承诺(如SBT)的因果效应；3) 将机器学习方法引入企业环境绩效预测领域；4) 揭示了企业减排潜力与当前排放水平的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供识别减排潜力企业的工具；2) 为企业管理者展示SBT等气候承诺的实际价值；3) 为政策制定者提供有针对性的监管依据；4) 开发了实用的减排预测模型，特别适用于难减排行业。
