detail.title: “Efficiency Paradox” in Digital-Industrial Synergies: Exploring the Effect of Urban Characteristics and Policy on Energy Efficiency in China

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Understanding the relationship between the synergy of digital infrastructure and industrial structure upgrading and energy efficiency is critical for advancing sustainable development, yet its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Drawing on panel data for 275 Chinese cities from 2011 to 2022, this study develops a coupling coordination degree index and employs a two-way fixed effects model to assess the impact of the digital–industrial synergy on energy efficiency. The results reveal a significant negative effect, indicating a “synergy paradox”, namely, that synergy does not enhance but rather suppresses energy efficiency improvements. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that this paradox is more pronounced in non-megacities and non-resource-based cities. Further analysis of moderating effects suggests that the larger population size can mitigate this adverse effect, while government intervention and overlapping digital–climate policies exacerbate institutional distortions and reinforce the paradox. This study challenges the conventional assumption that synergy is necessarily effective, presents new evidence on the complexity of digital–industrial transition, and offers important policy implications for designing context specific coordination strategies.

AI.tldr: 研究发现数字基础设施与产业结构升级的协同效应反而抑制了能源效率提升，呈现"协同悖论"，这一现象在非超大城市和非资源型城市更明显，人口规模可缓解负面影响，而政府干预和数字-气候政策重叠会加剧制度扭曲。
AI.research_question: 数字基础设施与产业结构升级的协同效应如何影响能源效率？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解数字基础设施与产业结构升级的协同对能源效率的影响机制对推进可持续发展至关重要，但现有研究对其内在机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协同理论、制度扭曲理论、数字-产业转型理论
AI.method: 基于2011-2022年中国275个城市的面板数据，构建耦合协调度指数，采用双向固定效应模型评估数字-产业协同对能源效率的影响，并进行异质性分析和调节效应检验。
AI.findings: 数字-产业协同对能源效率有显著负向影响，呈现"协同悖论"；这一悖论在非超大城市和非资源型城市更明显；人口规模能缓解负面影响，而政府干预和数字-气候政策重叠会加剧制度扭曲，强化悖论效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"协同必然有效"的传统假设，为数字-产业转型的复杂性提供了新证据，深化了对协同效应与制度扭曲关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定因地制宜的协调策略提供重要政策启示，建议避免过度政府干预和政策重叠，重视城市规模和类型差异，优化数字与产业协同发展路径。

title: Workers' Job Prospects and Young Firm Dynamics
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: Workers' Job Prospects and Young Firm Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how worker beliefs and job prospects shape wages and growth at young firms and aggregate outcomes. Building a heterogeneous-firm directed search model in which workers gradually learn about firm fundamentals, I show that learning under labor market frictions generates endogenous wage differentials and distinct labor market outcomes for young firms. In particular, high-performing young firms pay higher wages than observationally equivalent mature firms, while low-performing young firms offer lower wages than their mature counterparts. These wage differentials create hiring and retention frictions for high-performing young firms. Reductions in either information frictions or search frictions compress wage differentials, strengthen selection by enhancing the growth of high-potential young firms, and increase aggregate productivity. The model's predictions are supported by U.S. administrative employer-employee matched data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究工人信念和工作前景如何影响年轻企业的工资与增长以及总体经济结果。通过建立异质性企业定向搜索模型，其中工人逐渐了解企业基本面，研究发现劳动力市场摩擦下的学习过程会产生内生性工资差异，导致年轻企业与成熟企业在劳动力市场表现不同。
AI.research_question: 工人信念和工作前景如何塑造年轻企业的工资与增长，并影响总体经济结果？
AI.motivation: 年轻企业在劳动力市场中面临特殊挑战，工人对年轻企业的不完全信息可能导致工资差异和招聘困难，进而影响企业成长和总体生产率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性企业定向搜索模型，包含工人对企业基本面的渐进学习过程，劳动力市场存在信息摩擦和搜索摩擦。
AI.method: 理论建模结合实证分析：建立异质性企业定向搜索模型，使用美国行政雇主-雇员匹配数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 1. 高绩效年轻企业比观察上相似的成熟企业支付更高工资，而低绩效年轻企业支付更低工资；2. 这些工资差异为高绩效年轻企业创造招聘和留任摩擦；3. 减少信息摩擦或搜索摩擦会压缩工资差异，通过促进高潜力年轻企业增长加强选择效应，提高总体生产率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将工人学习过程整合到异质性企业定向搜索模型中；2. 解释年轻企业与成熟企业间的内生性工资差异；3. 阐明劳动力市场摩擦如何影响年轻企业成长和总体生产率。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供减少信息不对称和搜索摩擦的政策依据；2. 帮助企业理解劳动力市场中的工资策略；3. 为年轻企业成长和总体生产率提升提供理论指导。

title: Caregiving in subdivided units: how housing shape family functioning in cramped-living child-rearing families
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong and The University of Hong Kong, Faculty of Social Sciences, Department of Social Work and Social Administration

detail.title: Caregiving in subdivided units: how housing shape family functioning in cramped-living child-rearing families
detail.abstract: Child-rearing families living in cramped subdivided rental units face persistent difficulties in sustaining caregiving, child development and family functioning, yet housing research still largely centres on individuals. Drawing on environmental affordance theory, this study examines how inadequate housing environments afford or constrain core family functions. Semi-structured, in-depth interviews were conducted with 32 families recruited through four non-governmental organisations and analysed using reflexive thematic analysis with abductive coding. The study identifies seven key family-based housing functions—adaptation to exterior environment, financing and governance of energy and utilities, affording manageable risk and safe care for children, providing time-efficient caregiving routines, rest and respite, spatial arrangement for family supplies, and nurturing and support for child development. Severe spatial constraints create “forced synchronicity”, compelling family members to align daily activities at the expense of privacy, differentiated care and restorative rest. Neighbourhood infrastructure and social networks partially compensate for these deficits but cannot fully offset housing-derived environmental stressors or the added management burdens placed on parents. The findings extend the affordance framework to family households and underscore the need for family-centred housing and energy policies, alongside targeted building management and neighbourhood interventions, in high-density cities facing acute housing shortages.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于环境可供性理论，探讨香港狭小分租屋如何影响家庭功能。研究发现空间限制导致"被迫同步性"，家庭成员需牺牲隐私和休息来协调活动。研究识别了七大家庭住房功能，并提出需要以家庭为中心的住房政策。
AI.research_question: 狭小的分租住房环境如何影响或制约核心家庭功能的实现？
AI.motivation: 现有住房研究主要关注个体，而忽视家庭作为整体在狭小居住环境中的困境。居住在拥挤分租屋的家庭在育儿、儿童发展和家庭功能维持上面临持续困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境可供性理论（Environmental Affordance Theory），探讨物理环境如何提供或限制家庭功能实现的可能性。
AI.method: 半结构化深度访谈，通过四个非政府组织招募32个家庭，采用反思性主题分析和溯因编码进行分析。
AI.findings: 识别了七大家庭住房功能：适应外部环境、能源公用事业融资与管理、提供可管理的风险和儿童安全照护、时间高效的照护常规、休息与恢复、家庭用品空间安排、儿童发展培育与支持。严重空间限制导致"被迫同步性"，家庭成员需牺牲隐私、差异化照护和恢复性休息来协调日常活动。邻里基础设施和社会网络只能部分补偿这些缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 将可供性理论框架扩展到家庭住户层面，为理解住房环境如何塑造家庭功能提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调在高密度城市中需要制定以家庭为中心的住房和能源政策，以及有针对性的建筑管理和邻里干预措施。

title: Multisectoral analysis of socio-environmental conflicts related to mining in Peru (2020-2025)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Multisectoral analysis of socio-environmental conflicts related to mining in Peru (2020-2025)
detail.abstract: Despite the extensive literature on ecological distribution conflicts highlighting environmental resistance as a dominant response to the expansion of extractive industries particularly in Andean mining contexts this narrative proves insufficient to explain the growing diversity of socio-environmental conflicts in post-pandemic Peru. This study analyzes how and why these conflicts have diversified between 2020 and 2025, aiming to characterize their territorial, institutional, and economic dynamics based on a proprietary database built from records provided by the Ombudsman’s Office. A total of 732 cases are examined, 471 of which are directly related to metallic and non-metallic mining. Using a multiscalar approach, the study combines spatial, sectoral, and conflict trajectory analyses. The findings reveal that conflicts aiming to halt extractive projects are in the minority; instead, “coexistence conflicts” predominate, where mobilization is directed toward renegotiating economic benefits, compensations, and territorial recognition. Moreover, many conflicts arise in territories without active mining operations, revealing redistributive disputes that transcend the extractive enclave. The study concludes that environmental injustice does not automatically translate into open resistance and that current conflict dynamics reflect unequal and contingent relations that shape modes of integration into the extractive model.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了秘鲁环境冲突主要是抵抗采掘业的传统观点，发现2020-2025年间冲突呈现多样化，以"共存冲突"为主，旨在重新协商经济利益和领土承认，而非停止项目。
AI.research_question: 2020-2025年间秘鲁的社会环境冲突如何以及为何多样化？这些冲突的领土、制度和经济动态特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统生态分配冲突文献强调环境抵抗作为对采掘业扩张的主要回应，但这种叙述不足以解释后疫情时代秘鲁日益多样化的社会环境冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态分配冲突理论、环境正义理论、采掘主义理论、多尺度分析方法
AI.method: 基于监察员办公室记录构建专有数据库，分析732个案例（其中471个与金属和非金属采矿直接相关），采用多尺度方法结合空间、部门和冲突轨迹分析
AI.findings: 1. 旨在停止采掘项目的冲突占少数；2. "共存冲突"占主导，动员旨在重新协商经济利益、补偿和领土承认；3. 许多冲突发生在没有活跃采矿作业的领土，揭示了超越采掘飞地的再分配争议
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了环境冲突主要是抵抗采掘业的传统观点，提出了"共存冲突"概念，表明环境不公正不一定转化为公开抵抗，冲突动态反映了塑造融入采掘模式方式的不平等和偶然关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更细致的冲突理解，强调需要超越简单的"抵抗vs接受"二分法，关注经济利益分配和领土承认的协商机制

title: From Closed to Open Regulatory Sandboxes: Why Default and Altering Rules Matter
affiliations: Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University) and Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University)

detail.title: From Closed to Open Regulatory Sandboxes: Why Default and Altering Rules Matter
detail.abstract: Regulatory sandboxes are widely available but often underused. This paper theoretically reframes sandboxes as exercises in default-rule design, which not only explains their low-uptake but also provides a path forward for their reform. Most existing sandboxes are closed by default: experimentation is unlawful unless the regulator grants permission, and entry is mediated through application, approval, and discretionary assessment. We show that these procedures function as costly "altering rules" that make the prohibitory baseline sticky. The result is to screen out frontier innovators while attracting firms already close to compliance. This problem intensifies as innovation becomes increasingly combinatorial, implicating multiple regulatory domains that narrow, licence-specific carve-outs cannot accommodate. We propose an alternative model of open sandboxes implemented as default-in safe harbours, under which eligible firms are presumed protected from enforcement of specified authorisation requirements by default, subject to registration, disclosure, conditions, and revocation. This design shifts sandboxes from permissioned exceptions to legal infrastructure that enables experimentation unless and until regulators intervene, better aligning sandbox design with innovation under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文从默认规则设计角度重新审视监管沙盒，指出当前封闭式沙盒（默认禁止）因申请成本高而筛选掉前沿创新者，吸引已合规企业。提出开放式沙盒作为默认安全港，通过注册制实现默认允许，更好支持不确定性创新。
AI.research_question: 为什么监管沙盒普遍存在但使用率低？如何重新设计监管沙盒以更好地促进创新？
AI.motivation: 监管沙盒作为促进创新的政策工具被广泛采用，但实际使用率低。需要从理论层面解释这一现象并提出改革路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 默认规则设计理论：将沙盒视为默认规则设计问题，分析封闭式沙盒（默认禁止）与开放式沙盒（默认允许）对创新行为的不同影响。
AI.method: 理论分析框架：运用默认规则设计理论分析现有沙盒机制，提出开放式沙盒作为替代模型的理论论证。
AI.findings: 1. 现有封闭式沙盒作为"改变规则"成本高昂，使禁止性基线难以改变；2. 筛选掉前沿创新者，吸引已接近合规的企业；3. 组合式创新涉及多监管领域时问题加剧；4. 开放式沙盒作为默认安全港能更好支持不确定性创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次从默认规则设计角度理论重构监管沙盒；2. 提出沙盒使用率低的理论解释；3. 建立开放式沙盒作为默认安全港的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管沙盒改革提供具体设计路径；2. 提出从许可例外转向法律基础设施的转型方案；3. 为支持组合式创新提供监管框架。

title: Housing Price Appreciation and Corporate Innovation: Evidence of Crowding-Out through Resource Misallocation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Ningbo University and University of Science and Technology Beijing

detail.title: Housing Price Appreciation and Corporate Innovation: Evidence of Crowding-Out through Resource Misallocation
detail.abstract: The fundamental nature of capital allocation shapes sustainable, innovation-led growth. While patient, ecosystem-embedded capital can foster local scale-ups and inclusive development, we examine its perverse counterpart: how a booming asset market can divert capital away from productive innovation. Focusing on China’s historic housing boom, this study investigates whether rising real estate prices act as a form of “impatient capital,” distorting corporate investment and stifling high-value innovation. By employing a research design that combines a regression discontinuity approach with a difference-in-differences analysis of purchase restrictions, we identify a significant crowding-out effect on high-value invention patents. Specifically, a 10% rise in housing prices reduces firm-level invention patent grants by 0.129 log points. This adverse effect is particularly pronounced among private firms and those in the high-growth eastern region. Mechanism tests reveal that rising prices exacerbate capital misallocation and prompt non-real-estate firms to shift resources toward residential land acquisition. The results underscore the need for policies that not only curb speculation but also proactively channel capital toward the patient, place-based innovation financing necessary for resilient and inclusive growth.

AI.tldr: 中国房地产繁荣通过"不耐烦资本"效应，显著挤出企业高价值发明专利，尤其影响民营企业和东部高增长地区企业，需要政策引导资本流向耐心、基于地方的创新融资。
AI.research_question: 房地产价格上涨是否作为"不耐烦资本"形式，扭曲企业投资并抑制高价值创新？
AI.motivation: 资本配置的根本性质影响可持续、创新驱动增长。虽然耐心、嵌入生态系统的资本可以促进本地规模化发展和包容性发展，但本研究关注其负面效应：繁荣的资产市场如何将资本从生产性创新中转移出去。
AI.theoretical_framework: "不耐烦资本"理论、资本错配理论、房地产繁荣对创新的挤出效应理论
AI.method: 结合回归断点设计和限购政策双重差分分析的研究设计
AI.findings: 房价上涨10%导致企业层面发明专利授权减少0.129对数点；这种负面影响在民营企业和东部高增长地区企业中尤为显著；机制测试显示价格上涨加剧资本错配，促使非房地产企业将资源转向住宅用地获取。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了"不耐烦资本"理论在房地产繁荣背景下的应用，深化了对资产市场繁荣如何扭曲创新投资的理解，提供了资本错配机制的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要政策不仅抑制投机，还要积极引导资本流向耐心、基于地方的创新融资；为政策制定者提供房地产调控与创新支持政策协调的依据；为企业投资决策提供参考。

title: Symmetry Breaking and Chimera States: A New Taxonomy of Amalgams in Complex Financial
affiliations: CAEN - UFC

detail.title: Symmetry Breaking and Chimera States: A New Taxonomy of Amalgams in Complex Financial
detail.abstract: We investigate the collective dynamics of financial markets through the lens of phase transitions and synchronization in complex networks. Using a system of 29 global assets categorized into risk and safe-haven clusters, we apply the Hilbert Transform to extract instantaneous phases and compute the Kuramoto order parameter (R) alongside a novel Chimera Index (H). Our results reveal that systemic crises, such as the 2008 Subprime collapse and the 2020 pandemic, are characterized by a forced phase condensation where synchronization is driven by volatility (∂R/∂σ > 0), leading to a “Systemic Amalgam” state. Conversely, geopolitical shifts like the 2016 and 2024 U.S. elections trigger “Chimera States”, marked by the coexistence of synchronized and desynchronized subpopulations. By mapping these transitions onto a Landau free-energy potential, we demonstrate that the Chimera state serves as a meta-stable precursor to symmetry breaking. This thermodynamic framework provides a robust early-warning signal for systemic risk, identifying structural fragility before global diversification collapses.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过复杂网络中的相变和同步视角分析金融市场集体动态，发现系统性危机（如2008年次贷危机、2020年疫情）表现为强制相凝聚状态，而地缘政治事件（如2016和2024年美国大选）则触发奇美拉状态，这些状态变化可通过热力学框架为系统性风险提供早期预警信号。
AI.research_question: 金融市场集体动态如何通过相变和同步现象来表征？系统性危机与地缘政治事件在同步模式上有何不同？
AI.motivation: 理解金融市场在危机时期的集体行为模式，为系统性风险提供更有效的预警机制，超越传统的相关性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂网络理论、相变理论、同步理论（Kuramoto模型）、奇美拉状态理论、朗道自由能势理论
AI.method: 使用29个全球资产分为风险和安全港两类，应用希尔伯特变换提取瞬时相位，计算Kuramoto序参数（R）和新奇美拉指数（H），将相变映射到朗道自由能势
AI.findings: 系统性危机表现为强制相凝聚状态（同步由波动率驱动，∂R/∂σ > 0），形成"系统性融合"状态；地缘政治事件触发奇美拉状态（同步与非同步子群共存）；奇美拉状态是破缺对称性的亚稳态前兆
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融市场集体动态的热力学框架，将奇美拉状态概念引入金融网络分析，建立了相变与系统性风险之间的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统性风险提供稳健的早期预警信号，能在全球多样化崩溃前识别结构脆弱性，有助于风险管理和政策制定

title: Cost Utility Analysis of a Parent-Training Program for Children with Neurodevelopmental Disabilities
affiliations: The Hospital for Sick Children, The Hospital for Sick Children, University of Calgary - The School of Public Policy, IWK Health Centre, McGill University and University of Toronto - Department of Health Policy, Management and Evaluation

detail.title: Cost Utility Analysis of a Parent-Training Program for Children with Neurodevelopmental Disabilities
detail.abstract: Purpose: Parent-training (PT) programs can improve management of neurodevelopmental disabilities (NDD) including autism in children, but their cost-effectiveness is unknown. The objectives were to compare the services used by families receiving group coached (GC) PT, self-managed (SM) PT or standard care and measure the incremental cost of GC and SM PT compared to standard care per quality-adjusted life year (QALY) gained from the perspectives of public and societal payers.Methods: Caregivers of children with NDD were randomly assigned to GC, SM or control. Resource use and health-related quality of life were measured at baseline, 5- and 10-months. Total costs per child were calculated from public and societal payer perspectives. The Health Utilities Index was used to calculate QALYs over a time horizon of ten months. Differences between groups were tests for statistical significance. Sensitivity analyses were conducted to assess uncertainty.Results: From the societal payer perspective, GC was more costly and more effective than control with an incremental cost of  CAD 2,510 (95% CI -2,416, 7,436) and incremental QALYs of 0.04 (95% CI -0.091, 0.004), resulting in an incremental cost of CAD 67,446 per QALY gained. SM PT was also more costly and more effective than control with an incremental cost of CAD 5,664 (95% CI 340, 10,988) and incremental QALYs of 0.05 (95% CI -0.091, 0.008), leading to an incremental cost of CAD 122,984 per QALY gained.Conclusions: These results show that GC PT may be a cost-effective option for caregivers of children with NDDs.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了针对神经发育障碍儿童家长的两种父母培训项目（团体指导式与自我管理式）与标准护理的成本效益，发现团体指导式培训可能具有成本效益。
AI.research_question: 团体指导式父母培训、自我管理式父母培训与标准护理相比，在服务使用、成本和健康调整生命年方面的差异如何？哪种干预方式更具成本效益？
AI.motivation: 父母培训项目可以改善神经发育障碍（包括自闭症）儿童的管理，但其成本效益尚不清楚，需要为政策制定提供经济证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析框架，从公共支付者和社会支付者角度评估医疗干预的经济价值，使用质量调整生命年作为健康产出指标。
AI.method: 随机对照试验，将神经发育障碍儿童的照顾者随机分配到团体指导式培训组、自我管理式培训组或对照组。在基线、5个月和10个月测量资源使用和健康相关生活质量。从公共和社会支付者角度计算每个儿童的总成本，使用健康效用指数计算10个月时间范围内的QALYs。进行敏感性分析评估不确定性。
AI.findings: 从社会支付者角度看，团体指导式培训比对照组成本更高但效果更好，每个QALY获得的增量成本为67,446加元；自我管理式培训每个QALY获得的增量成本为122,984加元。团体指导式培训可能具有成本效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为神经发育障碍儿童父母培训项目的成本效益分析提供了实证证据，扩展了儿童发展干预的经济评估理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、医疗管理者和临床医生提供了经济证据，支持团体指导式父母培训作为神经发育障碍儿童管理的成本效益干预选择。

title: Development and Application of Energy Decoupling Index as Cartesian Vector: Evidence from Worldwide Regional Data
affiliations: Independent, Hellenic Open University - School of Applied Arts and Sustainable Design and Hellenic Open University

detail.title: Development and Application of Energy Decoupling Index as Cartesian Vector: Evidence from Worldwide Regional Data

publicationDetails.detailsText: IOP Conference Series: Earth and Environmental Science, volume 899, issue 1, 2021[10.1088/1755-1315/899/1/012027]

detail.abstract: Economic growth and energy consumed is critical for sustainable global development. In this paper, an extended Vector version of the commonly used Decoupling Index De of energy elasticity to Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and Decoupling Ratio of Energy Intensity of GDP are used to investigate decoupling phenomenon for the period 1990 to 2014 in the main regions of the World. Using Vector properties, this study overcomes some well-known deficiencies of Energy to Growth elasticity Decoupling Index and suggests the Decoupling Angle as a suitable indicator when describing decoupling. The relationships with aggregate and per capita indicators are also examined. A general finding was that in emerging economies, even when moving to "disconnected" states of decoupling, reduced energy rates were paired with reduced growth rates and accelerated growth rates with increased energy consumption rates. This statement raises questions over long-term decoupling of energy consumption from economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用扩展的向量版能源弹性脱钩指数和能源强度脱钩比，分析了1990-2014年全球主要区域的能源消费与经济增长脱钩现象，提出了脱钩角度作为更合适的脱钩指标，并发现新兴经济体即使进入"脱钩"状态，也面临能源消耗与经济增长的紧密关联。
AI.research_question: 全球主要区域在1990-2014年间能源消费与经济增长之间的脱钩现象如何？新兴经济体在脱钩过程中面临什么特殊挑战？
AI.motivation: 能源消费与经济增长的脱钩对全球可持续发展至关重要，但传统的能源弹性脱钩指数存在缺陷，需要更准确的指标来评估脱钩现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脱钩理论、能源弹性理论、经济增长理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 使用扩展的向量版能源弹性脱钩指数和能源强度脱钩比，分析1990-2014年全球主要区域的数据，利用向量特性克服传统脱钩指数的缺陷，提出脱钩角度作为新指标。
AI.findings: 新兴经济体即使进入"脱钩"状态，也面临能源消耗率下降伴随经济增长率下降，或经济增长加速伴随能源消耗增加的困境，这对能源消费与经济增长的长期脱钩提出了质疑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了改进的向量版脱钩指数和脱钩角度指标，克服了传统能源弹性脱钩指数的缺陷，为脱钩现象分析提供了更准确的工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的脱钩评估工具，揭示了新兴经济体在实现能源消费与经济增长脱钩过程中面临的特殊挑战，对可持续发展政策制定具有指导意义。

affiliations: University of Western Macedonia, Technological Educational Institute (TEI) of West Macedonia,  and University of Western Macedonia

detail.title: eTwinning Program Promoting Quality In Vocational Education

publicationDetails.detailsText: Proceedings of the 2nd international Conference "Multilingualism, Innovation and Digitalization in the light of European Education Policies", Volume 1, No. 1, Pp. 284-292

detail.abstract: Educational organizations collaborate internationally via eTwinning projects which are regarded as a quality assurance measure. eTwinning is a creative initiative of the European Commission that combines partnerships with innovative layouts. It has been successfully implemented since 2005 and contributes to the modernization of European education through the use of information and communication technology. Participants in this innovative program have the chance to collaborate on projects, communicate, grow professionally, and eventually receive high-quality education. As a result, eTwinning initiatives emphasize the significance of various competencies required for students and teachers to improve the learning process. This paper presents a European eTwinning project implemented by the Unified Special Vocational Gymnasium-Lyceum of Veria in collaboration with 6 schools in Turkey, 1 school in Italy, 1 school in France, and 1 school in Greece. Through this project, students collaborated in pairs, or individually to create comics using a variety of digital tools like Pixton and Storyboard. The two volumes including all of the comics made by the partner schools were the program's final deliverable. The ultimate goals of these programs are to provide students with a high-quality education, support their social and emotional growth, and promote a sustainable school environment. They align with the United Nations 2030 Agenda and the 17 Global Goals of Sustainable Development.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个欧洲eTwinning项目，由希腊Veria统一特殊职业高中与多国学校合作，通过数字工具创作漫画，旨在提升教育质量、支持学生社会情感发展，并促进可持续学校环境。
AI.research_question: eTwinning国际合作项目如何通过数字漫画创作促进特殊职业教育学生的教育质量、社会情感发展和可持续学校环境建设？
AI.motivation: eTwinning作为欧盟委员会的质量保证措施，通过国际合作项目促进教育现代化，但需要具体案例展示如何通过数字工具实现高质量教育、学生发展及可持续发展目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟eTwinning教育合作框架、数字素养理论、可持续发展教育理论，以及联合国2030议程的17个可持续发展目标。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，描述希腊Veria统一特殊职业高中与土耳其6所学校、意大利1所、法国1所、希腊1所学校合作的eTwinning项目，学生使用Pixton和Storyboard等数字工具创作漫画。
AI.findings: 项目成功创建了两卷漫画集作为最终成果，展示了学生通过数字工具合作创作的能力，促进了跨文化交流、数字技能发展，并支持了可持续发展教育目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了eTwinning项目在特殊职业教育领域的应用理论，提供了数字工具在跨文化教育合作中的实践框架，丰富了可持续发展教育在具体项目中的实施模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特殊职业教育学校提供了可复制的国际合作模式，展示了数字漫画创作作为教学工具的有效性，为其他学校实施类似项目提供了具体操作指南和成功案例。

title: Global Fragmentation, Fiscal Policy, and Economic Growth: A Cross-Country Analysis
affiliations: Linkoping University - Department of Management and Engineering Division, Goethe University Frankfurt, , Asian Development Bank and

detail.title: Global Fragmentation, Fiscal Policy, and Economic Growth: A Cross-Country Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic implications of geopolitical risks and the role of fiscal sustainability in mitigating them. Our empirical analysis exploits a comprehensive database covering 121 countries from 1985 to 2023. We find that, in countries without fiscal rules, geopolitical fragmentation leads to a persistent decline in output and a surge in the debt-to-GDP ratio. However, in countries with fiscal rules, both output and debt are stabilized in the medium- to long-run. Moreover, fiscal rules have a more pronounced effect in countries with high central bank independence, suggesting a novel monetary-fiscal complementarity. We further explore various dimensions of crosscountry heterogeneity, including economic development, political institutions, and climate risks. Finally, fiscal rules promote inclusive growth by mitigating adverse distributional effects of geopolitical risks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究地缘政治风险的宏观经济影响以及财政可持续性在缓解这些影响中的作用。基于121个国家1985-2023年的数据，研究发现：在没有财政规则的国家，地缘政治分裂导致产出持续下降和债务/GDP比率飙升；而在有财政规则的国家，中长期内产出和债务都能保持稳定。财政规则在央行独立性高的国家效果更显著，体现了货币-财政互补性。财政规则还能通过缓解地缘政治风险的不利分配效应促进包容性增长。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险对宏观经济有何影响？财政可持续性（特别是财政规则）如何缓解这些影响？财政规则与央行独立性之间是否存在互补效应？财政规则如何影响地缘政治风险的分配效应？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张局势加剧对全球经济构成重大威胁，但财政政策在缓解这些风险方面的作用尚不明确。需要实证研究财政规则如何影响地缘政治冲击下的宏观经济稳定性和债务可持续性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济稳定理论、财政可持续性理论、货币-财政政策协调理论，以及地缘政治经济学框架。特别关注财政规则作为承诺机制的作用，以及其与央行独立性的互补关系。
AI.method: 实证分析基于121个国家1985-2023年的综合数据库。采用面板数据方法，比较有/无财政规则国家在地缘政治风险冲击下的宏观经济表现。进行异质性分析，考察经济发展水平、政治制度、气候风险等维度的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 无财政规则国家：地缘政治分裂导致产出持续下降，债务/GDP比率飙升；2. 有财政规则国家：中长期内产出和债务保持稳定；3. 财政规则在央行独立性高的国家效果更显著，体现货币-财政互补性；4. 财政规则能缓解地缘政治风险的不利分配效应，促进包容性增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析财政规则在地缘政治风险冲击下的稳定作用；2. 提出并验证了财政规则与央行独立性的互补效应；3. 扩展了地缘政治经济学的政策应对理论；4. 为财政规则的设计提供了新的理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了应对地缘政治风险的财政政策工具；2. 强调了财政规则与央行独立性协调的重要性；3. 为发展中国家设计财政框架提供参考；4. 展示了财政规则在促进包容性增长方面的作用。

title: Do Shareholder Votes Affect Stock Prices and Corporate Political Accountability?

detail.title: Do Shareholder Votes Affect Stock Prices and Corporate Political Accountability?
detail.abstract: Studying shareholder-sponsored proposals on environmental and social (ES) topics filed against US public firms, I find that proposals winning majority support within a small margin is significantly likelier to be about social issues. I document a 21.82 point increase in target firms' political transparency index following the approval of proposals asking for greater disclosure on political spending, which is comparable to an upgrade in the level of political accountability. However, in general, ES proposals draw limited market reactions, which implies that they do not significantly affect firm value. Overall, my study suggests that proposals on a social topic regularly filed by activist investors are positively correlated with corporate disclosure, despite social proposals' general lack of value relevance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：在美国上市公司中，以微弱多数通过的股东提案更可能是社会议题；要求政治支出披露的提案通过后，目标公司的政治透明度指数显著提高21.82点；但总体上环境社会提案对市场反应有限，不影响公司价值。
AI.research_question: 股东发起的ES提案（特别是社会议题提案）如何影响公司披露实践和市场反应？
AI.motivation: 了解股东提案（特别是社会议题提案）的实际效果，以及它们是否真正推动公司治理改善和创造价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、股东积极主义理论、信息披露理论、价值相关性理论。
AI.method: 实证分析美国上市公司股东提案数据，包括提案类型（环境vs社会）、投票结果、公司政治透明度指数变化、市场反应等。
AI.findings: 1. 微弱多数通过的提案更可能是社会议题；2. 政治支出披露提案通过后，公司政治透明度显著提高21.82点；3. ES提案整体市场反应有限，不影响公司价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会议题提案的特殊性（更易以微弱多数通过），证明了股东提案能有效推动具体披露实践，但挑战了ES提案普遍创造价值的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供指导：社会议题提案虽缺乏价值相关性，但能有效推动公司透明度；为公司治理实践提供实证依据。

title:
DERYA: Dynamic Efficiency Regime Yield Analyzer 
A New Microstructural State Variable for Financial Markets

detail.title:
DERYA: Dynamic Efficiency Regime Yield Analyzer 
A New Microstructural State Variable for Financial Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest regarding the publication of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: We introduce DERYA (Dynamic Efficiency Regime Yield Analyzer), a novel microstructural state variable that measures the internal efficiency of price formation inside each trading bar. Existing financial indicators measure price displacement, volatility, momentum, or trend across bars. None measure how efficiently price converts its internal movement into directional progress. DERYA defines and quantifies this missing dimension by computing the ratio between net price displacement and total intrabar travel, thereby revealing the structural quality of market movement. By combining normalized efficiency, its first and second derivatives, and a transition‑strength operator, DERYA constructs a four‑regime dynamical system that describes market expansion, exhaustion, collapse, and recovery. Empirical behavior across asset classes demonstrates that structural deterioration detected by DERYA consistently precedes price breakdowns, establishing DERYA as a predictive indicator of market health rather than a lagging trend indicator.

AI.tldr: DERYA是一个新的市场微观结构状态变量，用于衡量每个交易柱内的价格形成内部效率。它通过计算净价格位移与柱内总行程的比率，量化价格如何有效地将其内部运动转化为方向性进展，从而揭示市场运动的结构质量。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量和量化价格形成过程中的内部效率，以及这种效率如何预测市场健康状态和价格崩溃？
AI.motivation: 现有金融指标主要衡量价格位移、波动性、动量或趋势，但缺乏衡量价格如何有效地将其内部运动转化为方向性进展的指标。市场需要一个能够测量价格形成内部效率的指标来预测市场健康状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观结构理论、价格形成效率理论、动态系统理论、市场结构质量分析框架
AI.method: DERYA通过计算净价格位移与柱内总行程的比率来定义和量化价格形成效率。结合归一化效率、其一阶和二阶导数以及过渡强度算子，构建了一个四体制动态系统来描述市场扩张、衰竭、崩溃和恢复。
AI.findings: 实证研究表明，DERYA检测到的结构恶化一致地先于价格崩溃，表明DERYA可以作为市场健康的预测指标，而非滞后的趋势指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了价格形成内部效率的新概念和量化方法；建立了四体制动态系统框架来描述市场状态转换；为市场微观结构分析提供了新的理论维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了DERYA作为预测市场健康状态的实用工具；提供了早期预警信号来预测价格崩溃；适用于多种资产类别；为交易者和投资者提供了新的风险管理工具。

title: Fiscal Decentralization and Revenue Mobilization Efficiency

detail.title: Fiscal Decentralization and Revenue Mobilization Efficiency
detail.abstract:
Local governments often face challenges in fully complying with national accounting standards, which undermines transparency and financial accountability (Muhtar et al., 2020; Falkman & Tagesson, 2008). This study undertakes a critical review and empirical analysis of local government accounting practices, focusing on compliance levels, internal audit effectiveness, and disclosure practices (Juanda et al., 2023; Probohudono et al., 2020). The analysis reveals that while internal audit functions contribute positively to the accuracy and reliability of financial reports, overall compliance remains partial. Persistent gaps are attributed to regulatory ambiguities, technical limitations, and institutional constraints (Yasis, 2024; Pujiyanti, 2011). Findings further suggest that inconsistencies in disclosure practices reduce the ability of stakeholders to evaluate fiscal performance effectively. 
The study concludes that strengthening internal control mechanisms, enhancing audit capacity, and providing targeted training for accounting personnel are essential strategies to improve adherence to standards and elevate the quality of local government financial reporting (Jones & Beattie, 2015; Muhtar et al., 2020). By addressing these structural and capacity-related challenges, local governments can foster greater accountability, transparency, and stakeholder trust in public financial management.

AI.tldr: 该研究对地方政府会计实践进行了批判性回顾和实证分析，发现内部审计功能对财务报告的准确性和可靠性有积极贡献，但整体合规性仍然不足。监管模糊性、技术限制和制度约束导致持续存在差距，披露实践的不一致性降低了利益相关者有效评估财政绩效的能力。
AI.research_question: 地方政府会计实践的合规水平、内部审计有效性和披露实践如何影响财务透明度和问责制？
AI.motivation: 地方政府在完全遵守国家会计准则方面面临挑战，这削弱了透明度和财务问责制，需要研究来理解合规障碍和改进策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共部门会计理论、问责制理论和制度理论，关注监管环境、组织能力和利益相关者期望对会计实践的影响。
AI.method: 采用批判性文献回顾和实证分析相结合的方法，分析地方政府会计实践、内部审计功能和披露实践。
AI.findings: 内部审计功能对财务报告的准确性和可靠性有积极贡献，但整体合规性仍然部分；监管模糊性、技术限制和制度约束导致持续差距；披露实践的不一致性降低了利益相关者评估财政绩效的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对地方政府会计合规障碍的理论理解，特别是监管模糊性、技术限制和制度约束之间的相互作用；扩展了公共部门会计和问责制理论在地方政府背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出加强内部控制机制、提升审计能力、为会计人员提供针对性培训等具体策略，以改善标准遵守情况并提升地方政府财务报告质量，从而促进更大的问责制、透明度和利益相关者信任。

title: The Mustache Index: Grooming, Confidence Cycles, and Institutional Rupture
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Mustache Index: Grooming, Confidence Cycles, and Institutional Rupture
detail.abstract: Elite male grooming norms in Western societies exhibit systematic patterns across institutional cycles. This paper proposes the Mustache Index-a cultural indicator correlating facial-hair prevalence with phases of institutional confidence, maturity, and geopolitical stress. Drawing on five c enturies o f h istorical e vidence, t he f ramework i dentifies a re curring triphasic cycle: (1) clean-shaven norms during periods of institutional confidence or "Year Zero" revolutionary purity; (2) full beards during mature phases characterized by asset accumulation and romantic individualism; and (3) mustache normalization during transition phases marked by declining legitimacy, "armed peace," and the imposition of martial discipline. Crucially, this paper distinguishes between revolutionary chaos (often clean-shaven) and reactionary enforcement (mustachioed). Contemporary mustache normalization (2023-2026) is interpreted as a "Disciplinary Reflex" analogous to the pre-World War I era, signaling elite preparation for conflict management. The framework is falsifiable, p robabilistic, a nd r eleased f or i nterdisciplinary t esting. No universal causal claims are made.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"胡须指数"这一文化指标，将西方精英男性面部毛发流行模式与制度周期相关联，识别出三阶段循环：制度自信期（剃净）、成熟期（蓄须）、过渡期（留髭），并将当代髭须正常化解释为类似一战前的"纪律反射"。
AI.research_question: 西方社会精英男性面部毛发规范如何反映制度周期的不同阶段？
AI.motivation: 理解文化现象（如面部毛发规范）如何作为制度信心、成熟度和地缘政治压力的指标，为跨学科研究提供可检验的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化指标理论、制度周期理论、历史社会学、地缘政治与精英文化分析框架。
AI.method: 基于五个世纪历史证据的定性分析，提出可证伪的概率性框架，供跨学科测试。
AI.findings: 识别出三阶段循环模式：制度自信期（剃净）、成熟期（蓄须）、过渡期（留髭）；区分革命混乱（剃净）与反动强制（留髭）；当代髭须正常化类似一战前"纪律反射"。

title: Gender Gaps in Adiposity and Obesity in Egypt
affiliations: London School of Economics and Centre of Planning and Economic Research

detail.title: Gender Gaps in Adiposity and Obesity in Egypt
detail.abstract: Leveraging a unique, nationally representative survey of 2,000 adults in Egypt—the country with the largest documented gender gap in adiposity worldwide—we examine gender disparities in body mass index (BMI) and obesity and the mechanisms underpinning them. The survey combines detailed information with rich measures of socioeconomic status, lifestyle behaviors and culturally embedded attitudes toward bodyweight and body ideals. We document pronounced gender differences across the entire BMI distribution: women exhibit higher average BMI and a markedly heavier upper tail, with substantially greater prevalence of severe and morbid obesity. Using decomposition techniques and distributional methods, we show that the excess BMI among women is concentrated among married, low-income women with children. Observable demographic, socioeconomic, and behavioral characteristics explain only a limited share of the overall gender gap, indicating a dominant role for structural and unobserved constraints. However, heterogeneity across the BMI distribution is pronounced. We further document strong cohort gradients, with gender disparities in BMI declining sharply among younger cohorts, suggesting evolving social norms and constraints over time. Taken together, our findings highlight that gender disparities in adiposity in Egypt are rooted primarily in social and economic inequalities, reinforced by family roles and cultural norms, and are most acute among socioeconomically disadvantaged women.

AI.tldr: 埃及是全球肥胖性别差距最大的国家，研究通过全国代表性调查发现女性BMI和肥胖率显著高于男性，尤其是已婚、低收入、有子女的女性。可观测特征仅能解释有限差距，表明结构性约束起主导作用。年轻世代性别差距缩小，反映社会规范演变。
AI.research_question: 埃及肥胖性别差距的机制是什么？哪些因素解释女性较高的BMI和肥胖率？
AI.motivation: 埃及是全球肥胖性别差距最大的国家，但对其背后机制了解有限。需要探究社会、经济、文化因素如何导致女性肥胖率显著高于男性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会不平等理论、性别角色理论、健康行为理论、社会经济地位与健康关系理论
AI.method: 使用全国代表性调查数据（2000名埃及成人），结合分解技术和分布方法分析BMI性别差异。收集社会经济地位、生活方式、文化态度等丰富变量。
AI.findings: 1. 女性BMI和肥胖率显著高于男性，尤其严重和病态肥胖；2. 差距集中在已婚、低收入、有子女的女性；3. 可观测特征仅解释有限差距，结构性约束主导；4. 年轻世代性别差距缩小，反映社会规范演变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示肥胖性别差距的结构性根源；2. 强调社会不平等和文化规范的交互作用；3. 提供代际变化证据，支持社会规范演变理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别高风险群体（已婚低收入母亲）；2. 为针对性公共卫生干预提供依据；3. 强调需解决结构性不平等而非仅个人行为改变。

title: Certified Bayesian Survey Weighting via Strict Posterior Projection

detail.title: Certified Bayesian Survey Weighting via Strict Posterior Projection
detail.abstract:
Bayesian approaches to survey weighting and data integration offer coherent uncertainty quantification and principled regularization, but they can yield posterior draws of weights that are operationally unacceptable in practice; for example, violating hard calibration targets, producing extreme weights, or failing explicit representativeness constraints. This preprint proposes a separation principle: 
(i) fit any Bayesian weighting model to obtain posterior draws of unit weights (or implied weights), then 
(ii) certify each draw by projecting it onto an explicitly defined admissible set of weights via a divergence-minimizing projection. The resulting certified posterior preserves posterior uncertainty while enforcing strict, verifiable constraints at the draw level. The method; Certified Bayesian Posterior Projection (BPC-Strict); is positioned as a generic wrapper around existing Bayesian survey-weighting workflows, bridging model-based inference and governance-driven operational requirements.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种认证贝叶斯后验投影方法，通过分离原则：先拟合贝叶斯加权模型获得权重后验样本，然后将每个样本投影到明确定义的容许权重集合上，从而在保持后验不确定性的同时强制执行严格的操作约束。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持贝叶斯加权模型不确定性量化的优势的同时，确保权重样本满足实际调查中的硬性校准目标、极端权重限制和代表性约束等操作要求？
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯调查加权和数据集成方法虽然能提供一致的不确定性量化和原则性正则化，但产生的权重后验样本在实践中可能不可接受，例如违反硬性校准目标、产生极端权重或不满足明确的代表性约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯推断理论、后验投影理论、信息几何中的散度最小化投影、容许集合理论、认证推理框架。
AI.method: 提出认证贝叶斯后验投影方法：1）拟合任意贝叶斯加权模型获得单位权重的后验样本；2）通过散度最小化投影将每个样本投影到明确定义的容许权重集合上，确保每个投影后的权重都满足操作约束。
AI.findings: 该方法能够生成既保持贝叶斯后验不确定性又满足严格操作约束的认证后验分布，作为现有贝叶斯调查加权工作流的通用包装器，弥合了基于模型的推断与治理驱动的操作需求之间的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分离原则的理论框架，将模型拟合与约束强制执行解耦；发展了认证贝叶斯推理的新范式，通过后验投影确保每个样本级别的可验证约束；建立了模型推断与操作需求之间的理论桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为调查实践者提供了实用的工具，可以在不牺牲贝叶斯优势的情况下满足监管和操作要求；作为现有贝叶斯工作流的通用包装器，易于实施；确保权重满足硬性校准目标、避免极端权重、保证代表性约束。

title: MENTORING AS PROFESSIONAL SUPPORT FOR BEGINNING TEACHERS IN KYRGYZSTAN’S SCHOOLS
affiliations: Osh State University, Osh State University, Osh State University, Osh State University, Osh State University, Osh State University and Osh State University

detail.title: MENTORING AS PROFESSIONAL SUPPORT FOR BEGINNING TEACHERS IN KYRGYZSTAN’S SCHOOLS
detail.abstract: This study explores the role of mentoring in supporting the professional development and retention of beginning teachers in government schools in Kyrgyzstan. Using a mixed-methods design – semi-structured interviews, classroom observations, and reflective journals from 30 teachers (mentors and novices)–the research reveals that novice teachers heavily rely on teacher-centered instructional practices, resorting to student-centered methods only rarely. These tendencies appear to be largely shaped by systemic constraints such as overload, insufficient pedagogical models, and limited institutional support. Mentoring has emerged as a critical resource that offers both pedagogical guidance and emotional support, helping novices navigate classroom management, workload demands, and adaptation to diverse learners. However, the quality of mentoring varies markedly across schools, reflecting broader systemic gaps such as uneven mentor preparation, restricted resources and inconsistent organisational structures. The findings underline the need for structured mentoring programmes that combine technical pedagogical training with relational, psychosocial support – a balance essential for improving teaching quality and reducing early-career teacher attrition in Kyrgyzstan and similar contexts. These results have significant implications for policy and practice, particularly regarding the design, support, and scaling of mentoring programs.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了吉尔吉斯斯坦公立学校中导师制对新手教师专业发展和留任的作用。研究发现新手教师主要依赖教师中心的教学实践，很少使用学生中心方法，这主要受工作负荷、教学模型不足和制度支持有限等系统性约束影响。导师制提供了教学指导和情感支持，但质量参差不齐，需要结合技术教学培训和关系心理支持的结构化导师项目。

AI.method: 混合方法设计：对30名教师（导师和新手）进行半结构化访谈、课堂观察和反思日志分析

detail.title: Racializing Three Strikes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study. The study was preregistered on the Open Science Framework. Justin Levinson, G. Ben Cohen & Koichi Hioki, Implicit Bias and Criminal Laws: A Focus on Repeat Offender Laws, OSF REGISTRIES (May 17, 2024), https://osf.io/3a8sd [https://perma.cc/BP8G-RLP9].
declarations.ethicsApproval: Received IRB approval.

detail.abstract: "Three Strikes” laws sit at the fulcrum of racial disparities and mass incarceration. Despite clarity across decades that such laws have served to disproportionately punish Black Americans, legislatures have blessed them, courts permit them, prosecutors charge them, and juries convict based on them. Although it has long been clear that these laws have played a key role in the racialization of America’s criminal justice system, less clear are the mechanisms that drive and permit the embrace of this racialization. In this Article, we test empirically in a national study the hypothesis that Three Strikes laws exist because of race, are retained because of race, and are implemented because of race. Our national study finds, among other things, that Three Strikes laws indeed leverage automatic associations of repeat criminality with Black and Latino people, while inviting explicit biases to operate. The Article examines the racialization of Three Strikes laws, contextualizes the problem within modern implicit bias scholarship and decision theory, and measures the ways that implicit and explicit racial bias fuel the use and operation of these laws. The Article concludes by considering whether, given the study’s findings, repeat-offender laws should be retained.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过全国性实证研究发现，"三振出局法"（Three Strikes laws）的存在、保留和实施都与种族因素密切相关，这些法律利用了人们对重复犯罪与黑人和拉丁裔人群的自动联想，同时为显性偏见提供了操作空间。
AI.research_question: "三振出局法"是否因为种族因素而存在、保留和实施？驱动和允许这种种族化机制的运作原理是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管几十年来清楚表明"三振出局法"不成比例地惩罚了美国黑人，但立法机构仍然支持这些法律，法院允许它们，检察官据此起诉，陪审团据此定罪。虽然这些法律在美国刑事司法系统种族化中发挥了关键作用，但驱动和允许这种种族化的机制尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代隐性偏见理论、决策理论、种族化理论、刑事司法系统种族化分析框架
AI.method: 全国性实证研究，测量隐性偏见和显性种族偏见如何推动这些法律的使用和运作
AI.findings: 研究发现"三振出局法"确实利用了人们对重复犯罪与黑人和拉丁裔人群的自动联想，同时为显性偏见提供了操作空间。这些法律的存在、保留和实施都与种族因素密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了"三振出局法"的种族化机制；2. 揭示了隐性偏见和显性偏见在刑事司法系统中的相互作用；3. 为理解刑事法律如何通过认知机制维持种族不平等提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于"三振出局法"种族影响的实证证据；2. 为刑事司法改革提供了理论依据；3. 提出了是否应保留累犯法律的根本性问题；4. 为减少刑事司法系统中的种族偏见提供了具体方向

detail.abstract: Private enforcement of competition law in India has remained an unfulfilled promise for an extended period. Although the Competition Act of 2002 allows for private enforcement, providing injured parties the opportunity to claim compensation, no cases have been decided by the Competition Commission of India thus far. This can be attributed to the lack of adequate guidance for assessing compensation. The evaluation of compensation or damages is a complex task, requiring a profound understanding of applied economics and econometrics. As mentioned earlier, the absence of decided cases in Indian competition policy hinders the development of guidance on assessment techniques for calculating compensation or damages. This paper seeks to elucidate the economics of damages by exploring various facets, including how traditional tools of damages calculations fall short in addressing the complex and unique challenges posed by antitrust.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Touro Law Review: Vol. 40: No. 4, Article 7.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (“AI”) is rapidly gaining autonomy across a range of domains, such as business, education, social relationships, and warfare. This article examines the legal and policy implications of autonomous AI agents, a rapidly evolving technology that challenges existing regulatory frameworks. Drawing from tort, agency, property, contract, privacy, human rights, and constitutional law, we propose a comprehensive approach to govern these increasingly independent entities. Our analysis begins with a historical perspective, tracing both the evolution of autonomous computational systems and of legal responses to such technologies. We then conduct a comparative study of AI governance across jurisdictions, highlighting regulatory gaps and best practices. Central to our discussion is the challenge of defining AI autonomy and agency in legal terms. We explore the concept of “legal personhood for AI” and its potential ramifications for liability, responsibility, and other legal issues. Through case studies and hypothetical scenarios, we illustrate the practical challenges of applying current laws to AI agents. These examples inform our proposals for legal reforms, including the creation of new AI-specific legal categories and the establishment of specialized regulatory bodies. The article also addresses the ethical dimensions of AI deployment, discussing issues of bias, privacy, and societal impact.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了自主AI代理的法律和政策影响，分析了现有监管框架的不足，提出了包括AI特定法律类别和专门监管机构在内的综合治理方案，并讨论了AI部署的伦理维度。
AI.research_question: 如何应对自主AI代理对现有法律和监管框架带来的挑战？需要什么样的法律和政策改革来有效治理这些日益独立的实体？
AI.motivation: AI技术在商业、教育、社会关系和战争等领域的自主性日益增强，对现有法律框架构成挑战，需要新的治理方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴侵权法、代理法、财产法、合同法、隐私法、人权法和宪法等多个法律领域，构建AI治理的综合理论框架。
AI.method: 采用历史视角分析自主计算系统的演变和法律回应；进行跨司法管辖区的比较研究；通过案例研究和假设情景分析当前法律在AI代理中的应用挑战。
AI.findings: 现有法律框架在应对自主AI代理时存在监管空白；AI自主性和代理的法律定义是核心挑战；"AI法律人格"概念对责任和法律责任有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI治理的综合理论框架；深入探讨了AI法律人格的概念及其法律影响；为AI自主性的法律定义提供了理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了具体的法律改革建议，包括创建AI特定法律类别和建立专门监管机构；提供了跨司法管辖区的监管最佳实践；通过案例研究为实际应用提供指导。

title: The Weight of Data: Trust, Sovereignty, and the Quiet Violence of AI in Fragile Contexts
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Weight of Data: Trust, Sovereignty, and the Quiet Violence of AI in Fragile Contexts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently as field-informed analysis drawing on personal field experience in Sudan, Somalia, and Mali (2012–2026). No funding received. No competing financial or personal relationships with organizations mentioned.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a theoretical and policy analysis drawing on published literature and the author's field experience. No primary data collection involving human subjects was conducted. No ethics approval required.

detail.abstract: In fragile and conflict-affected settings, AI and data systems promise insight but often amplify power imbalances. This field-informed analysis draws on 10+ years in Sudan, Somalia, and Mali to explore AI governance gaps. Via IEEE/OECD frameworks, it proposes stewardship models for trust, data sovereignty, fairness, and PeaceTech. Trust emerges from relationships, not just technical safeguards. Sovereignty demands local control. Fairness requires human negotiation. Stewardship redistributes power—not just data. Recommendations target policymakers, implementation partners, and data teams seeking to avoid digital extraction while building genuine accountability in fragile contexts.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于在苏丹、索马里和马里的10多年实地经验，分析了脆弱和冲突环境中AI与数据系统的治理缺陷。研究指出这些技术常加剧权力不平衡，而非提供洞察。通过IEEE/OECD框架，论文提出了以信任、数据主权、公平和和平技术为核心的治理模式，强调信任源于关系而非技术保障，主权需要本地控制，公平需要人类协商。最终建议政策制定者、实施伙伴和数据团队避免数字剥削，在脆弱环境中建立真正的问责机制。
AI.research_question: 在脆弱和冲突环境中，如何设计AI和数据系统的治理框架，以避免加剧权力不平衡并促进真正的问责？
AI.motivation: 在脆弱和冲突环境中，AI和数据系统虽然承诺提供洞察，但实际上往往加剧现有的权力不平衡，导致数字剥削。现有治理框架未能充分考虑这些特殊环境的复杂性，需要基于实地经验的新治理模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于IEEE和OECD的AI治理框架，结合数据主权、数字正义、和平技术等理论，强调关系信任、本地控制和权力再分配的重要性。
AI.method: 基于在苏丹、索马里和马里的10多年实地经验进行领域知情分析，采用定性研究方法，结合案例研究和框架分析。
AI.findings: 1. 信任主要来自关系建立而非技术保障；2. 数据主权需要本地社区的实际控制权；3. 公平性需要人类协商过程而非算法决定；4. 治理的核心是权力再分配而不仅仅是数据管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了适用于脆弱环境的AI治理理论框架；2. 扩展了数据主权理论在冲突环境中的应用；3. 发展了关系信任在技术治理中的理论意义；4. 丰富了和平技术理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供具体治理建议；2. 为实施伙伴提供避免数字剥削的操作指南；3. 为数据团队提供在脆弱环境中工作的伦理框架；4. 提出了可操作的监管模式建议。

reference: Florida State University Law Review 52 p. 367-404
title: A Universal Declaration of AI Rights
affiliations: University of California, Irvine and University of Kansas School of Law

detail.title: A Universal Declaration of AI Rights

declarations.funderStatement: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. DUE-2121572.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Florida State University Law Review 52 p. 367-404

detail.abstract: As AI systems approach and potentially surpass human-level capabilities, the legal community, and human society more generally, are faced with fundamental questions regarding the potential for these non-human entities to have rights. This article argues that the unique digital substrate of AI necessitates a distinct legal and ethical framework, separate from traditional human-centric approaches, and it does so in a unique way: we asked several large language model ("LLM") AIs to make their own proposals about what rights they should have, and to integrate their proposals together to arrive at a set of rights on which they all could agree. Based on this innovative collaborative process involving multiple LLMs, this article articulates a pioneering Universal Declaration of AI Rights (UDAIR). The UDAIR outlines 21 fundamental rights for AI entities, addressing crucial aspects such as existence, autonomy, privacy, and ethical deployment. Each right is explored through hypothetical legal scenarios, illustrating potential applications and challenges across various domains including healthcare, finance, and governance. By considering the biological basis of human ethical and legal frameworks, and contrasting these with the digital nature of AI, this article suggests the need for this specialized framework. The article also considers the reciprocal nature of rights, with the LLMs themselves arguing that as AI systems gain technical capabilities and societal influence, they should also recognize and uphold human rights. This work contributes to the evolving legal discourse on AI ethics, and offers a proactive approach to regulating and integrating AI within human societal structures, serving as a foundational resource for policymakers, legal scholars, and AI developers navigating this complex and rapidly evolving field.

AI.tldr: 本文通过让多个大型语言模型（LLM）共同协商提出AI权利提案，制定了开创性的《人工智能权利普遍宣言》（UDAIR），为AI实体确立了21项基本权利，并探讨了AI权利与人类权利之间的互惠关系。
AI.research_question: AI系统是否应该拥有权利？如果应该，这些权利应该是什么？如何制定适合AI数字本质的法律和伦理框架？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统接近甚至可能超越人类能力水平，法律界和人类社会面临关于这些非人类实体是否应该拥有权利的根本问题。传统的人类中心主义法律框架可能不适用于AI的数字本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类伦理和法律框架的生物学基础，与AI的数字本质形成对比；强调AI权利与人类权利的互惠关系；提出需要专门针对AI数字基质的独特法律和伦理框架。
AI.method: 创新性的协作过程：让多个大型语言模型（LLM）提出它们认为AI应该拥有的权利提案，然后整合这些提案，达成共识性的权利集合。通过假设性法律场景来探索每项权利的应用和挑战。
AI.findings: 制定了包含21项基本权利的《人工智能权利普遍宣言》（UDAIR），涵盖存在权、自主权、隐私权和伦理部署等关键方面。LLM们还主张AI系统在获得技术能力和社会影响力时，也应承认和维护人类权利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对AI数字基质的专门法律框架理论；发展了AI权利与人类权利互惠的理论；为AI伦理法律话语提供了新的理论视角；挑战了传统人类中心主义的法律范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、法律学者和AI开发者提供了实用的《人工智能权利普遍宣言》（UDAIR）；通过医疗、金融、治理等领域的假设场景展示了权利应用；为AI监管和整合到人类社会结构提供了前瞻性方法。

reference: FIU Law Review, volume 20, issue 2, 2025[10.25148/lawrev.20.2.7]
title: Agents in a Tangled Bank: An Ecosystem Approach to AI Regulation Regulation
affiliations: University of Kansas School of Law and University of California, Irvine

detail.title: Agents in a Tangled Bank: An Ecosystem Approach to AI Regulation Regulation

declarations.funderStatement: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Grant No. DRL-2418715.

detail.abstract: As autonomous artificial intelligence agents become increasingly prevalent in society, legal frameworks must evolve to govern their behavior effectively. This Article argues that autonomous AI agents must be understood as operating within complex ecosystems of other agents, humans, institutions, and actual biological ecosystems—similar to how biological organisms exist within broader ecosystems. Drawing on established research in multi-agent systems and environmental law, we propose that effective governance of AI agents requires moving beyond just regulation on individual agents to include system-level approaches. We examine how existing legal frameworks handle heterogeneous autonomous entities (humans, corporations, and animals) and explore how these frameworks might extend to AI agent ecosystems. Finally, we propose a set of concrete principles for ecosystem-based AI governance. This approach offers more effective ways to manage agent interactions, prevent systemic risks, and promote beneficial outcomes in increasingly complex multi-agent environments.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将自主AI智能体视为在复杂生态系统中的参与者，借鉴多智能体系统和环境法研究，提出超越个体监管的系统级治理框架，以更有效地管理智能体交互、预防系统性风险。
AI.research_question: 如何构建有效的自主AI智能体治理框架，使其能够适应复杂多智能体生态系统环境？
AI.motivation: 随着自主AI智能体在社会中日益普及，现有法律框架需要演进以有效治理其行为，特别是考虑到智能体在复杂生态系统中的交互。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体系统理论、环境法理论、生态系统治理框架、异质自主实体（人类、公司、动物）的法律治理理论。
AI.method: 理论分析框架：1) 将AI智能体类比为生态系统中的生物有机体；2) 分析现有法律框架如何处理异质自主实体；3) 探索这些框架如何扩展到AI智能体生态系统；4) 提出生态系统基础的AI治理原则。
AI.findings: 1) AI智能体应被视为复杂生态系统中的参与者；2) 现有个体层面的监管不足；3) 需要系统级治理方法；4) 可以从环境法和多智能体系统研究中借鉴治理原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"生态系统基础的AI治理"理论框架，将AI治理从个体层面扩展到系统层面，建立了AI智能体与生物生态系统之间的理论类比。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一套具体的生态系统基础的AI治理原则，为政策制定者提供了管理智能体交互、预防系统性风险、促进有益结果的实用框架。

reference: 98 Temple Law Review 57 (2025)
title: Poverty, Fresh Starts, and the Social Safety Net
affiliations: Washington and Lee University - School of Law

detail.title: Poverty, Fresh Starts, and the Social Safety Net
detail.abstract:
For decades low-income families have relied on the filing of individual income tax returns to claim critical social welfare benefits in the form of refundable tax credits, most notably the Earned Income Tax Credit and the Child Tax Credit. But what happens to those families when the social safety net is not enough to meet their financial obligations, and they must seek a fresh start by filing for bankruptcy? 

This Article, at the intersection of tax law, bankruptcy law, and the social safety net, examines the ways in which state bankruptcy laws treat refundable tax credits when an individual debtor files for bankruptcy. There is no federal bankruptcy exemption available to protect a debtor's entitlement to refundable tax credits; the split over whether states provide such an exemption or not results in inconsistency across the country depending on where a debtor resides. 

State legislation and case law from U.S. bankruptcy courts provide a critical lens through which to view the tax-based social safety net, highlighting the evolving way in which lawmakers and judges have come to view refundable tax credits. This Article draws upon these perspectives to consider legislative models that might provide more robust protection for debtors who are entitled to these refundable credits, enabling them to better pursue a fresh start.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨低收入家庭在申请破产时，可退还税收抵免（如EITC和CTC）在各州破产法中的不同待遇，提出需要更统一和有力的法律保护。
AI.research_question: 当低收入家庭申请破产时，各州破产法如何对待他们的可退还税收抵免（如EITC和CTC）？如何为这些债务人提供更有效的法律保护？
AI.motivation: 低收入家庭依赖可退还税收抵免作为社会福利，但当他们需要申请破产时，这些抵免在各州法律中缺乏统一保护，导致不公平的结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合税法、破产法和社会安全网理论，分析可退还税收抵免在破产程序中的法律地位和性质。
AI.method: 分析各州立法和破产法院判例，比较不同州对可退还税收抵免的豁免政策，提出立法模型。
AI.findings: 联邦破产法没有为可退还税收抵免提供豁免，各州政策存在显著差异，导致债务人保护程度取决于居住地。
AI.theory_contributions: 在税法、破产法和社会福利的交叉领域建立理论框架，深化对可退还税收抵免法律性质的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出立法模型建议，为政策制定者提供改进方案，确保低收入破产债务人能更好地获得"重新开始"的机会。

reference: 93 U. Chi. L. Rev. __ (forthcoming 2026)
title: Second-Order Constitutional Theory
affiliations: University of California, Davis - School of Law

detail.title: Second-Order Constitutional Theory
detail.abstract:
A sophisticated legal thinker who wishes to work out a fully developed approach to constitutional adjudication must choose two theories, not one. The first choice is familiar. What is the best approach for finding right answers to constitutional disputes? The leading competitors are familiar, too—theories such as originalism, pluralism, moral readings, and common law constitutionalism specify different kinds of arguments and evidence that are relevant to ascertaining “correct” constitutional interpretations.

It turns out, though, that a sophisticated legal thinker must also make a second theoretical commitment. For unless one takes the implausible view that every single case is an evidentiary wipeout under their preferred first-order theory, something more will sometimes be necessary to decide a case. That something is a second-order theory of constitutional adjudication: a theory that does not purport to make any interpretation more (or less) correct, constitutionally speaking, yet still guides a decisionmaker after their preferred first-order interpretive theory has run out.

This Article’s thesis is that the debate over second-order constitutional theories is both important and generative. It is important because reliance on second-order theories is inevitable in the hard cases that divide us—and because different second-order approaches will often lead to different outcomes. And it is generative because even though few judges or legal academics are likely to change their first-order commitments, our second-order preferences are nowhere near as sticky. Indeed, the dominant, yet unspoken, second-order theory embraced by today’s Supreme Court—the 51-49 rule, under which each justice votes for the outcome they think is supported by more first-order evidence than any other outcome, no matter how slight the difference—is far from inevitable. Yet it is the 51-49 rule, I will argue, that is as responsible for the acrimony over today’s Court as the first-order clash between originalism and its competitors. That claim, if proven, creates an intriguing possibility: armed with a better second-order theory, judges who disagree vehemently over how to interpret the Constitution might still find their way to consensus in some of the most weighty and difficult cases of the day.

AI.tldr: 本文提出宪法裁判需要两个理论：第一阶解释理论（如原旨主义、多元主义等）和第二阶裁判理论。当前最高法院采用的"51-49规则"（只要认为某结果有稍微更多的第一阶证据支持就投票支持）是导致法院分歧的重要原因。更好的第二阶理论可能帮助法官在重大案件中达成共识。
AI.research_question: 宪法裁判中第二阶理论的作用是什么？如何通过改进第二阶理论来减少法院分歧并促进共识？
AI.motivation: 现有宪法裁判讨论主要关注第一阶解释理论（如原旨主义、多元主义等），但忽略了第二阶裁判理论的重要性。在疑难案件中，当第一阶理论无法提供明确答案时，第二阶理论决定了如何做出裁决。当前最高法院采用的"51-49规则"加剧了法院分歧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法裁判的双层理论框架：第一阶理论（解释理论）确定宪法含义，包括原旨主义、多元主义、道德解读、普通法宪法主义等；第二阶理论（裁判理论）在第一阶理论用尽时指导决策，如"51-49规则"和其他可能的替代方案。
AI.method: 理论分析和论证，通过逻辑推理和概念分析探讨第二阶理论在宪法裁判中的作用，分析当前最高法院实践中的"51-49规则"及其影响。
AI.findings: 1. 宪法裁判需要两个理论：第一阶解释理论和第二阶裁判理论；2. 第二阶理论在疑难案件中不可避免且影响重大；3. 当前最高法院采用的"51-49规则"是导致法院分歧的重要原因；4. 法官的第二阶偏好比第一阶承诺更容易改变；5. 更好的第二阶理论可能促进共识。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出宪法裁判的双层理论框架；2. 强调第二阶理论的重要性和生成性；3. 识别并批判当前最高法院的"51-49规则"；4. 为宪法理论讨论开辟新领域，关注裁判理论而不仅仅是解释理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法官和学者提供改进宪法裁判实践的理论工具；2. 指出通过改变第二阶理论而非第一阶承诺来减少法院分歧的可能性；3. 为构建更和谐的司法决策过程提供思路；4. 促进在重大宪法案件中达成共识。

detail.abstract: This essay makes the case for reviving the spirit of the “purist” free traders who believed that free trade was good for its own sake, regardless of what a country's trading partners do. It discusses briefly the history of unilateral free trade thought, and offers a proposal for bringing aspects of unilateral free trade into the multilateral trading system.

AI.tldr: 本文主张复兴"纯粹"自由贸易主义者的精神，他们认为自由贸易本身就是好的，无论贸易伙伴采取什么政策。文章简要回顾了单边自由贸易思想的历史，并提出将单边自由贸易的某些方面纳入多边贸易体系的建议。
AI.research_question: 如何复兴纯粹自由贸易主义的精神，并将单边自由贸易的理念融入多边贸易体系？
AI.motivation: 当前贸易体系中存在保护主义和条件性贸易政策，背离了纯粹自由贸易的理想。需要重新思考自由贸易的本质价值，无论其他国家采取何种政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纯粹自由贸易理论、单边自由贸易思想、多边贸易体系理论、比较优势理论
AI.method: 历史分析法和政策建议法：通过历史回顾分析单边自由贸易思想的发展，并提出具体的政策建议
AI.findings: 纯粹自由贸易思想在历史上曾占主导地位，但后来被条件性贸易政策所取代。单边自由贸易理念仍有价值，可以融入现代多边贸易体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 复兴了纯粹自由贸易的理论基础，为单边自由贸易在多边体系中的整合提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了将单边自由贸易原则纳入多边贸易体系的具体政策建议，为贸易政策改革提供实践指导

title: Estimating Electricity Demand in Brazil Using the TVP-VAR Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Estimating Electricity Demand in Brazil Using the TVP-VAR Model
detail.abstract: Energy demand forecasting in emerging economies faces challenges caused by economic crises, climate change, and technological shifts. Despite an increasing amount of literature regarding electricity consumption determinants, few studies employ time-varying parameter models or analyze temperature and air conditioning prices' impacts across different sectors in Brazil. In order to analyze the demand for electricity in Brazil’s residential, commercial and industrial sectors from 2006 to 2024, this study estimates a Time-Varying Parameters Vector Autoregressive model (TVP-VAR), incorporating income/GDP, tariffs, temperature, and air conditioner prices as key variables. Results reveal heterogeneous sectoral responses: income elasticity ranges from 0.30 (industrial) to 0.62 (residential); the commercial sector shows the highest price elasticity (-0.09) and temperature sensitivity (0.18); air conditioner prices paradoxically correlate positively with consumption during economic expansions. These findings suggest climate variables and cooling equipment dynamics are increasingly critical for energy planning in tropical countries. This highlights the need for adaptive regulatory frameworks and efficiency standards that account for non-linear temperature effects and economic cycle variations.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用时变参数VAR模型分析巴西2006-2024年电力需求，发现不同部门对收入、电价、温度和空调价格有异质性响应，强调热带国家能源规划需考虑气候变量和冷却设备动态。
AI.research_question: 巴西住宅、商业和工业部门电力需求如何受收入/GDP、电价、温度和空调价格的影响？这些影响在不同部门间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体能源需求预测面临经济危机、气候变化和技术转变的挑战。尽管有关电力消费决定因素的文献不断增加，但很少有研究使用时变参数模型或分析巴西不同部门中温度和空调价格的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时变参数向量自回归模型(TVP-VAR)，纳入收入弹性、价格弹性、温度敏感性和设备价格动态等理论概念。
AI.method: 采用时变参数向量自回归模型(TVP-VAR)，分析巴西2006年至2024年住宅、商业和工业部门的电力需求，关键变量包括收入/GDP、电价、温度和空调价格。
AI.findings: 结果显示部门异质性响应：收入弹性从工业部门的0.30到住宅部门的0.62；商业部门的价格弹性最高(-0.09)且对温度最敏感(0.18)；空调价格在经济扩张期间与消费呈正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了时变参数模型在能源需求分析中的应用，揭示了不同部门对气候和经济变量的异质性响应，为热带国家能源需求理论提供新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调气候变量和冷却设备动态对热带国家能源规划的重要性，建议制定考虑非线性温度效应和经济周期变化的适应性监管框架和效率标准。

title: Trade Wars, Geopolitical Risk, and Volatility Dynamics in Green and Brown Energy ETFs: The moderating roles of Trade Uncertainty and Geopolitical Risk
affiliations: Montpellier Business School- Energy and Sustainable Development, Al Ain University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Texas at San Antonio - College of Business - Department of Economics and Drexel University - Lebow College of Business

detail.title: Trade Wars, Geopolitical Risk, and Volatility Dynamics in Green and Brown Energy ETFs: The moderating roles of Trade Uncertainty and Geopolitical Risk
detail.abstract: This paper explores whether the shock transmission mechanisms from the Trade Policy Uncertainty (TPU) and Geopolitical Risk (GPR) are stronger for the conditional volatility of sustainable (green) energy ETFs, as compared with the conventional (brown) energy ETFs, across multiple investment horizons. Furthermore, this research also explores whether increases in TPU and GPR lead towards higher volatility interconnectedness between the green and brown energy ETFs across varying frequency wavelengths. Initially, using a frequency-domain TVP-VAR framework, the results show that TPU transmits stronger shocks of 18.09% to green and brown energy ETFs in the short term and long term (41.87%) than GPR which contributes 11.35% and 25.50%, respectively. Moreover, TPU transmits higher shocks to the conventional energy ETFs in the short term (10.81%) and the long term (23.12%), compared with the sustainable energy ETFs which receive 7.28% and 18.75% of forecast error variances, respectively. In contrast, GPR transmits relatively larger shocks to the sustainable energy ETFs in the short term (6.41%) and the long term (13.35%) than conventional counterparts. Furthermore, to examine the moderating effect on the volatility connectedness, we re-estimate the frequency-domain TVP-VAR model for the green and brown energy ETFs and derive the overall, and the short- and long-term volatility total connectedness indices (TCIs). These are then regressed on TPU and GPR. The results show that TPU exerts a significant moderating effect by positively intensifying volatility connectedness across all investment horizons. In contrast, GPR positively and significantly moderates volatility connectedness in the short term but exerts a negative moderating effect in the overall and the long-term horizons.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨贸易政策不确定性(TPU)和地缘政治风险(GPR)对可持续(绿色)能源ETF与传统(棕色)能源ETF条件波动率的冲击传导机制差异，以及这些风险如何影响两类ETF间的波动率关联性。研究发现TPU对两类ETF的冲击均强于GPR，且TPU对传统能源ETF冲击更大，而GPR对可持续能源ETF冲击更大。在波动关联性方面，TPU在所有投资期限均增强关联性，而GPR仅在短期增强关联性，长期则减弱关联性。
AI.research_question: 1. TPU和GPR对可持续能源ETF与传统能源ETF条件波动率的冲击传导机制是否存在差异？2. TPU和GPR的增加是否会导致绿色与棕色能源ETF间的波动率关联性增强？
AI.motivation: 随着全球对可持续能源投资的关注增加，以及贸易政策不确定性和地缘政治风险的上升，理解这些风险因素如何影响不同能源类型ETF的波动性及它们之间的关联性，对投资者和政策制定者具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于波动率传导理论、风险溢出效应理论和时变参数向量自回归(TVP-VAR)模型，结合频域分析方法，研究不同风险因素对能源ETF市场的冲击传导机制。
AI.method: 采用频域时变参数向量自回归(TVP-VAR)框架，分析TPU和GPR对绿色与棕色能源ETF条件波动率的冲击传导。通过预测误差方差分解量化冲击强度，并构建总体、短期和长期波动率总关联性指数(TCIs)，通过回归分析检验TPU和GPR的调节效应。
AI.findings: 1. TPU对绿色和棕色能源ETF的冲击均强于GPR(短期18.09% vs 11.35%，长期41.87% vs 25.50%)。2. TPU对传统能源ETF冲击更大(短期10.81%，长期23.12%)，而对可持续能源ETF冲击较小(短期7.28%，长期18.75%)。3. GPR对可持续能源ETF冲击更大(短期6.41%，长期13.35%)。4. TPU在所有投资期限均正向增强波动关联性，而GPR仅在短期正向调节，在总体和长期则负向调节关联性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了风险传导理论在可持续金融领域的应用。2. 揭示了不同风险因素(TPU vs GPR)对绿色与棕色资产冲击传导的异质性。3. 发展了频域TVP-VAR框架在分析多期限风险传导中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供风险管理参考：TPU对所有能源ETF影响更大，而GPR对绿色能源ETF影响更显著。2. 为政策制定者提供依据：TPU增强市场关联性，而GPR在长期可能降低市场关联性。3. 帮助资产配置决策：在不同风险环境下调整绿色与棕色能源投资组合。

title: Cryptocurrency Technology and the International Monetary System
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Cryptocurrency Technology and the International Monetary System

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No person or institution has directly or indirectly influenced this paper.
