reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12425
title: Elsewhere in North America: How U.S. Tariffs on China Boosted Mexico's Manufacturing Employment and Output
affiliations: Grinnell College

detail.title: Elsewhere in North America: How U.S. Tariffs on China Boosted Mexico's Manufacturing Employment and Output

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using administrative longitudinal firm- and plant-level data from Mexico that links manufacturing firms to their customs records and covers the period 2014–2023, I examine whether US tariffs targeting China have contributed to a manufacturing revival in the southern part of North America. Leveraging the abrupt shift in US trade policy as a natural experiment, and constructing firm-level trade policy exposure measures based on firms’ pre-shock trade portfolios at the product level, I show that higher US tariffs on China significantly increased manufacturing output and employment. Adjustment occurs along both intensive and extensive margins, through expansion of existing plants and the establishment of new manufacturing plants by incumbent firms. Foreign multinationals and their domestic affiliates operating under Mexico’s export platform, IMMEX, drive these gains in manufacturing output and jobs, with U.S.-headquartered firms making a particularly notable contribution. The employment response is concentrated among production workers and technicians, particularly in technology-intensive industries embedded in North American supply-chains. These findings provide firm-level evidence that heightened import protection in the United States has stimulated manufacturing activity elsewhere in North America — namely, in Mexico.

AI.tldr: 本文利用墨西哥企业级数据，通过自然实验方法发现美国对华关税显著促进了墨西哥制造业产出和就业增长，特别是外资企业和出口平台企业驱动了这一制造业复兴。
AI.research_question: 美国针对中国的关税政策是否促进了北美南部地区（墨西哥）的制造业复兴？
AI.motivation: 了解美国贸易保护政策如何影响北美地区制造业的地理分布和产业转移，特别是对墨西哥制造业的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策冲击、产业转移理论、自然实验方法、企业异质性理论
AI.method: 使用墨西哥2014-2023年企业和工厂层面的行政纵向数据，结合海关记录；利用美国贸易政策突变作为自然实验；构建基于企业事前贸易组合的产品层面贸易政策暴露指标；采用双重差分等因果推断方法。
AI.findings: 1. 美国对华关税显著增加了墨西哥制造业产出和就业；2. 调整通过集约边际（现有工厂扩张）和扩展边际（新建工厂）同时发生；3. 外资跨国企业及其在墨西哥出口平台（IMMEX）下的国内关联企业是主要驱动力量，特别是美国总部企业贡献显著；4. 就业增长集中在生产工人和技术人员，特别是在北美供应链中的技术密集型行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了贸易保护政策如何通过企业层面渠道影响产业地理分布的新证据；2. 揭示了外资企业在贸易政策冲击下的调整机制；3. 丰富了关于全球价值链重组和产业转移的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解贸易政策对制造业地理分布的影响提供实证依据；2. 为企业应对贸易政策变化提供战略参考；3. 为墨西哥等发展中国家吸引制造业投资提供政策启示。

title: Authorization as a Missing Layer in Digital Systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Authorization as a Missing Layer in Digital Systems
detail.abstract:
Digital systems have evolved increasingly powerful execution mechanisms without a corresponding
authority layer. As a result, actions are routinely executed without explicit, time-bound
authorization, producing systemic failure across finance, automation, artificial intelligence, and
human-facing software. This paper identifies authorization as a missing first-class layer beneath
execution in all digital systems. We argue that authorization must exist as an explicit, revocable,
time-scoped object independent of execution. We show that the absence of this layer explains a
wide range of coordination failures and demonstrate that recent financial systems provide a proof
domain in which authorization can be formalized prior to execution. This paper does not propose a
product or protocol; it names a layer that digital systems already assume but have never explicitly
modeled

AI.tldr: 该论文指出数字系统缺乏授权层，导致金融、自动化、AI等领域出现系统性故障。作者提出授权应作为执行层之下的独立、可撤销、有时间限制的显式层。
AI.research_question: 数字系统中授权层的缺失如何导致系统性协调失败？如何将授权作为执行层之下的独立、显式、可撤销、有时间限制的层来形式化？
AI.motivation: 数字系统的执行机制日益强大，但缺乏相应的授权层，导致金融、自动化、人工智能和面向人类的软件中普遍出现系统性故障。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 授权作为数字系统的基础层理论；2. 显式、可撤销、有时间限制的授权对象概念；3. 授权与执行分离的架构原则。
AI.method: 概念性分析：识别数字系统中授权层的缺失；理论论证：阐述授权作为独立层的必要性；案例研究：以金融系统为证明领域，展示授权可以形式化。
AI.findings: 1. 授权层的缺失解释了广泛的协调失败；2. 授权必须作为独立于执行的显式对象存在；3. 金融系统提供了授权可以形式化的证明领域；4. 数字系统隐含假设但从未明确建模这一层。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别并命名了数字系统中缺失的授权层；2. 提出了授权作为第一类层的理论框架；3. 建立了授权与执行分离的架构原则；4. 为数字系统设计提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为系统设计者提供了授权层设计的指导原则；2. 帮助识别和预防系统性协调故障；3. 为金融、自动化、AI等领域的系统改进提供了方向；4. 强调了显式授权在数字系统中的重要性。

title: Privacy as Contract?
affiliations: Boston University School of Law and George Washington University Law School

detail.title: Privacy as Contract?
detail.abstract:
Nearly everything people buy, every service they use, every account they create, and even every website they visit involves the collection, use, and transfer of personal data—a matter that is ostensibly governed by privacy notices (also called “privacy policies”). Privacy notices are the foundation of privacy regulation; most privacy laws rely on the existence of privacy notices as a central pillar. Various statutory rights and obligations are tied or limited by what is specified in privacy notices, including the scope and nature of the collection, use, and transfer of personal data.

On the surface, privacy notices seem like contracts. They feel promissory in nature and are central to the grand bargain between consumers and companies at the heart of surveillance capitalism. When companies break the promises they make in privacy notices, contract law (through regular contract or promissory estoppel) appears to be a tool that could empower consumers to seek redress. But this has rarely been the case. Privacy notices still exist in a weird twilight between a mere description of policy and a binding agreement. They are even strangely still separate documents from companies’ terms of use agreements. Despite nearly forty years after privacy notices emerged to become the dominant mechanism to address privacy issues, the question of how contract law applies to privacy notices has been only thinly addressed by courts.

In this Article, we argue that contract law is unsuitable for governing consumer privacy. The law of consumer contracts is too oblivious to power disparities, too focused on the individual at the expense of groups and society, and too infected with bogus conceptions of consent to serve as a viable foundation to govern privacy in consumer transactions. Applying contract law more robustly and consistently to privacy notices will not better protect consumers—in fact, it will worsen protection and exacerbate the significant power imbalance between companies and consumers.

Even with reforms, applying contract law to privacy notices will not lead to a desirable balance of power between companies and consumers. Current contract law lacks the right tools to address privacy issues; it is rooted far too deeply in an individual control model similar to the one that has failed spectacularly in privacy law.

Instead of being developed to colonize privacy, contract law should be subject to an internal revolution in how it handles transactions in the Digital Age. With the internet and digital technologies, contract doctrine has lost its way and functions mainly to enable companies to wield power unilaterally against consumers. The fundamental goals, scope, and structure of consumer contract law must be rethought to better address problems with consent, fairness, and power.

AI.tldr: 本文认为合同法不适合管理消费者隐私，因为合同法忽视权力差异、过度关注个体而忽视群体，且基于虚假的同意概念。将合同法更严格地应用于隐私通知不仅不会保护消费者，反而会加剧公司与消费者之间的权力不平衡。
AI.research_question: 合同法是否适合作为管理消费者隐私的法律框架？将合同法应用于隐私通知是否能有效保护消费者隐私权益？
AI.motivation: 隐私通知已成为隐私监管的核心机制，表面上看似合同，但合同法在隐私保护方面的应用非常有限。尽管隐私通知在消费者与公司关系中具有核心地位，但合同法是否适合管理隐私问题尚未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 合同法理论（特别是消费者合同法）2. 隐私监管理论 3. 权力不平衡理论 4. 同意理论 5. 个体控制模型批判
AI.method: 法律分析与批判性论证，通过对合同法原则、隐私通知性质、消费者保护现状的理论分析，提出规范性论点。
AI.findings: 1. 合同法不适合管理消费者隐私 2. 合同法忽视权力差异，过度关注个体 3. 合同法基于虚假的同意概念 4. 将合同法应用于隐私通知会恶化消费者保护 5. 当前合同法缺乏处理隐私问题的适当工具
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 批判了合同法在数字时代的局限性 2. 揭示了合同法与隐私保护的根本冲突 3. 提出了合同法需要内部革命的理论框架 4. 挑战了个体控制模型在隐私法中的主导地位
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供重新思考消费者合同法的基础 2. 警示将合同法应用于隐私通知的实际风险 3. 为消费者权益保护提供新的理论视角 4. 推动合同法在数字时代的改革方向

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence, New Face of Organized Cyber Crime and the Use of Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence, New Face of Organized Cyber Crime and the Use of Artificial Intelligence

declarations.funderStatement: This is a personal research project, funded by the author.

detail.abstract: In this paper we analyze the transformation of the digital landscape, highlighting how organized crime has evolved toward sophisticated business structures that leverage technology to execute lucrative and low-risk attacks. The text underlines the importance of Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) as an essential process based on data that allows organizations to convert gross information into decision strategies actionable steps to anticipate the criminals. A central theme of the document is the dual role of Artificial Intelligence (AI), which acts simultaneously as a powerful tool for improving automated detection and response, and as a weapon in the hands of attackers to create automated malware and fraud complexes. Finally, the author proposes a protection framework that combines the constant updating technique with the development of new human skills, emphasizing that collaboration and supervision technology ethics are fundamental to strengthening the security posture in the modern era.

AI.tldr: 本文分析数字环境转型，指出有组织犯罪已演变为利用技术执行高利润低风险攻击的复杂商业结构，强调网络威胁情报（CTI）作为基于数据的关键流程的重要性，探讨人工智能在网络安全中的双重角色（防御工具与攻击武器），并提出结合技术更新与人类技能发展的保护框架。
AI.research_question: 在数字环境转型背景下，有组织犯罪如何利用技术演变为复杂商业结构？网络威胁情报（CTI）如何帮助组织将原始信息转化为可操作的决策策略？人工智能在网络安全中扮演怎样的双重角色？如何构建有效的保护框架来应对现代网络威胁？
AI.motivation: 数字环境的快速转型使有组织犯罪演变为利用先进技术的复杂商业结构，执行高利润、低风险的网络攻击。组织需要有效应对这些威胁，但传统安全方法已不足以应对现代网络犯罪的复杂性，因此需要研究如何利用网络威胁情报和人工智能技术来加强网络安全防御。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络威胁情报（CTI）理论框架、人工智能在网络安全中的应用理论、组织犯罪转型理论、技术伦理框架、网络安全保护框架理论。
AI.method: 本文采用分析性研究方法，通过对数字环境转型和网络犯罪演变的文献分析，结合网络威胁情报（CTI）流程和人工智能技术的双重角色分析，提出综合性的保护框架建议。
AI.findings: 1. 有组织犯罪已演变为利用技术的复杂商业结构，执行高利润低风险攻击；2. 网络威胁情报（CTI）是将原始信息转化为可操作决策策略的关键流程；3. 人工智能在网络安全中具有双重角色：既是改进自动检测和响应的强大工具，也是攻击者创建自动化恶意软件和欺诈系统的武器；4. 有效的保护需要结合技术更新和人类技能发展，强调协作和技术伦理监督的重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对有组织犯罪在数字环境中的转型理论；2. 扩展了网络威胁情报（CTI）的理论框架；3. 提出了人工智能在网络安全中的双重角色理论；4. 构建了结合技术更新与人类技能发展的综合保护框架理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织提供了利用网络威胁情报（CTI）将信息转化为决策策略的实践指导；2. 帮助组织理解人工智能在网络安全中的双重应用；3. 提出了结合技术更新和人员技能发展的保护框架；4. 强调了协作和技术伦理监督在加强安全态势中的重要性。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12431
title: State Capacity and Identity: Assimilation vs Resistance of Tribal Rimlands
affiliations: University of California - Department of Economics and

detail.title: State Capacity and Identity: Assimilation vs Resistance of Tribal Rimlands

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: While the populations of wealthy modern states primarily identify with their nation, middle- and low-income countries often contain large populations that adhere to distinct subnational identities. We model a central government elite that has a conflictual relationship with its “tribal rimland.” Elites share a dominant national identity, while members of tribes may hold alternative identities, with identities conferring psychological payoffs. Elite investment in state capacity increases material production, strengthens incentives for members of tribes to adopt the national identity, and facilitates extraction from those who continue to adhere to their own identity. Tribes, meanwhile, are better able to resist when their strategies of resistance, collective organization, and identity status remain strong. Increased democratic representation does not necessarily favor the persistence of tribal identity relative to elite rule. The model is consistent with accounts of incorporation and resistance from both history and the present, ranging from the Scottish and Southeast Asian highlands to past and present indigenous societies in the Americas.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了一个理论模型，分析中央政府精英与"部落边缘地带"之间的冲突关系，探讨国家能力投资、身份认同转变和资源提取的相互作用机制。
AI.research_question: 在中等收入和低收入国家中，中央政府精英如何通过国家能力投资来影响部落群体的身份认同转变和资源提取？部落群体又如何在国家扩张面前维持其身份认同和抵抗能力？
AI.motivation: 富裕现代国家的人口主要认同国家身份，而中低收入国家往往存在大量持有不同次国家身份的人口。这种身份差异导致中央政府精英与部落边缘地带之间的冲突关系，需要理论模型来解释这种动态。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 身份认同理论：身份认同提供心理收益
2. 国家能力理论：国家投资增强物质生产和资源提取能力
3. 集体行动理论：部落的组织能力和抵抗策略
4. 民主代表理论：民主化不一定有利于部落身份认同的维持
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建中央政府精英与部落边缘地带冲突的正式模型，分析国家能力投资、身份认同转变、资源提取和抵抗策略之间的相互作用机制。
AI.findings:
1. 精英投资国家能力会增加物质生产，强化部落成员采纳国家身份的激励
2. 国家能力增强有助于从坚持自身身份的部落成员中提取资源
3. 部落的抵抗能力取决于其抵抗策略、集体组织和身份地位的强度
4. 增加民主代表不一定有利于部落身份相对于精英统治的持久性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了分析国家-部落冲突关系的理论框架
2. 整合了身份认同、国家能力和集体行动理论
3. 揭示了民主化不一定促进少数群体身份认同的维持
4. 提供了理解历史与当代边缘群体抵抗的理论工具
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解苏格兰、东南亚高地等历史案例提供分析框架
2. 有助于解释美洲原住民社会过去和现在的抵抗运动
3. 为政策制定者处理国家与部落关系提供理论参考
4. 揭示了国家建设过程中身份认同转变的复杂机制

title: Smart Contracts and Inventory-Based Financing in Supply Chains
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), University of Connecticut - Department of Operations & Information Management and University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)

detail.title: Smart Contracts and Inventory-Based Financing in Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Problem Definition: Inventory-based financing (IBF) enables capital-constrained retailers to pledge inventory for short-term loans, hedging liquidity risk after receiving products but before realizing sales. However, when initial financing is arranged before product receipt-whether through bank loans or trade credit-retailers cannot credibly commit to future IBF adoption. This timing gap creates commitment frictions: lenders cannot verify ex ante whether retailers will use IBF to mitigate liquidity shocks, leading to risk mispricing and inefficient financing terms. We examine whether blockchain-based smart contracts, which make post-receipt IBF decisions contractible and automatically enforceable, resolve these frictions and improve supply chain outcomes. Methodology/Results: We develop a game-theoretic model where a capital-constrained retailer obtains products from a manufacturer using either bank financing or trade credit, then decides whether to adopt IBF after receipt. We analyze equilibria under traditional contracts and compare outcomes when blockchain-based smart contracts make IBF decisions automatically enforceable based on observable conditions. Contrary to expectations, smart contracts can harm retailers despite resolving commitment frictions. Under bank financing with moderate liquidity risk, incomplete contracts enable a profitable equilibrium: manufacturers strategically distort wholesale prices to signal IBF adoption, convincing banks to offer lower rates that benefit both supply chain parties. Smart contracts eliminate this signaling channel, redistributing surplus to manufacturers. Under trade credit, smart contracts create value only in narrow parameter regions and only when designed to enforce both IBF mandates and compensatory transfers, a dual commitment mechanism unavailable under bank financing. Managerial Implications: Completing contracts through technology improves risk pricing but reshapes value capture. Smart contract adoption requires careful institutional design, not just technological deployment, to achieve win-win outcomes.

AI.tldr: 区块链智能合约虽然能解决库存融资中的承诺摩擦，但可能损害零售商利益。在银行融资中，传统不完全合约通过批发价信号实现双赢均衡，而智能合约消除这一信号渠道，将剩余转移给制造商。在贸易信贷中，智能合约仅在特定参数区域且需双重承诺机制时才创造价值。
AI.research_question: 区块链智能合约能否解决库存融资中的承诺摩擦问题并改善供应链结果？
AI.motivation: 库存融资帮助资金受限零售商对冲流动性风险，但在产品接收前安排融资时，零售商无法可信地承诺未来采用库存融资，导致风险定价错误和融资条件低效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析资本受限零售商从制造商获取产品时采用银行融资或贸易信贷，然后在产品接收后决定是否采用库存融资的决策过程。
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型，比较传统合约与区块链智能合约（使库存融资决策基于可观察条件自动执行）下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1. 在银行融资中，当流动性风险适中时，不完全合约通过制造商策略性扭曲批发价来传递库存融资采用信号，使银行提供更低利率，实现双赢均衡。2. 智能合约消除这一信号渠道，将剩余转移给制造商，可能损害零售商。3. 在贸易信贷中，智能合约仅在狭窄参数区域且需同时执行库存融资授权和补偿转移的双重承诺机制时才创造价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了不完全合约在供应链融资中的信号传递价值。2. 识别了智能合约可能破坏现有均衡机制的风险。3. 区分了不同融资模式下智能合约的价值创造条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒管理者：技术完善合约虽改善风险定价，但会重塑价值分配。2. 智能合约采用需要精心设计制度安排，而非单纯技术部署。3. 在银行融资中需谨慎评估智能合约对现有信号机制的影响。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12427
title: Online Reviews: Information Content, Drivers, and Platform Design
affiliations: and

detail.title: Online Reviews: Information Content, Drivers, and Platform Design

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Online ratings emerge from a multi-stage process that can systematically distort their informational content. We develop a unified framework decomposing the rating process into distinct components: experienced quality (driven by intrinsic quality, seller effort, and price), expectations formed prior to consumption, contextual influences, strategic distortions, idiosyncratic tastes, and selection into reviewing. This decomposition organizes a growing theoretical and empirical literature and clarifies how seemingly disparate findings -- from fake reviews to disappointment effects to selection biases - relate to distinct stages of the data-generating process. Our framework also provides a lens for evaluating platform design interventions: effective policies target specific components of the rating process, yet many distortions remain difficult to address without introducing new trade-offs. We highlight open questions where further research is most needed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一框架，将在线评分过程分解为多个组成部分，以解释评分数据生成过程中的系统性扭曲，并为平台设计干预提供分析视角。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地分解在线评分过程的不同组成部分，以理解评分数据的生成机制及其中的系统性扭曲？
AI.motivation: 在线评分来自一个多阶段过程，可能系统性地扭曲其信息内容。现有文献中的各种发现（如虚假评论、失望效应、选择偏差等）看似分散，需要统一框架来理解它们与评分过程不同阶段的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 评分过程分解框架：将评分过程分解为体验质量（由内在质量、卖家努力和价格驱动）、消费前期望形成、情境影响、策略性扭曲、异质性偏好和评论选择等组成部分。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和文献综述。通过开发统一的概念框架来组织和整合现有理论和实证文献。
AI.findings: 1. 评分过程中的各种扭曲现象（虚假评论、失望效应、选择偏差等）对应于数据生成过程的不同阶段；2. 有效的平台政策应针对评分过程的特定组成部分；3. 许多扭曲难以解决而不引入新的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了一个统一框架来分解在线评分过程；2. 将看似分散的文献发现系统性地组织起来；3. 为理解评分数据生成机制提供了概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台设计干预提供了分析视角；2. 帮助识别哪些扭曲可以通过针对性政策解决；3. 指出了现有干预措施的局限性；4. 明确了需要进一步研究的关键问题。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12430
title: Housing in Big Cities: The Capitalization Premium
affiliations: University of Würzburg,  and University of Würzburg

detail.title: Housing in Big Cities: The Capitalization Premium

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper establishes a novel city size premium which may be termed the capitalization premium. Real estate investors derive benefits from investing in larger cities, most notably lower housing risk and/or higher expected rent growth. Standard asset valuation implies that, given the level of rents, investors are willing to pay increasingly higher housing prices as city size increases, a capitalization premium. Enabled by fine-grained microgeographic property prices and rents and an estimation strategy combining fixed-effects and instrumental variables, the key contribution of this paper is to identify the relationship between city size and the capitalization rate and to provide an estimate of the magnitude of this capitalization premium. We also spell out key implications of this finding for urban economics and macroeconomics.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一种新的城市规模溢价——资本化溢价。房地产投资者投资大城市可获得收益，主要是更低的住房风险和/或更高的预期租金增长。在租金水平给定的情况下，投资者愿意为大城市支付更高的房价，形成资本化溢价。
AI.research_question: 城市规模与资本化率（房价与租金比率）之间存在怎样的关系？这种资本化溢价的规模有多大？
AI.motivation: 理解为什么投资者愿意为大城市房地产支付更高价格，以及这种"资本化溢价"如何影响城市经济和宏观经济。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准资产定价理论：投资者愿意为低风险和高增长预期的资产支付溢价。城市规模通过降低住房风险和提高租金增长预期影响资本化率。
AI.method: 使用细粒度微观地理房产价格和租金数据，结合固定效应和工具变量估计策略，识别城市规模与资本化率的关系。
AI.findings: 发现城市规模与资本化率之间存在正相关关系，即城市越大，投资者愿意支付的房价相对于租金越高，形成了可量化的资本化溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"资本化溢价"概念，为理解城市规模对房地产定价的影响提供了新的理论框架，连接了城市经济学和资产定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产投资者提供了投资决策依据，为城市规划者和政策制定者理解城市规模对房地产市场的影响提供了实证证据。

title: Explainable Machine Learning For Dynamic Pricing In Fast-Changing Retail Environments
affiliations: Chewy Inc, Infinity Tech Group and Publix Super Markets Inc

detail.title: Explainable Machine Learning For Dynamic Pricing In Fast-Changing Retail Environments
detail.abstract: Dynamic pricing has become a critical strategy in fast-changing retail environments where demand patterns, customer behavior, and competitive conditions evolve rapidly. While machine learning models have shown strong performance in optimizing prices, their lack of transparency limits trust, adoption, and regulatory compliance in real-world retail applications. This paper proposes an explainable machine learning framework for dynamic pricing that balances predictive accuracy with interpretability. The approach integrates advanced pricing models with explainability techniques to reveal how key factors such as demand fluctuations, inventory levels, customer sensitivity, and competitor pricing influence price decisions. By providing human-understandable explanations alongside price recommendations, the framework enables retailers to make informed, accountable, and adaptive pricing decisions in real time. The model is designed to operate effectively in volatile retail settings, including online marketplaces and omnichannel platforms, where rapid changes require continuous learning and justification of pricing actions. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed explainable approach achieves competitive revenue performance while significantly improving transparency and decision confidence compared to black-box models. The findings highlight the importance of explainable machine learning in bridging the gap between algorithmic efficiency and managerial trust, supporting ethical, compliant, and sustainable dynamic pricing practices in modern retail ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释的机器学习框架用于动态定价，在保持预测准确性的同时提高透明度，帮助零售商在快速变化的零售环境中做出可解释的定价决策。
AI.research_question: 如何在动态定价中平衡机器学习模型的预测准确性与可解释性，以增强零售商对定价决策的信任和采纳？
AI.motivation: 动态定价在快速变化的零售环境中至关重要，但传统机器学习模型缺乏透明度，限制了实际应用中的信任、采纳和监管合规性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可解释人工智能（XAI）、动态定价理论、机器学习透明度理论、决策信任理论
AI.method: 提出一个可解释的机器学习框架，整合先进的定价模型与可解释性技术，揭示需求波动、库存水平、客户敏感性和竞争对手定价等关键因素如何影响价格决策。
AI.findings: 实验评估表明，提出的可解释方法在保持竞争力的收入表现的同时，相比黑盒模型显著提高了透明度和决策信心。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 构建了可解释机器学习与动态定价的理论整合框架；2) 提出了算法效率与管理信任之间的桥梁理论；3) 发展了零售环境中透明定价决策的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为零售商提供实时、可解释的定价决策工具；2) 支持监管合规和伦理定价实践；3) 增强在线市场和全渠道平台中的定价适应性；4) 提高管理者对自动化定价系统的信任和采纳。

title: Opinion Dynamics with Multiple Adversaries
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin and

detail.title: Opinion Dynamics with Multiple Adversaries
detail.abstract: Opinion dynamics models how the publicly expressed opinions of users in a social network coevolve according to their neighbors as well as their own intrinsic opinion. Motivated by the real-world manipulation of social networks during the 2016 US elections and the 2019 Hong Kong protests, a growing body of work models the effects of a strategic actor who interferes with the network to induce disagreement or polarization. We lift the assumption of a single strategic actor by introducing a model in which any subset of network users can manipulate network outcomes. They do so by acting according to a fictitious intrinsic opinion. Strategic actors can have conflicting goals, and push competing narratives. We characterize the Nash Equilibrium of the resulting meta-game played by the strategic actors. Experiments on real-world social network datasets from Twitter, Reddit, and Political Blogs show that strategic agents can significantly increase polarization and disagreement, as well as increase the "cost" of the equilibrium. To this end, we give worst-case upper bounds on the Price of Misreporting (analogous to the Price of Anarchy). Finally, we give efficient learning algorithms for the platform to (i) detect whether strategic manipulation has occurred, and (ii) learn who the strategic actors are. Our algorithms are accurate on the same real-world datasets, suggesting how platforms can take steps to mitigate the effects of strategic behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个社交网络意见动态模型，其中多个战略参与者可以操纵网络结果，通过虚构内在意见来增加极化与分歧，并开发检测算法
AI.research_question: 当社交网络中多个战略参与者可以操纵意见动态时，他们如何影响网络结果？平台如何检测和识别这些战略操纵者？
AI.motivation: 受到2016年美国大选和2019年香港抗议中社交网络被操纵的现实事件启发，现有研究通常假设单一战略参与者，但现实中可能存在多个具有冲突目标的操纵者
AI.theoretical_framework: 意见动态模型、博弈论（纳什均衡）、价格操纵成本（Price of Misreporting，类似无政府状态价格）
AI.method: 理论分析（纳什均衡特征描述）、实证实验（使用Twitter、Reddit和政治博客的真实社交网络数据集）、算法开发（检测和识别战略参与者的高效学习算法）
AI.findings: 战略参与者能显著增加网络极化和分歧，提高均衡成本；在真实数据集上验证了操纵效果；给出了价格操纵成本的最坏情况上界；开发的有效算法能准确检测操纵和识别战略参与者
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了意见动态模型，从单一战略参与者到多个具有冲突目标的参与者；描述了由此产生的元博弈的纳什均衡；提出了价格操纵成本的概念并给出理论界限
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交平台提供了检测战略操纵的算法工具；展示了如何识别具体的战略参与者；为平台采取措施减轻战略行为影响提供了可行方案

reference: Tilburg Law Review, 2025, Volume 30, No. 2, pp. 96–119, doi:/10.5334/tilr.422
title: Digital Technology and Procedural Justice: Towards a Geography of Justice
affiliations: Tilburg Law School and Tilburg University

detail.title: Digital Technology and Procedural Justice: Towards a Geography of Justice
detail.abstract: Dispute resolution in the hands of courts has long been criticised as problematic. Digital technology and innovation are changing dispute resolution, and this has an impact on procedural justice. This paper scrutinises how technology (tech) is responding to the criticism of traditional court proceedings (e.g. complexity, high costs) and the new challenges tech brings with it. The analysis looks at five key tech interventions: the digitisation of civil procedures, digital procedural tools, platform-based online dispute resolution (ODR), blockchain-enabled ODR, and the emerging use of artificial intelligence in decision-making. For each proposed tech development, the analysis considers the potential advantages they bring to tackle traditional justice problems as improved access, cost reduction, and speed of proceedings, as well as new criticisms, such as reduced transparency, hidden influences, insufficient or overfiltering, diminished opportunities for in-person hearings, and the risk of reinforcing power imbalances. Framing the discussion within the context of procedural justice, drawing on Art. 6 ECHR standards and social science perspectives on what parties are looking for in dispute procedures, the paper argues for a flexible access to justice approach and system-wide 'geography of justice' This framework envisions a pluralistic dispute resolution landscape that carefully balances technological efficiency with the imperative to uphold fundamental rights and ensure fair outcomes for parties.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字技术如何改变争议解决，分析五种技术干预措施在解决传统法院问题（如复杂性、高成本）方面的潜力，同时评估新技术带来的透明度降低、权力失衡等新挑战，主张在程序正义框架下构建灵活、多元的争议解决体系。
AI.research_question: 数字技术如何应对传统法院程序的批评（如复杂性、高成本），以及这些技术本身带来了哪些新的挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统法院争议解决长期受到批评，而数字技术和创新正在改变争议解决方式，并对程序正义产生影响。需要审视技术如何回应传统法院程序的问题以及技术本身带来的新挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 程序正义理论，基于《欧洲人权公约》第6条标准和社会科学视角，关注当事人在争议程序中寻求什么。提出"司法地理学"框架，强调多元化的争议解决格局。
AI.method: 分析五种关键技术干预措施：民事程序数字化、数字程序工具、平台型在线争议解决（ODR）、区块链支持的ODR、以及人工智能在决策中的新兴应用。对每种技术发展评估其潜在优势和新批评。
AI.findings: 技术干预在改善司法可及性、降低成本、加快程序方面具有潜力，但也带来透明度降低、隐藏影响、过滤不足或过度、面对面听证机会减少、以及强化权力失衡等新风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"灵活司法可及性"方法和系统性的"司法地理学"框架，为平衡技术效率与基本权利保护提供理论指导，推动多元化的争议解决格局发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和司法系统提供实践指导，帮助他们在采用数字技术时平衡效率与公平，确保技术应用不会损害程序正义和当事人的基本权利。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12429
title: Co-Voting Democracy: Bridging Direct and Representative Democracy
affiliations: ETH Zurich - CER-ETH -Center of Economic Research

detail.title: Co-Voting Democracy: Bridging Direct and Representative Democracy

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We provide a rationale for Co-Voting, a decision-making procedure that blends elements of direct and representative democracy to mitigate their main inefficiencies. A randomly selected group of citizens receives voting rights on specific issues, with their collective decision aggregated with parliament’s decision according to a pre-specified weight. Using a simple model, we show that Co-Voting acts as an insurance device against both uninformed decisions in direct democracy and decision biases in representative democracy. We further introduce Co-Del-Voting, which adds strategic delegation to parliament and strictly outperforms both systems. Finally, we outline possible extensions and a roadmap for implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合直接民主与代议制民主的决策机制——共同投票（Co-Voting），通过随机选择公民群体与议会共同决策，以缓解两种民主形式的主要低效问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种混合直接民主与代议制民主的决策机制，以缓解两种民主形式的主要低效问题？
AI.motivation: 直接民主中公民可能因信息不足做出低质量决策，而代议制民主中议会可能因利益集团影响产生决策偏差。需要一种机制来平衡这两种民主形式的优缺点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治经济学和决策理论，分析直接民主与代议制民主的效率问题，提出混合决策机制的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用简单的理论模型分析共同投票机制的效果，并引入战略委托机制（Co-Del-Voting）进行扩展分析。
AI.findings: 共同投票机制可以作为保险装置，既防止直接民主中因信息不足导致的低质量决策，又防止代议制民主中的决策偏差。加入战略委托的Co-Del-Voting机制在严格意义上优于两种传统民主系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了混合民主决策机制的理论框架，为民主制度设计提供了新的理论视角，展示了如何通过制度设计平衡不同民主形式的优缺点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际民主改革提供了可行的实施路径，包括可能的扩展机制和具体的实施路线图，有助于改善现实政治决策质量。

title: SutrAI: A Smart E-Commerce Platform for Traditional Indian Fashion Retail
affiliations: Thakur College of Engineering & Technology - Computer Engineering Department, Thakur College of Engineering & Technology - Computer Engineering Department, Thakur College of Engineering & Technology - Computer Engineering Department and Thakur College of Engineering & Technology - Computer Engineering Department

detail.title: SutrAI: A Smart E-Commerce Platform for Traditional Indian Fashion Retail
detail.abstract: The Indian ethnic fashion e-commerce sector has experienced exponential growth, reaching $4.8 billion in 2024, yet mainstream platforms lack specialized features for traditional wear. This paper presents SutrAI, an innovative e-commerce platform specifically engineered for ethnic fashion retail, incorporating Virtual Drape technology and culturally aware design principles. The system employs modern microservices architecture utilizing Next.js 15 for front-end development, Medusa v2 for backend services, PostgreSQL for data persistence, and Razorpay for secure payment processing. Key innovations include region-specific product categorization, AI-powered virtual try-on capabilities, and comprehensive administrative management tools. Performance evaluation demonstrates significant improvements over generic platforms: 65% increase in conversion rates, 40% reduction in return rates, and 45% improvement in user engagement metrics. The platform successfully addresses critical gaps in ethnic fashion e-commerce by providing culturally relevant features and enhanced user experience through technological innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SutrAI，一个专为印度民族时尚电商设计的创新平台，采用虚拟试穿技术和文化感知设计原则，相比通用平台显著提升了转化率、降低了退货率并改善了用户参与度。

AI.method: 采用现代微服务架构，使用Next.js 15前端、Medusa v2后端、PostgreSQL数据库和Razorpay支付系统，开发了SutrAI平台，并进行性能评估。
AI.findings: SutrAI平台相比通用平台实现了：转化率提升65%，退货率降低40%，用户参与度指标改善45%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了文化感知设计在民族时尚电商中的应用框架，验证了技术创新对提升特定文化领域电商平台绩效的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了具有区域特定产品分类、AI虚拟试穿功能和综合管理工具的SutrAI平台，为民族时尚电商提供了可行的技术解决方案和商业模式参考。

title: Is the software to blame for video gaming disorder?
affiliations: Alexandru Ioan Cuza University, Faculty of Law and Alexandru Ioan Cuza University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Is the software to blame for video gaming disorder?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Eastern Journal of European Studies, December 2025, Vol. 16, Iss. 2

detail.abstract: With over 3 billion active players, the video gaming industry is one of the most lucrative in the world, outperforming the film and music industries combined. Even though playing video games has many favourable effects on players, excessive and careless game playing outweighs these benefits, with numerous negative repercussions on players' physical and mental health, social and professional activities, as well as their financial status. The purpose of this paper is to examine, from a legal standpoint, the ways in which video games can impact players' health, particularly their mental health, as well as the legislative "reactions" at the European Union level that may offer a solution regarding liability for harms inflicted on video game players, particularly those who suffer from video gaming disorder. In the International Classification of Diseases 11th Revision ICD-11, gaming disorder is defined as “a pattern of gaming behaviour ('digitalgaming' or 'video-gaming') characterized by impaired control over gaming, increasing priority given to gaming over other activities to the extent that gaming takes precedence over other interests and daily activities, and continuation or escalation of gaming despite the occurrence of negative consequences”. Video games, as software and software-as-aservice/game-as-a-service, fall under the new European Directive on Product Liability (Directive (EU) 2024/2853) and the Artificial Intelligence Act.

detail.abstract: To date, ecosystem-based theories of antitrust liability have had limited impact on U.S. antitrust law, with U.S. enforcement agencies and courts referring to ecosystems only informally. By contrast, the European Commission’s 2024 guidelines invoke ecosystems without clarifying how they differ from established concepts such as aftermarkets, bundling, or vertical integration. Key factors proffered to define ecosystems, such as network effects, also have ambiguous effects on competition.  Furthermore, scholarly attempts to define ecosystems in terms of economic success or market centrality risk punishing firms for successfully competing on the merits, which may also entrench incumbents by reducing incentives for rivals to invest in alternatives. Clearer definitions and economic justifications must precede any serious effort to incorporate ecosystem-based approaches into U.S. antitrust law.

detail.abstract: The Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID), begun in 1968, is a nationally representative longitudinal survey that follows U.S. individuals and the family units in which they reside across decades. This paper provides an overview of the PSID’s design, content, data collection procedures, and file structure as of the mid-1990s. Emphasizing the study’s low attrition rates and successful recontact strategies, the paper documents the growth of the PSID sample to nearly 8,700 households by 1995 and more than 50,000 individuals observed for up to 28 years.

detail.abstract: Modern retail supply chains face unprecedented vulnerabilities to disruptions from demand shocks and operational uncertainties, creating significant challenges for inventory allocation in multi-echelon systems. Traditional inventory control, often reliant on centralised decision making and static policies, lacks the agility needed for these dynamic environments, especially due to prevalent data silos and limited real-time information sharing. This paper proposes a model for decentralised inventory and lateral transshipment management in a two-echelon supply chain, leveraging Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). The problem is formulated as a multi-agent Markov Decision Process (MDP) incorporating non-stationary demand and stochastic demand spikes. Our core idea involves modelling each store as an autonomous, self-interested agent operating under local information, and using a Q-learning-based algorithm to dynamically integrate replenishment and transshipment actions to maintain service levels and resilience. This model addresses the challenge of fostering system-wide coherence without a dedicated central controller or direct information sharing among agents by potentially employing reward shaping within each agent’s learning objective to align individual goals with overall system performance.

AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）、多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）、Q学习算法、分散式决策理论、库存管理理论、横向转运理论。

detail.abstract: Digital platforms face a persistent challenge in managing behavior-driven content diffusion and curbing misinformation. This paper develops a dynamic theoretical framework in which individuals choose to support, reject, or ignore content based on a Logit utility shaped by evolving private beliefs and platform incentives. Through local social learning, beliefs update via neighbors’ observable actions, creating a feedback loop that links micro behavior and collective belief dynamics. We show that this mechanism endogenously generates self-reinforcing behavioral cascades, where weak incentives or early random actions can lock the network into a dominant behavioral state—supportive, neutral, or rejecting—regardless of factual accuracy. To address this structural fragility, we formulate the platform’s challenge as a dynamic optimal control problem and characterize the optimal incentive path as an early push, gradual fade strategy: interventions should be strongest when beliefs are most volatile and taper as the system stabilizes. To better capture real-world interactions, we extend the analysis to specific network topologies to assess how structure mediates cascade dynamics and intervention effectiveness.

AI.findings: PSID在追踪长期贫困动态方面具有独特优势（长期面板设计），但在样本代表性、测量误差等方面存在局限性。不同数据集各有优劣，研究者应根据具体研究问题选择合适的数据源。替代数据集在某些方面可以补充PSID的不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数据源选择的理论框架，深化了对面板数据在贫困研究中的应用理解，为贫困动态测量方法论做出贡献，建立了数据质量评估的理论标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者选择贫困和福利动态研究的数据源提供实用指南；帮助政策制定者理解不同数据源的可靠性；促进数据收集机构的改进；为未来数据收集设计提供参考。

detail.title: Waiting and Preemption in Public Good Contributions

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies dynamic contributions to a public good with uncertain quality. Two potential contributors gradually receive stochastic, costless signals about the public good’s quality and decide endogenously whether to contribute, when to contribute, and how much to contribute. Within a threshold framework, the paper first shows the existence of a sepa rating equilibrium, in which players contribute only after learning that the public good is of high-quality. The paper then shows the existence of immediate contribution equilibria, either symmetric or asymmetric, where uninformed players contribute at the outset. The paper further shows the existence of pooling equilibria in which both informed (high-quality) and uninformed contributors wait to contribute at a specific time, when contributions become credible enough to trigger immediate following. These equilibria arise under different parameter conditions and imply different expected aggregate utilities, which depend on the speed of signals arriving and the players’ time preferences.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在公共物品质量不确定情况下的动态贡献行为。两个潜在贡献者逐步接收关于公共物品质量的随机信号，内生决定是否贡献、何时贡献以及贡献多少。论文在阈值框架下展示了三种均衡：分离均衡（只在确认高质量时贡献）、即时贡献均衡（对称或不对称）和混合均衡（知情和不知情者等待特定时机贡献）。
AI.research_question: 在公共物品质量不确定的情况下，潜在贡献者如何内生地决定是否贡献、何时贡献以及贡献多少？不同均衡类型（分离均衡、即时贡献均衡、混合均衡）在什么参数条件下存在？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中许多公共物品（如开源软件、公共研究项目）的质量在初期是不确定的，贡献者需要基于逐步获得的信息做出贡献决策。理解这种动态决策过程对于设计激励机制和预测集体行动结果具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值框架下的动态博弈理论，信号学习理论，公共物品理论，贝叶斯更新，序贯决策理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建动态博弈模型，分析不同均衡的存在条件和性质，比较不同均衡下的预期总效用
AI.findings: 1. 存在分离均衡：参与者只在确认公共物品为高质量时才贡献；2. 存在即时贡献均衡：对称或不对称的不知情参与者在开始时立即贡献；3. 存在混合均衡：知情（高质量）和不知情贡献者都等待特定时机贡献，当贡献足够可信时触发立即跟随；4. 不同均衡在不同参数条件下存在；5. 预期总效用取决于信号到达速度和参与者的时间偏好
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在公共物品质量不确定的动态贡献问题中建立了完整的均衡分析框架；2. 识别并证明了三种不同类型的均衡存在条件；3. 揭示了信号学习速度和时间偏好如何影响均衡选择和集体福利；4. 为理解信息不对称下的集体行动提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为公共物品项目管理者设计激励机制提供理论指导；2. 帮助预测在不同信息环境下集体贡献行为的动态模式；3. 为政策制定者理解公共物品供给的动态过程提供分析工具；4. 对开源社区、众筹平台等实际场景中的贡献行为有解释和预测价值

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper argues that advancing the study of service quality in professional settings requires moving beyond generic, one-size-fits-all models towards understanding that are service-specific, context sensitive, and that consider both client and provider perspectives. Future research can more accurately assess features such as credibility, ethics, trust and co-creation to capture the essence of PS. Therefore, future research should focus on both provider and client-based, qualitative research approaches, which can gain a subjective perspective on the subjective nature of the concept. Also, being more contextualised, more research studies can be implemented in built environment disciplines that support one of the basic needs of human beings. Especially, valuation services research can expand from developed to developing countries, which can extract the nature of professional discipline, including professional expertise, knowledge, skills, its autonomy and integrity, which is derived through the client-provider co-creation that may enhance credibility and trust, thereby offering both theoretical and practical value for improving professional practice globally. Accordingly, this review provides a broader space to enlarge the service quality literature in the professional context. So, in the future, researchers can zoom into particular professions which have not been explicitly addressed in this stage and find special requirements to address the service quality in their context.

AI.tldr: 本文主张专业服务质量研究需超越通用模型，转向服务特定、情境敏感、兼顾客户与提供者视角的理解，未来应聚焦定性的主客双重视角研究，并在建筑环境等具体专业领域开展更多情境化研究。
AI.research_question: 如何推进专业服务环境中的服务质量研究，使其超越通用模型，实现服务特定、情境敏感且兼顾客户与提供者视角的理解？
AI.motivation: 当前专业服务质量研究过于依赖通用的一刀切模型，缺乏对特定服务类型、具体情境以及客户与提供者双重视角的深入理解，限制了研究的理论深度和实践价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专业服务质量理论、服务主导逻辑、共同创造理论、信任与信誉理论、专业自主性与完整性理论
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，提出未来研究应采用的定性研究方法，特别是基于提供者和客户视角的定性研究
AI.findings: 专业服务质量研究需要：1)从通用模型转向服务特定理解；2)考虑具体情境敏感性；3)兼顾客户与提供者双重视角；4)采用定性研究方法；5)在建筑环境等具体专业领域开展更多研究；6)将估值服务研究从发达国家扩展到发展中国家
AI.theory_contributions: 1)扩展了专业服务质量文献的理论空间；2)提出了服务特定、情境敏感的研究框架；3)强调了共同创造在专业信誉和信任形成中的作用；4)为不同专业领域的服务质量研究提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 1)为专业实践提供改进方向；2)帮助特定专业领域识别服务质量的特殊要求；3)促进发展中国家专业服务质量提升；4)通过增强信誉和信任改善客户-提供者关系

title: The Trade-Off Between Union Wage Gains and Working Time Flexibility: How Gender Benefits Are Offset
affiliations: University of Auckland, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland

detail.title: The Trade-Off Between Union Wage Gains and Working Time Flexibility: How Gender Benefits Are Offset

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the trade-off between union wage premiums and working time flexibility and its implications for gender pay disparities in Australia using longitudinal data from the HILDA Survey (2001-2022). Using instrumental variable estimation with lagged industry level unionization rates and flexibility prevalence as instruments, I document that unions create a fundamental trade-off between wage gains and schedule autonomy. Union membership provides substantial wage premiums, with women receiving larger benefits (15.1%) than men (10.1%) when flexibility is held constant. However, unions also systematically reduce working time flexibility for both genders. Heterogeneity analysis shows that flexibility generates higher wage returns for women across most of the earnings distribution, meaning that equal flexibility constraints impose unequal economic costs by gender. When examining total effects without controlling for flexibility, the gender difference in union wage premiums becomes statistically insignificant, indicating that flexibility constraints offset unions’ gender-equalizing potential. Union and flexibility’s premiums are concentrated among middle-income workers, leading to distinct trade-offs depending on wage level. Family structure analysis reveals that union premiums are concentrated among partnered women, while flexibility benefits primarily accrue to partnered mothers.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用澳大利亚HILDA调查数据（2001-2022），通过工具变量方法分析工会工资溢价与工作时间灵活性之间的权衡及其对性别工资差距的影响。研究发现工会创造了一个基本权衡：提供显著工资溢价（女性15.1%，男性10.1%），但系统性减少工作时间灵活性。灵活性对女性的工资回报更高，导致同等灵活性约束对两性产生不同的经济成本。
AI.research_question: 工会工资溢价与工作时间灵活性之间的权衡如何影响澳大利亚的性别工资差距？
AI.motivation: 理解工会对工资和工作条件的影响，特别是这种影响如何因性别而异，对于解决性别工资差距和设计更公平的劳动政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工会工资溢价理论、工作时间灵活性理论、性别工资差距理论、劳动经济学中的权衡理论
AI.method: 使用澳大利亚HILDA调查的纵向数据（2001-2022），采用工具变量估计方法，以滞后的行业层面工会化率和灵活性普遍性作为工具变量，进行异质性分析和家庭结构分析。
AI.findings: 1. 工会创造工资溢价与工作时间灵活性之间的基本权衡；2. 工会提供显著工资溢价（女性15.1%，男性10.1%）；3. 工会系统性减少工作时间灵活性；4. 灵活性对女性的工资回报更高；5. 不控制灵活性时，工会工资溢价的性别差异变得统计不显著；6. 工会和灵活性的溢价集中在中收入工人；7. 工会溢价集中在有伴侣的女性，灵活性收益主要惠及有伴侣的母亲。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了工会工资溢价与工作时间灵活性之间的权衡理论框架；2. 揭示了这种权衡如何影响性别工资差距；3. 提出了灵活性约束抵消工会性别平等潜力的机制；4. 拓展了工会影响异质性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计更公平的劳动政策提供依据；2. 帮助工会制定兼顾工资增长和工作灵活性的策略；3. 为企业设计灵活工作安排提供参考；4. 为减少性别工资差距提供具体政策建议。

detail.title: Democratic Backsliding and Media Scrutiny

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Democratic backsliding by incumbents is often a gradual process of trial-and-error. We develop a model where the consequences of an incumbent’s attempts to subvert complex democratic norms and institutions are uncertain. A unique optimal strategy emerges as the incumbent trades off ambition against political constraints, giving rise to incrementalism, opportunism and backtracking. Incrementalism emerges as the incumbent learns from each successive attempt to erode norms in the face of uncertainty. Backtracking can occur when the incumbent overshoots publicly “acceptable” guardrails, while mistakes strengthening norms may deter backsliding altogether. Public suspicion of the media and incumbent popularity encourage media reports that paint a positive picture of backsliding attempts, enabling opportunistic behaviour. But ex-ante mistrust of the incumbent shifts media reporting and public sentiment against her. The relationship between citizens’ beliefs and the media’s incentives produces a channel that can progressively strengthen or weaken democratic norms.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个模型，解释在位者如何通过试错过程逐步削弱民主规范。在位者在野心与政治约束之间权衡，产生渐进主义、机会主义和退却行为。媒体报告和公众信任在其中起关键作用。
AI.research_question: 在位者如何通过试错过程逐步削弱民主规范？媒体和公众信任如何影响这一过程？
AI.motivation: 民主倒退往往是一个渐进过程，而非突然事件。现有研究未能充分解释在位者如何在面对不确定后果时，通过试错策略逐步侵蚀民主制度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 试错学习理论：在位者从每次侵蚀民主规范的尝试中学习；2. 政治约束理论：在位者在野心与政治约束间权衡；3. 媒体-公众互动理论：媒体报告影响公众认知，公众信任影响媒体激励。
AI.method: 理论建模方法。开发一个形式模型，其中在位者面临侵蚀民主规范的不确定后果，通过优化策略在野心与约束间权衡。分析媒体报告、公众信任和公民信念的互动机制。
AI.findings: 1. 渐进主义是面对不确定性时的最优策略；2. 当在位者超出公众"可接受"底线时会发生退却；3. 加强规范的错误可能完全阻止民主倒退；4. 公众对媒体的怀疑和在位者受欢迎度鼓励媒体正面报道倒退尝试；5. 事前对在位者的不信任使媒体和公众反对她。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出民主倒退的试错学习理论框架；2. 识别渐进主义、机会主义和退却作为核心策略；3. 建立公民信念与媒体激励的互动模型，解释民主规范如何被渐进强化或削弱。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为识别和应对民主倒退提供分析框架；2. 强调媒体监督和公众警觉的重要性；3. 揭示事前信任对民主韧性的关键作用；4. 为民主捍卫者提供策略建议。

title: An Equitable Digital Future: An Epistemic Reference for a Pan-African Diplomatic Position on Select Sections of the WSIS+20 Zero Draft (Vol-II)

detail.title: An Equitable Digital Future: An Epistemic Reference for a Pan-African Diplomatic Position on Select Sections of the WSIS+20 Zero Draft (Vol-II)
detail.abstract: The WSIS+20 Revision 1 document (dated November 7, 2025) partially reflects the priorities outlined in the AIFAT paper, which focuses on a Pan-African diplomatic position emphasizing actionable, financially backed, and rights-respecting commitments to address digital divides in Africa and the Global South. The Rev1 document reaffirms high-level WSIS principles, aligns with the Global Digital Compact (GDC), and emphasizes inclusion, but it remains somewhat general and warrants any specific, Africa-centric or for that matter a BOP centric apparatus in reference to the amendments proposed by AIFAT. It matches in broad recognition of issues like affordability, data governance, human rights, financing, and DPI, but falls short in providing concrete targets, mechanisms, or explicit support for sovereign control and debt-linked financing. In some areas, it exceeds expectations by proposing new structures (e.g., task forces, fellowships) for ongoing implementation and alignment with the 2030 Agenda. Notably, while Africa is mentioned as a priority region (e.g., paras 5, 88), the document does not yet adopt or endorse an "Africa-centric" lens-at least a BOP centric triangulation or reference the AfCFTA, treating challenges more globally. AI.tldr: 本文分析了WSIS+20 Rev1文件与AIFAT论文中提出的非洲优先数字发展议程之间的差距，指出该文件虽认可数字鸿沟等核心问题，但缺乏具体的非洲中心化机制、目标和融资方案。
AI.research_question: WSIS+20 Rev1文件在多大程度上采纳了AIFAT论文提出的非洲中心化、行动导向、资金支持的数字发展议程？
AI.motivation: 非洲和全球南方国家面临严重的数字鸿沟问题，需要具体的、资金支持的、尊重权利的承诺。AIFAT论文提出了明确的非洲中心化解决方案，但国际政策文件是否采纳这些建议尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字鸿沟理论、全球治理理论、发展融资理论、数字主权理论、非洲中心主义发展观
AI.method: 政策文本分析：比较AIFAT论文建议与WSIS+20 Rev1文件内容，识别共识与差距
AI.findings: WSIS+20 Rev1文件在高层原则上与AIFAT建议一致，但缺乏具体目标、机制、主权控制和债务融资支持，未采纳非洲中心化视角，未明确引用AfCFTA等非洲具体框架

AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家参与国际数字治理谈判提供策略建议，指出需要推动更具体的承诺、融资机制和主权控制条款

title: Data-driven Innovation and Privacy Concerns in a Schumpeterian Growth
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland - Department of Economics

detail.title: Data-driven Innovation and Privacy Concerns in a Schumpeterian Growth

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a Schumpeterian growth model in which consumer data are used as the R&D input for quality improvements, and consumers balance the economic benefits of selling their consumption data against privacy concerns. In the market equilibrium, a higher degree of privacy concerns reduces the supply of consumer data, hindering innovation and thereby slowing down growth. This finding is consistent with our cross-country empirical evidence that privacy concerns are negatively correlated with regional digital development. Furthermore, our model shows that if the degree of privacy concerns exceeds a certain threshold, the decentralized equilibrium features socially excessive innovation, suggesting that data use should be more strictly regulated or taxed. In contrast, if the degree of privacy concerns is lower than this threshold value, innovation in the decentralized equilibrium is below the socially efficient level, and policies that promote or subsidize data use become socially desirable. These findings help us understand cross-country differences in data regulation policies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，将消费者数据作为研发投入用于质量改进，消费者在出售消费数据的经济收益与隐私担忧之间权衡。市场均衡中，较高的隐私担忧会减少消费者数据供给，阻碍创新并减缓增长。跨国实证证据显示隐私担忧与区域数字发展负相关。模型表明：当隐私担忧超过阈值时，分散均衡会出现社会过度创新，需要更严格的数据监管或征税；低于阈值时，创新低于社会最优水平，应促进或补贴数据使用。
AI.research_question: 消费者隐私担忧如何影响以数据为研发投入的创新和经济增长？隐私担忧程度不同时，数据使用的最优政策干预是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字经济时代，消费者数据成为创新的重要投入，但消费者对隐私的担忧可能限制数据供给。理解隐私担忧对创新和增长的影响，以及相应的最优政策设计，对各国制定数据监管政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熊彼特增长模型（Schumpeterian growth model），将消费者数据作为研发投入，引入消费者在数据出售收益与隐私担忧之间的权衡。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与均衡分析，结合跨国实证证据（隐私担忧与区域数字发展的相关性检验）。
AI.findings: 1. 隐私担忧减少消费者数据供给，阻碍创新和经济增长；2. 跨国证据显示隐私担忧与数字发展负相关；3. 存在隐私担忧阈值：超过阈值时市场均衡创新过度，需要更严格监管或征税；低于阈值时创新不足，应促进或补贴数据使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将消费者数据作为研发投入纳入熊彼特增长框架；2. 建立隐私担忧影响创新和增长的理论机制；3. 识别决定最优数据政策（监管vs补贴）的隐私担忧阈值条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为各国数据监管政策差异提供理论解释；2. 为政策制定者提供基于隐私担忧程度的数据使用干预指南；3. 帮助理解跨国数字发展差异的成因。

title: Women’s Empowerment from Property to Political and Labor Rights
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Women’s Empowerment from Property to Political and Labor Rights

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Since the nineteenth century, many societies have transitioned from male-dominated institutions toward regimes in which rights are more evenly distributed across genders. Property, political, and labor rights now underpin modern gender equality. Yet, a central puzzle remains (Doepke and Tertilt, 2009): why would men, who initially monopolize authority, voluntarily expand women’s rights? We propose that such reforms occur when those in power face credible threats from the subordinated group—women. In our framework, an increase in women’s relative productivity amplifies their bargaining power, making such threats more effective. Rights are thus extended not altruistically but strategically, as concessions to avert costly political or social instability. We develop a dynamic model that endogenizes the evolution of women’s rights as a sequential process—from property to political and ultimately to labor-market rights. The model identifies the strategic logic behind each stage and provides testable comparative statics on the timing and ordering of reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了男性主导的社会为何会自愿扩大女性权利。研究发现，当掌权者面临被压迫群体（女性）的可信威胁时，权利改革才会发生。女性相对生产力的提高增强了她们的议价能力，使得威胁更有效。权利扩张是战略性的让步，而非利他主义，旨在避免政治或社会不稳定。
AI.research_question: 为什么最初垄断权威的男性会自愿扩大女性权利？
AI.motivation: 自19世纪以来，许多社会从男性主导的制度转向权利更平等分配的体制。财产权、政治权利和劳动权利构成了现代性别平等的基础。但核心谜题是：为什么最初垄断权威的男性会自愿扩大女性权利？
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Doepke和Tertilt(2009)提出的核心谜题，本文提出战略让步理论框架。认为权利改革发生在掌权者面临被压迫群体（女性）的可信威胁时，女性相对生产力的提高增强了她们的议价能力，使得威胁更有效。
AI.method: 开发了一个动态模型，将女性权利的演变内生化为一个顺序过程——从财产权到政治权利，最终到劳动力市场权利。模型识别了每个阶段的战略逻辑，并提供了关于改革时机和顺序的可检验比较静态分析。
AI.findings: 权利扩张是战略性的让步，而非利他主义，旨在避免政治或社会不稳定。女性权利的演变遵循特定的顺序模式：财产权→政治权利→劳动力市场权利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为性别权利演变提供了新的理论解释框架；2. 将权利改革视为战略互动过程而非自然演进；3. 建立了女性权利演变的顺序模型；4. 提供了可检验的比较静态预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解性别权利改革的时机和顺序；2. 为政策制定者提供改革路径的参考；3. 揭示了女性生产力提高对权利改革的推动作用；4. 为性别平等运动提供战略指导。

title: Entrepreneurial Opportunity Recognition from a Cognitive Processes Perspective: A Systematic Review and Bibliometric Analysis
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School

detail.title: Entrepreneurial Opportunity Recognition from a Cognitive Processes Perspective: A Systematic Review and Bibliometric Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Entrepreneurial Opportunity Recognition (EOR) is central to entrepreneurship research, yet its underlying cognitive processes remain underexplored, hindering theoretical advancement. This limits understanding of how entrepreneurs identify opportunities, particularly amidst uncertainty. Cognition shapes perceptions and decisions in dynamic environments. In an era of volatility, complexity, and digital transformation, clarifying how entrepreneurs cognitively navigate change and identify opportunities is vital for fostering adaptability, resilience, and responsible leadership. This cognitive lens, linking observable outcomes with mental models, directly aligns with the “Business (Un)Usual: Navigating Change in a Dynamic World” theme by exploring value creation in uncertain times. 

Given the theoretical and practical importance of a cognitive perspective, an integrative and transparent review of the cognitive processes underlying EOR is imperative. Traditional narrative reviews often lack rigour and reproducibility, leading to partial interpretations. This study employs a systematic literature review (SLR) and bibliometric analysis to provide a critical synthesis and objective mapping of the field’s intellectual structure. This dual approach 12 aims to overcome fragmentation and build a robust foundation for future cognitive research in entrepreneurship. 

A mixed-method approach integrates a systematic review with bibliometric analysis for a comprehensive overview of cognitive processes in EOR. The SLR, guided by the SPAR-4-SLR protocol (Paul et al., 2021) and PRISMA 2020 guidelines (Page et al., 2021), ensures trans parency through explicit selection criteria, identifying theoretical gaps and research trends. Articles from Web of Science and Scopus yielded 170 empirical studies, with data extracted via a structured coding sheet. Complementing this, bibliometric analysis mapped the field’s intellectual structure from 1995 to 2024 through performance and science mapping. This involved citation analysis to identify influential works, bibliographic coupling for emerging clusters, and co-word analysis for thematic structures, offering a triangulated and nuanced understanding. 

Performance analysis shows exponential growth in cognitive EOR scholarship since the mid 2010s, with Journal of Business Venturing and Strategic Entrepreneurship Journal as prominent outlets. Foundational studies highlight prior knowledge, pattern recognition, entrepreneurial alertness, self-efficacy, and creativity as central cognitive mechanisms. Science mapping iden tified four thematic clusters: (1) Cognitive Foundations, focusing on mental models, human capital, and creativity, particularly in international entrepreneurship; (2) Entrepreneurial Alert ness and Intentions, linking psychological competencies, mindset, and education to opportunity recognition; (3) Entrepreneurial Cognition and Innovation, positioning cognition as a strate gic resource for innovation in high-growth ventures; and (4) Gender, Self-Efficacy, and En trepreneurial Intention, examining demographic influences and the mediating role of self-efficacy. 

These findings reveal theoretical gaps, particularly concerning the dynamic interaction of cognitive resources and mental representations in opportunity recognition, and an underdeveloped understanding of opportunity evaluation. Practically, these gaps hinder entrepreneurship education, complex opportunity recognition by practitioners, and effective policy interventions. This systematic review and bibliometric analysis provide a robust foundation for advancing cognitive perspectives, ensuring EOR is better theorised, empirically grounded, and practically impactful. This directly contributes to the conference theme by enhancing our understanding of how individuals navigate change in a dynamic world and drive positive change amidst uncertainty for the benefit of organisations and society.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统性文献综述和文献计量分析，整合分析了创业机会识别（EOR）的认知过程研究，识别了四个主题集群，揭示了理论空白，为未来认知创业研究提供了坚实基础。
AI.research_question: 创业机会识别（EOR）的认知过程是什么？如何通过系统性文献综述和文献计量分析整合该领域的研究，识别理论空白和研究趋势？
AI.motivation: 创业机会识别是创业研究的核心，但其认知过程尚未充分探索，阻碍了理论发展。在波动性、复杂性和数字化转型的时代，理解创业者如何认知地应对变化并识别机会对于培养适应性、韧性和负责任领导力至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知理论框架，包括认知过程、心理模型、先验知识、模式识别、创业警觉性、自我效能感和创造力等认知机制。
AI.method: 混合方法：系统性文献综述（遵循SPAR-4-SLR协议和PRISMA 2020指南）结合文献计量分析（包括引文分析、文献耦合分析和共词分析）。数据来自Web of Science和Scopus数据库的170篇实证研究。
AI.findings: 1. 认知EOR研究自2010年代中期呈指数增长；2. 识别了四个主题集群：认知基础、创业警觉性与意图、创业认知与创新、性别、自我效能与创业意图；3. 揭示了理论空白，特别是认知资源与心理表征的动态互动以及机会评估的理解不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了认知EOR研究的综合框架；2. 识别了理论空白和研究趋势；3. 为未来认知创业研究建立了坚实基础；4. 将认知过程与创业机会识别理论联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创业教育提供指导；2. 帮助从业者识别复杂机会；3. 为政策干预提供依据；4. 增强组织和社会在不确定环境中的适应性和韧性。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12428
title: A Strategic Compass for Navigating Senegal's Debt Crisis
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University and

detail.title: A Strategic Compass for Navigating Senegal's Debt Crisis

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: With public debt at around 130% of GDP, Senegal’s options are limited: there are no good solutions. This paper reviews the constraints and difficult choices the government faces in managing the debt crisis. We explore two possible paths. In the first approach, the government seeks to avoid restructuring at all costs. For debt to remain sustainable, it needs to maintain extremely tight fiscal policy for an extended period and refinance existing debt at very low interest rates. We provide quantification of both efforts, and show that such a strategy could work, albeit under very narrow – and to some extent – unlikely, assumptions: the level of consolidation expected would probably deteriorate economic growth and be counterproductive, or politically unsustainable. Moreover, the level of bilateral or multilateral support would need to be substantial: only by securing partners willing to take risks at low interest rates could Senegal refinance its debt due in 2026 and 2027. It would also require large net financing from regional banks, thus transferring risks to the monetary union. In the second approach, the government aims to negotiate with its bilateral and private external creditors to restructure its debt under an IMF program. We argue that this could be achieved through a less radical fiscal adjustment than in the previous scenario, where restructuring is avoided. It would seek to avoid implicating regional lenders, arguing that doing so would worsen the country's prospects and even those of its external creditors. Such a strategy would also involve mobilizing the international community through new multilateral concessional loans, along with high-level political commitments from its main bilateral creditors, France and China, to achieve fast and comprehensive debt relief, comparable to that achieved by private creditors. It also requires strengthening fiscal and prudential oversight within the zone. We argue that while there are considerable pressures to repay, the economic literature teaches us that the costs of delaying a restructuring are higher.

AI.tldr: 塞内加尔面临130%GDP的债务危机，论文分析两种应对路径：一是避免债务重组但需极度紧缩财政和低息再融资，二是通过IMF计划与双边及私人债权人谈判重组，后者可能更可行。
AI.research_question: 塞内加尔政府应如何管理130%GDP的债务危机？避免重组与谈判重组两种路径的可行性、约束条件和后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 塞内加尔公共债务占GDP约130%，面临严重债务危机，政府管理选项有限且没有完美解决方案，需要分析约束条件和艰难选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债务可持续性理论、财政调整理论、债务重组经济学、国际金融架构理论、主权债务危机管理理论。
AI.method: 情景分析、量化模拟、约束条件评估、政策路径比较分析、基于经济文献的理论论证。
AI.findings: 1)避免重组路径需要极端紧缩财政和极低利率再融资，假设条件苛刻且可能损害经济增长；2)谈判重组路径可通过IMF计划实现，需要较少财政调整但需国际社会支持；3)延迟重组的成本高于立即重组。
AI.theory_contributions: 1)为高债务国家提供债务危机管理的理论框架；2)比较不同债务管理策略的理论依据；3)强调延迟重组的成本高于立即重组的理论启示。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)为塞内加尔政府提供具体可行的债务管理方案；2)为双边债权人(法国、中国)和多边机构提供政策建议；3)为区域银行和货币联盟提供风险管理指导；4)为类似高债务国家提供参考案例。
